label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieIntro

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharliePostBattle

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_IsntItFunHere

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanIntro
text: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS\nalways bring our POKéMON.\lHow about a quick battle?

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanDefeat

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro
text: DAN: While searching for treasures,\nwe discovered a TRAINER!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat
text: DAN: We couldn't win even though\nwe worked together…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBattle
text: DAN: We can't find any treasures…\nI wonder if someone got them already?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoughMons
text: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro
text: KIRA: Oh?\nWe were searching for treasures.\lBut we discovered a TRAINER instead!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraDefeat
text: KIRA: Ooh, so strong!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBattle
text: KIRA: Where could the treasures be?\pI've already decided what I'm buying\nwhen we find the treasures!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnoughMons
text: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegister
text: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry!\nI'm going to register you for that!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchIntro
text: DAN: We've been searching for\ntreasures all this time.\pOur POKéMON have grown stronger, too.\nLet us show you, okay?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchDefeat
text: DAN: You're strong, as usual!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRematch
text: DAN: We can't find any treasures,\nwe lose at POKéMON…\pI want to go home… But if I say that,\nshe gets all angry with me…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchNotEnoughMons
text: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
text: KIRA: Oh? We meet again!\pJust like us, you still haven't given up\nsearching for treasures, have you?\pWant to make it so the loser has\nto give up searching?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchDefeat
text: KIRA: Oh, we lost again…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRematch
text: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise\nour POKéMON some more and we find\lthe treasures here!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchNotEnoughMons
text: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro
text: I'm not good at swimming,\nbut I am good at battles!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniDefeat
text: Oops.\nThat didn't go very well.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBattle
text: Walking around barefoot in this ship\nis kind of gross.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonIntro
text: Strength and compassion…\nThose are a TRAINER's treasures!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDefeat
text: Ah, there is something about you\nthat sparkles.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPostBattle
text: In a cabin somewhere on board,\nI saw something sparkle.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
text: This is a perfect place to go exploring!\nIt's exciting here!\pI bet there're amazing treasures on\nboard.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_TakingALookAround
text: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm\ntaking a look around.\pHmhm…\nThere appear to be other cabins…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaIntro
text: What on earth would compel you to\ncome here? You must be curious!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaDefeat
text: Not just curious, but also strong…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostBattle
text: The man next door…\pHe says he's just sightseeing,\nbut I don't know about that.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRegister
text: You're such a tough TRAINER!\nLet me register you as a memento!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchIntro
text: What on earth would compel you to\ncome back? You must really be curious!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchDefeat
text: Aren't you too strong?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostRematch
text: I'm sure that man's up to something!\nHe just acts so suspiciously!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusIntro
text: Waaah!\nI've been found! …Huh?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusDefeat
text: Oh, you're not my mom.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusPostBattle
text: I'm in trouble with my mom, so I ran.\nKeep it a secret where I am!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
text: Urrrrppp…\pI'm getting queasy just being aboard\nthis ship…\pIt's not even moving, but…

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSomething
text:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to
snatch something important!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideoutBe
text: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is trying to\nawaken an awesome POKéMON at their\lHIDEOUT.\pBut where might their HIDEOUT be?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubmarine
text:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's gone off to jack a submarine!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122
text:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to
MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney
text: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is after\nan awesome POKéMON at MT. CHIMNEY.\pBut what is that POKéMON like?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCity
text:
What? What? What do you want with
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: Ayiyiyi!\nSuspicious character spotted!

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Grrrrr…\nI lost it!

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: I took the loss for the TEAM,\nbut I did my job…

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: If you want to know the secret about\nour HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: I can't win at all…

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Our HIDEOUT's secret?\pWell, let's just say…\nThere's a submarine at the far end!\pBut, by now…\nKekekeke…

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: Fuel supply loaded A-OK!\nIn-cruise snacks loaded A-OK!\pNothing left to do but KO a pesky\nmeddler!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: I took a serious licking!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: Humph!\nThis was supposed to happen!\pMy mission was to just hold you up!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
text: Yawn… Keeping watch over the\nHIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: Yawn…\nOh, I lost…

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
text: If you scurry too much, other TEAM\nAQUA members might get you.

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro
text: Hey!\nYou there!\pWhich do you think is cooler?\nTEAM AQUA's uniform or TEAM MAGMA's?

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
text: I lost in a cool way…

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
text: If you have a cool uniform, you look\ngood even in a loss, don't you think?

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
text:
Hehehe…\pGot here already, did you?
We underestimated you!\pBut this is it!\pI'm a cut above the GRUNTS you've seen
so far.\pI'm not stalling for time.
I'm going to pulverize you!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattDefeat
text: Hehehe…\nSo, I lost, too…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHisPreparations
text: Hehehe!\pWhile I was toying with you, our BOSS\ngot through his preparations!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
text:
Hehehe!\pOur BOSS has already gone on his way to
some cave under the sea!\pIf you're going to give chase, you'd
better search the big, wide sea beyond\lLILYCOVE.\pBut will you find it then?
Hehehe!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting!\nYou owe me a battle, too!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: Tired of waiting…\nLost and dazed…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: BOSS…\nIs this good enough?

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
text:
Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride
and joy!\pYou're clueless about where you are,
aren't you?\pFluster and tire out the enemy, then
lower the boom! That's our plan!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
text: What's wrong with you?\nYou're not tired at all!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
text: That reminds me… I can't remember\nwhere I put the MASTER BALL.\pIf I fail to guard it, our BOSS will\nchew me out…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Intro
text: When I joined TEAM AQUA, the first\nthing I had to learn was how these\lwarp panels connected.

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Defeat
text: I was too occupied thinking about\nthe warp panels…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
text: I'll have to learn about how I can\nbattle more effectively…

text: POKEMON CENTER

label: AzaleaTown_Text_SlowpokeWellSign
text:
SLOWPOKE WELL\pAlso known as the
RAINMAKER WELL.\pLocals believe that a
SLOWPOKE's yawn summons rain.\pRecords show that a
SLOWPOKE's yawn ended a
drought 400 years ago.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_ApricornBoy
text: KURT says a good BALL\nstarts with patience.\pI am better at the\nwaiting than the carving.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_WellNeighbor
text: When SLOWPOKE nap near\nthe well, everyone lowers\ltheir voice.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Slowpoke
text: SLOWPOKE: ... ...Yawn?

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GymFan
text: BUGSY studies tiny wings\nand tiny legs.\pThen somehow those tiny\nthings beat you.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_DorianIntro
speaker: Dorian
text: You're the NEW BARK kid.\pI expected taller.\pI'm DORIAN.\nI check the people getting\lahead of me.\pSo far?\nBad list.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_DorianBeforeBattle
text: Try to make this useful.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_DorianDefeat
text: Hmph.\nBad read.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_DorianAfterWin
speaker: Dorian
text: You're not polished.\pThat's the annoying part.\pBUGSY keeps notes.\nTry not to be an easy page.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_DorianAfterBattle
text: Still here?\nGood.\pI dislike being wrong twice.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_DorianTooEarly
text: Team Rocket?\pClear the forest first.\nThen we can talk rankings.

label: AzaleaTown_Text_DorianTooLate
text: HIVE BADGE already?\pFine.\nWe compare later.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon
text: My dear challenger!\pYour skill level is truly astounding!\pWe now would like you to face our\nleader, the ARENA TYCOON!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PreparedForTycoon
text: A battle with the ARENA TYCOON!\nAre you prepared?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForGreta
text: REFEREE: The ARENA TYCOON!\nMake way for GRETA!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger
text: GRETA: Hey!\nHowdy!\p…Wait, are you the challenger?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IsThatRight
text: Is that right? Hmm…\nHmhm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
text: I don't know how to say it, but…\nTo put it bluntly, you look pretty weak.\lAre you sure you're up for me?\pHmm…\pWell, all right!\nWe'll take things easy to start with!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IgniteMyPassionForBattle
text: Okay! Let's see you ignite my passion\nfor battle!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll
text: GRETA: Ow, wait a second!\nYou are tough after all!\pI like you!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedGutsSymbol
text: The Guts Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime
text: Hmm…\pIt's going to be fun the next time!\nI'm looking forward to it!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain
text: GRETA: Hey! Howdy!\nYou finally won your way up to me!\pI was getting worried waiting for you!\nI was really looking forward to seeing\lyou again!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SoAreYouReady
text: … … …\nSo, are you ready?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WontAllowHalfheartedEffort
text: I won't allow a halfhearted effort!\nBe ready for a thrashing!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_LetsGetThisStarted
text: Come on, REFEREE!\nLet's get this started!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaBlownAway
text: GRETA: Gaaah! Blown away!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GutsSymbolTookGoldenShine
text: The Guts Symbol took on\na golden shine!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose
text: Arrrgh!\nThis is so infuriating!\pIf we ever battle again, I won't lose!\nDon't you forget it! Bye-bye!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
text:
In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
text:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.\pFirst, one battle lasts only
three turns.\pIf the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.\pThe REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.\pAlso, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
text: The first judging factor is “Mind.”\nThis factor evaluates how aggressive\lthe battlers were.\pThe judging is based on how often\nthe TRAINERS ordered the use of\loffensive moves.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
text:
The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively\lPOKéMON moves were used.\pIf a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.\pIf a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.\pIf it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super\leffective” and goes down if it was\l“not very effective.”\pThe Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.\pIf the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to\lhit with a move, its Skill rating will not\lgo down.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
text: The third judging factor is “Body.”\nThis factor is based on how much HP\lremained at the end of a battle.\pThe rating takes into account how much\nHP a POKéMON had at the start of\lbattle, and what remained at the end.

Hey, my name's NOLAND!
I'm basically in charge of this place,\lwhich is why I'm the FACTORY HEAD!\pI had a look at your Battle Swap data.\pYou seem to have the right idea,
but you're still square in your head!\pListen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only
about reading books or doing desk work.\pJust doing that sort of thing…
It may as well be useless!\pYou have to experience things with
your heart and your body, understand?\pI'll take you on under the same
conditions as you.\pI'll be using rental POKéMON, too!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ShakeOutKnowledgeBringItOn

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandLetsSeeFrontierPass

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedKnowledgeSymbol

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred
text: Heh…\nYou're a pretty bright spark…\pNext time, I'll come after you hard.\nNo holds barred, understand?\pYou keep up your studies!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
text:
NOLAND: Hey, hey! How's it going?
You keeping up with your studies?\p…Oh?\pYou've taken on a harder look than
the last time I saw you.\pNow, this should be fun!
I'm getting excited, hey!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_AllRightBringItOn

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_OutOfMyLeagueLetsSeePass

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
text: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nSingle Tournament.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge
text: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap Single challenge?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
text:
The Battle Swap Single Tournament
is a SINGLE BATTLE competition using\lonly rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win seven times in\la row, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
text: We look forward to your next visit.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WillHoldMonsForSafekeeping

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_StepThisWay

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMonsSaveResults
text: Thank you for participating!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save the event results.\nPlease wait.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMons
text: I will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsSevenWins
text: Congratulations! You've won seven\nstraight Battle Swap matches!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePointsForStreak

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
text:
Hi!
You, there!\pAre you thinking that the events here
are easy since you don't need to have\la raised team of POKéMON?\pI wouldn't be too sure about winning
that easily.\pIf you don't have thorough knowledge
about POKéMON and their moves,\lit will be tough to keep winning.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_SwappedForWeakMon
text: I swapped for a weak POKéMON…\nI thought it was a good kind to have…\pThey wiped the floor with us…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentsMons
text: Things haven't been going my way\nat all.\pYou need to check your opponent's\nPOKéMON during battle to see if\lthey're any good.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CantFigureOutStaffHints
text: You know how the staff here give you\na few hints about your next opponent?\pWell, I'm a full-grown man, but I have\ntrouble figuring out their hints.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RentalMonsAreVaried
text: Like, I'm really tough, but I get bored\nreally easily, so I just kept swapping\land battling over and over.\pSo anyway, when I kept entering\nBattle Swap events, I noticed they\lvaried the rental POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
text: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
text: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
text: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the seventh TRAINER in the event.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules
text:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainOpenLvRules
text: In the Open Level, the rental POKéMON\nand the opposing TRAINERS' POKéMON\lare all Level 100.

boss, the FACTORY HEAD.\pHe says, “We're going to do it!
Come here right now!”

text: And now…\pBy winning consistently, you have\nearned the privilege of challenging\lour master, the PALACE MAVEN…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_AnnounceArrivalOfSpenser
text: Let great fanfare announce the arrival\nof the PALACE MAVEN, SPENSER!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro
text:
SPENSER: My physical being is with
POKéMON always!\pMy heart beats as one with
POKéMON always!\pYoung one of a TRAINER!
Do you believe in your POKéMON?\pCan you believe them through
and through?\pIf your bonds of trust are frail,
you will never beat my brethren!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ProveYourBondWithMons
text: The bond you share with your POKéMON!\nProve it to me here!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserPostSilverBattle
text: SPENSER: Gwahahah!\pHah, you never fell for my bluster!\nSorry for trying that stunt!\pHere!\nBring me the thing!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_LetsSeeFrontierPass
text: My, my, if only you could maintain that\nfacade of distinguished authority…\pHere!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedSpiritsSymbol
text: The Spirits Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserAwaitNextTime
text: SPENSER: Your POKéMON's eyes are \ntruly clear and unclouded.\pI will eagerly await the next\nopportunity to see you.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack
text:
SPENSER: Gwahahah!
You've battled your way up again?\pYou must have developed a truly
formidable bond with your POKéMON.\pSo be it!\pThis time, I won't bluster or hold back.
This time, there's no fooling around.\pReady now?
Prepare to lose!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_Kaaah
text: … … …Kaaah!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserYourTeamIsAdmirable
text: SPENSER: Well, that was some display!\nEven fully unleashed, my brethren\lcould not overpower you.\pYour team spirit is truly admirable!\pHere!\nBring me that thing, will you?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_HurryWithFrontierPass
text: My, my, if only you could maintain\na certain level of decorum…\pGaaah, here!\nHurry with that FRONTIER PASS, you!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpiritsSymbolTookGoldenShine
text: The Spirits Symbol took on\na golden shine!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserComeSeeMeAgain
text: SPENSER: Gwahahah!\pCome see me time and again!\nMy brethren and I will be waiting!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_PeopleAndMonAreSame
text: People and POKéMON, they are but\nthe same…\pTheir individual nature makes them\ngood at certain things, and not good\lat others.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_LetMonDoWhatItLikes
text: Rather than trying to make a POKéMON\ndo what it dislikes, try to let it do\lwhat it likes and is good at doing.\pPut yourself in the POKéMON's position\nand consider what moves it would like.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_MonDifferentWhenCornered
text: A POKéMON's nature is a remarkable\nthing…\pSome POKéMON behave in a completely\ndifferent way when they are cornered.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_BeginningToUnderstandNature
text: Are you beginning to understand how\na POKéMON's nature makes it behave?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_HeartfeltBondBetweenYouAndMons
text: Ah… I see a strong, heartfelt bond\nbetween you and your POKéMON…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
text: Where the hearts of TRAINERS\nare put to the test.\pI welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.\pI accept challenges to the SINGLE\nBATTLE HALLS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeSingleBattleChallenge
text: Do you wish to take\nthe SINGLE BATTLE HALL challenge?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
text:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for SINGLE BATTLES\lthat are named SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.\pThe SINGLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial\lrule that must be obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReturnWhenFortified

required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThese POKéMON must all be of
Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pCome back when you have made
your preparations.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FollowMe
text: Good.\nNow, follow me.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
text: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
text: To achieve a 7-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_BattlePointsFor7WinStreak

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
text:
For a hardy fellow like me,
hardy POKéMON are the best.\pOffense is the best defense!
A relentless attack is the ultimate!\pBut that's not what I wanted to chat
about.\pEvery so often a really cute lady
swings by here.\pShe says that she can tell what
POKéMON are thinking.\pI don't know about that part,
but she is really cute.\pHuh?
Why are you looking at me like that?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
text:
Hmm…\pIt appears that the nature of POKéMON
and the moves that they have been\ltaught are the keys to battle here.\pTo be more precise, it's how well
the moves match the nature of\lthe POKéMON.\pIf your POKéMON is in trouble and
unable to live up to its potential,\lyou may need to examine how well\lits moves match its nature.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
text: My POKéMON is usually very docile.\pBut when it's in a BATTLE HALL,\nit sometimes seems to become\ltransformed into something wicked!\pIt becomes totally intimidating.\nIt's shocking, even.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
text: I wonder what sort of nature a POKéMON\nwould have if it favored enfeebling its\lopponents and chipping away slowly.\pI'd be surprised if it was a LAX nature.\pBut, nah, that can't be right.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
text: Where the hearts of TRAINERS\nare put to the test.\pI welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.\pI accept challenges to the DOUBLE\nBATTLE HALLS.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeDoubleBattleChallenge
text: Do you wish to take\nthe DOUBLE BATTLE HALL challenge?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
text:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for DOUBLE BATTLES\lthat are named DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial\lrule that must be obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ToDefeatMavenAnd7Trainers

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
text: Here, POKéMON are required to think\nand battle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
text:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDue to its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
text:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
text:
When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
text: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
text:
Here we conduct an event we call
the Battle Choice.\pThe Battle Choice rules are very
simple…\pChoose one of three paths and make
your way to the goal room at the end\lof the BATTLE PIKE. It's that simple.\pHowever, what happens on the chosen
path depends entirely on the luck\lof the challenger…\pIf you reach the goal, you will be
rewarded with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please have a word with\lour staff in the big rooms on the way.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
text: Where the courage of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID!\pI am your guide to\nthe Battle Quest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_EmbarkOnChallenge
text: Have you the courage to embark on\nthe Battle Quest challenge?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_AwaitFutureChallenge
text: We await your challenge in the future!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
text:
The Battle Quest is a battling
event in which you must explore\lthe PYRAMID and try to reach the top.\pIn the PYRAMID are seven floors of
mazes, all of them filled with not only\lskilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.\pYou must enter with three POKéMON,
none of them holding an item.\pOn your ascent, you will be provided
with a BATTLE BAG for items.\pIf you fail in your challenge, any item
placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must select “REST”\land save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
text: The PYRAMID offers two courses,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich will you enter?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
text: Very good. Now, please select the three\nPOKéMON you wish to accompany you.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
text:
A slight problem, adventurer!\pYou seem to not have the three
POKéMON qualified for the challenge.\pPlease also remember to take all
items from your POKéMON.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you are ready, please have
a word with me.

text:
A slight problem, adventurer!\pYou seem to not have the three
POKéMON qualified for the challenge.\pThe three POKéMON must be different
and each no higher than Level 50.\pPlease also remember to take all
items from your POKéMON.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you are ready, please have
a word with me.

A major problem, explorer!\pYou did not save before ending
your challenge the last time.\pConsequently, your challenge has
been disqualified, I'm sorry to say.\pHere is the BAG we've been holding
for you.\p{PLAYER} got the BAG back.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveConqueredPyramid

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TellYouWhatMisfortunesAwait
text: Welcome…\pI shall be pleased to tell you what\nmisfortunes await in the PYRAMID…

text: I see a shower of sparks…\p…And in it, I see your POKéMON\nstruggling with paralysis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintExplosion

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BelieveMyFortunesOrNot

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
text: Did you know?\pIf you run fast, TRAINERS may notice\nand come after you for a battle.\pSo, if you want to avoid TRAINERS,\ndon't catch their eyes, but sneak\lcautiously and quietly past them.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
text: Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!\pI had a whole lot of items, but I lost\nthem all when I lost!\pAwaaaaaaarrrrgh!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
text: Welcome back!\nYou've done the unthinkable!\pYou've defeated the PYRAMID KING\nand conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_GiveYouTheseBattlePoints
text: Young explorer!\nIn commendation of your courage,\lwe give you these Battle Point(s)!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
text: When the PYRAMID is conquered,\nthe wild POKéMON that appear in it\lare replaced by different kinds.\pExplore, observe, and learn what kinds\nof wild POKéMON you may encounter.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
text:
TRAINERS are lying in wait for you
inside the PYRAMID.\pOn each floor, there are up to
eight TRAINERS.\pWhen you defeat a TRAINER, you will
get a helpful hint for your adventure.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
text:
The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange
themselves every time you enter it.\pThe mazes are poorly lit.
You must advance with caution.\pThe light grows brighter whenever you
defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
text:
The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG
while in the PYRAMID.\pThere are two separate BATTLE BAGS--
one each for the Level 50 and\lOpen Level adventures.\pThey each can hold up to 99 pieces
of ten kinds of items.\pThe contents of the BATTLE BAG are
lost if you fail in your quest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo
text:
It is a delight to see you here!
You have reached the summit of\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID!\pAbove here is the PYRAMID's
lookout point.\pIt is a place open only to those
who have conquered the PYRAMID.\pNow, please!
Up you go!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_PlayerConqueredPyramid
text: The PYRAMID's new conqueror!\nLet the name {PLAYER} be known!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
text:
It is a delight to see you here!\pUnfortunately, you were second by
a mere fraction of time!\pOur chief has already conquered
the PYRAMID ahead of you.\pHowever, my young explorer…
You are a TRAINER!\pAssert your power and take the glory
of the pinnacle from our chief!\pNow, please! When you are ready,
take one more step of courage!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
text: Young adventurer…\pWouldn't you agree that explorations\nare the grandest of adventures?\pYour own wits!\pYour own strength!\pYour own POKéMON!\pAnd, above all, only your own courage\nto lead you through unknown worlds…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
text:
Aah, yes, indeed this life is grand!
Grand, it is! Eh?\pI'm BRANDON!\pI'm the PYRAMID KING, which means
I'm in charge here.\pMost people call me the chief!\pYou coming here means you have
that much confidence in yourself,\lam I right?\pHahahah!
This should be exciting!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BringCourageToOurBattle
text: Now, then!\nBring your courage to our battle!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonFrontierPassPlease
text: BRANDON: Hahahah! Grand it was!\nGrand, yes, indeed!\pWell done! You've earned recognition!\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please!

BRANDON: …You've finally returned,
young explorer…\pYour love of adventure seems to come
deep from within your heart…\pYes… You are exactly as I was in
my own youth…\p… … …Ah…\pThe passionate!\pThe dangerous!\pThe desperate!\pThose days of death-defying,
life-affirming adventures are back…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
text:
Greetings…
My name is ANABEL.\pI am the SALON MAIDEN, and I am in
charge of running the BATTLE TOWER…\pI have heard several rumors
about you…\pIn all honesty, what I have heard does
not seem attractive in any way…\pThe reason I've come to see you…
Well, there is but one reason…

… … … … … …\pYou have confidence in your POKéMON
battling talent, don't you?\pI urge you to keep battling and
keep on winning.\pI will be waiting for you.
Until the next time we meet…

I won't have to hold back against you…\pIt's been too long now…\pToo long since I've been able to battle
without thinking about anything…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
text:
The BATTLE TOWER's SINGLE BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lSINGLE BATTLES with three POKéMON.\pThere are many SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS,
seven TRAINERS await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

The BATTLE TOWER's DOUBLE BATTLE

in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS,

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeMultiBattle

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeMultisChallenge

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultisChallenge
text:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES.\pFor MULTI BATTLES, you must partner
with a TRAINER in the TOWER and enter\lwith two POKéMON each.\pInside the TOWER is a room named
the BATTLE SALON where you may meet\lother TRAINERS.\pThere, you must find a TRAINER to act
as your partner in MULTI BATTLES.\pOnce you have partnered up, you will
be shown to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM.\pIn the MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeLinkMultisChallenge

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
text:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES with a friend.\pYou must link with your friend using
Wireless Adapters or a Game Boy\lAdvance Game Link cable.\pYou must partner with your friend and
enter two different kinds of POKéMON.\pThere are many MULTI BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn a MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await you and your friend\lto make a tag-team challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pPlease beware that unlike other ROOMS,
you may not interrupt your challenge.\pOnce you start, you must battle seven
MULTI BATTLES in a row nonstop.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
text:
The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where
four types of battles are waged--\lSINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI\lBATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE.\pFor each of these types, there are
separate BATTLE ROOMS.\pPlease speak with a guide offering
the type of battle you wish to enter.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
text:
Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are
entering, you will be required to take\la certain number of POKéMON.\pThe SINGLE BATTLE mode requires
three POKéMON.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four,
and the MULTI modes both require two.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
text:
The BATTLE SALON is where you must
find a partner to form a tag team for\lthe MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge.\pChoose the best partner for you by
examining other TRAINERS'\lPOKéMON and their moves.\pYou may choose a new tag partner
after winning seven straight matches.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
text:
The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two
friends to mount a challenge together.\pYou and your friend must be linked with
Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link\lcable.\pYou must choose two POKéMON at
the registration counter.\pThese POKéMON must be different
from those of your friend.\pYou may not interrupt this challenge
in the middle, unlike other modes.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
text:
For 70 years I have raised POKéMON!
I am the man they revere as\lthe legendary top POKéMON BREEDER!\pIf you ever become as seasoned as me,
you'll see the abilities of POKéMON\lat a glance.\pYou're a TRAINER. Doesn't it interest
you to know your own POKéMON's\labilities?\pHere!
Let's have a look at your POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_AverageAbility
text: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would describe\nas being of average ability.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BetterThanAverageAbility
text: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would describe as\nhaving better-than-average ability.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_ImpressiveAbility
text: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would say is\nquite impressive in ability!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_OutstandingAbility
text: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would say is\nwonderfully outstanding in ability!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectHP
text: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its HP…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectAtk
text: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its ATTACK…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectDef
text: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its DEFENSE…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpAtk
text: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its SPECIAL ATTACK…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpDef
text: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its SPECIAL DEFENSE…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpeed
text: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its SPEED…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatRelativelyGood
text: That stat is relatively good.\n…Hm… That's how I call it.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatImpressive
text: That stat is quite impressive.\n…Hm… That's how I call it.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatOutstanding
text: That stat is outstanding!\n…Hm… That's how I call it.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatFlawless
text: It's flawless! A thing of perfection!\n…Hm… That's how I call it.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_NoTimeForMyAdvice
text: What?\nYou have no time for my advice?\pYou should always be eager to learn\nfrom the experiences of your elders!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_HaveBusinessNeedsTending
text: Yes, what is it now?\pI have business that needs tending!\nSave it for next time!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_LetsLookAtYourPokemon
text: Ah, youngster! Do your POKéMON's\nabilities intrigue you?\pHere, here!\nLet's have a look at your POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvenICantTell
text: An expert I am, but even I can't tell\nanything about an unhatched POKéMON!\pShow me a POKéMON!\nA POKéMON is what I need to see!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_SaidMyMonIsOutstanding
text: He said my POKéMON is outstanding!\nI'm glad I raised it carefully!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_DidntDoAnythingSpecialRaisingIt
text: He said my POKéMON is outstanding!\nBut I didn't do anything special\lraising it…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FrontierManiacIntro
text:
Howdy! When it comes to news about
the BATTLE FRONTIER, I'm no. 1.\pYou can think of me as
the FRONTIER MANIAC.\pJust checking, but you are a TRAINER,
isn't that right?\pI'll happily share the hottest news
I gathered about the BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SwingByForTheLatestWord
text: Howdy! Did you swing by to grill me\nabout the latest word? Oh, all right!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MyInformationsBeenUsefulRight
text: Well? Well? Well?\pI'm sure my information's been\nseriously useful to you, right?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FacilityIsHottest
text: Let's see now…\pIt sounds like the {STR_VAR_1}\nis the hottest place going.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_BattleTowerIsHottest
text: Let's see now…\pIt sounds like BATTLE TOWER\n{STR_VAR_1} is the hottest.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenIsThere
text: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this mysterious TRAINER called\nthe SALON MAIDEN that runs the place.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenSilverMons
text: Have you battled the SALON MAIDEN?\pWhen she's measuring up her opponent,\nshe apparently uses these POKéMON:\pA PSYCHIC-type PSI POKéMON,\na FIRE-type VOLCANO POKéMON,\land a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenGoldMons
text:
Have you battled the SALON MAIDEN
when she's serious?\pWhen she's battling flat out,
she apparently uses these POKéMON:\pA DRAGON & PSYCHIC EON POKéMON,
an ELECTRIC-type THUNDER POKéMON,\land a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceIsThere
text: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this flamboyant TRAINER called\nthe DOME ACE that runs the place.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceSilverMons
text: Have you battled the DOME ACE?\pWhen he's treating the opponent\nlightly, he uses these three POKéMON:\pA DRAGON & FLYING DRAGON POKéMON,\na WATER & GROUND MUD FISH POKéMON,\land a FIRE & FLYING FLAME POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceGoldMons
text:
Have you battled the DOME ACE
when he's serious?\pWhen he's demonstrating his strategy,
he uses these three POKéMON:\pA DRAGON & FLYING EON POKéMON,
a WATER & GROUND MUD FISH POKéMON,\land a STEEL- & PSYCHIC-type IRON LEG\lPOKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadIsThere
text: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this freaky TRAINER called\nthe FACTORY HEAD that runs the place.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadSilverMons
text:
Have you battled the FACTORY HEAD
already?\pLet me think… When he goes to battle,
he just gets three rental POKéMON.\pHe battles under pretty much the same
conditions as you.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadGoldMons
text:

when he's serious?\pWhen he goes seriously to battle,

conditions as you.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenIsThere

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice1
text:
Sure, there are several places where
you can enter DOUBLE BATTLES.\pBut the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS of
the BATTLE TOWER are, like, basic!\pThey're where you should learn about
how DOUBLE BATTLES are played here\lin the BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice2
text: Watch yourself in the battles here.\pI hear there are TRAINERS that have\nstrategies they developed just for\lDOUBLE BATTLES.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice3
text: Once you're confident and comfortable\nwith DOUBLE BATTLES here, you should\lthink about challenging other places\loffering DOUBLE BATTLES.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MultiBattleAdvice
text: All sorts of TRAINERS gather in\nthe BATTLE SALON.\pJust think--you may run into your\nfriends or followers!\lYou should look carefully!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_LinkMultiBattleAdvice
text: If you're with a friend, head for the\nLINK MULTI BATTLE ROOM.\pIf you play with a strong friend,\nyou can expect to see tough foes!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_NewsGatheringPower
text: What amazing news-gathering power!\nMy mentor's like none other!

text: What amazing powers of observation!\nMy mentor's like none other!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_AmazingPowerOfPersuasion
text: What amazing power of persuasion!\nMy mentor's like none other!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ThisPlaceIsScaringMe
text: …What is this place?\nIt's scaring me…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_CantYouSeeWereBusyHere
text: …What's that you want?\pCan't you see we're kind of busy here?\nCan't your business wait till later?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
text:
…Huh?
You look to me like a tough TRAINER.\pHeheh…
Listen, I have this proposition.\pWe have a little group going here,
and we play a little game with what\lgoes on in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThe rules are really simple.\pFirst, we pick one of the facilities
in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThen, we each pick a different TRAINER
who's taking that facility's challenge,\land bet with our Battle Points.\pThe guy who bet on the TRAINER with
the best record takes all the Battle\lPoints in the pool.\pSounds simple, huh?
So, anyway…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HowAboutEnteringEventForMe
text: I'll see to it that you benefit, too.\nSo how about it?\lHow about entering that event for me?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_SpotMeSomeBattlePoints
text: All right, that's perfect.\nSo, uh… How about spotting me some\lof your Battle Points?\pTrust me, I'll show you my gratitude\nafterward.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HowMuchCanYouSpot
text: Great, great!\nSo, how much can you spot me?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouDontHaveEnoughPoints
text: Oh, no, no, no!\nYou don't have enough Battle Points!\pI wish you wouldn't monkey around and\nwaste everyone's time!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThanksOffYouGo
text: Heheh! Thanks much!\nSo, off you go!
