label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NiceTryCantReturnPoints
text:
Oh, it's you…
Nice try…\pI hate to break it to you, but I can't
return your Battle Points…\pI guess we'll have to let it motivate
us to try harder next time!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HelloChampHeresYourPoints
text:
Oh, yes!
Hello there, champ!\pI knew you could!
I knew you would!\lWe're both big winners!\pI'll return your Battle Points and,
of course, a little extra from me!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ObtainedBattlePoints
text: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_1} Battle Points.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThinkOfMeForAnotherChallenge
text: If you're up for another challenge,\nplease do think of me!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NotInterested
text: Not interested?! You shouldn't be\nso afraid to take a chance!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_Oh
text: Oh…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_BackedWrongTrainer
text: I backed the wrong TRAINER again!\pMaybe I should be battling normally\nlike everyone else…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_TrainerGoodButRattled
text: That TRAINER…\pHe's good, but he gets rattled too\neasily to survive the BATTLE DOME…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_KnowWinnerWhenISeeOne
text: Giggle!\nI know a winner when I see one!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ShouldBeTakingChallenges
text: Those TRAINERS…\nWhat are they doing?\lThey should be taking challenges.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_WonderIfInterviewsAiring
text: I wonder if they'll be airing interviews\nwith tough TRAINERS today?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_IfIOpenedRestaurantHere
text: If I opened a restaurant here,\nit'd make money for sure.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_NeedBreatherAfterBattles
text: Whew…\pI need to take a breather after\nsome intense battles…\pBut even now, I never take a break\nfrom plotting strategy and combos.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlGreeting
text: Ehehe!\nI can tell what POKéMON are thinking!\pPlease!\nCan I see your POKéMON?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlNoneShown
text: Boo!\nCheapie!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAttackHighAttackLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nIt will battle even if it has a lot\lof ouchies!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAttackHighDefenseLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will worry about itself!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAttackHighSupportLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDefenseHighAttackLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will hit back!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDefenseHighDefenseLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nIt says it worries about itself whether\lor not it has a lot of ouchies!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDefenseHighSupportLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSupportHighAttackLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will hit back!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSupportHighDefenseLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will worry about itself!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSupportHighSupportLow
text: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nIt says it likes to be sneaky even\lif it has a lot of ouchies!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlEgg
text: That's silly! An EGG is asleep!\nI can't talk to it!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_LadyClaimsSheUnderstandsPokemon
text: How charming!\nThat little lady claims she can\lunderstand POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlSayingSomethingProfound
text: I have this feeling that the little girl\nis saying something profound.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtRedHouseALot
text: I know something!\pThat little girl plays at the red house\na lot!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
text:
My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}.
Do you know it?\lIt's quite cute and rather nice.\pThis little one, I could trade with
pride!\pWould you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
text: Oh, it's adorable!\nThank you!\lI promise I'll be good to it!\pOh! I hope you'll be good to\nmy {STR_VAR_2}, too!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_DontTradeForAnythingButMon
text: Oh, I'm sorry!\nI don't intend to trade for anything\lbut a {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFineToo
text: Oh, you won't?\nWell, that's fine, too.\lPlease come visit us again.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuchCuterThanImagined
text: Giggle!\nA SKITTY is so much cuter than I had\limagined. I'm delighted!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
text:
Buhahaha!\pYou couldn't tell it from looking now,
but I used to be one tough TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the toughest
BEAUTY around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat is it now?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that blowhard woman over
there. I'm actually talented!\pLet me prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON special and\lyet cute moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
text: Buhahaha!\pAre you back to learn special and\nyet cute POKéMON moves?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove
text: Fine, fine, look here!\nWhich move should I teach?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXBattlePoints
text: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToWhichMon
text: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON\nI should teach the move to.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEnoughPoints
text: What the…\nYou haven't got enough Battle Points!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattlePoints
text: Do you see how skilled I am now?\nI'll take your Battle Points, thanks!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
text: What's that?\nYou don't want to…\pIf you want to see how skilled I am,\nyou come see me anytime!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
text:
Ihihihi!\pI know it's hard to see now, but I used
to be one fantastic TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the most
invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat's wrong?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that buffoonish woman over
there. I'm actually experienced!\pI can prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON hard and\lyet pretty moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
text: Ihihihi!\pHave you come to learn hard and\nyet pretty POKéMON moves?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
text: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth\neach other, you probably think that\lthey don't get along.\pBut if that were true, they wouldn't\nstay out here together, would they?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
text:
When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER,
those ladies were strong and beautiful.\pThey were idols among us TRAINERS.\pEven now, age hasn't dulled their
abilities.\pIn fact, their POKéMON moves have
grown even more polished.\pBut… For some reason, I can't help
but feel this…\pTime is so cruel…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SoftboiledDesc
text: Recovers up to\nhalf the user's\nmaximum HP.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossDesc
text: Inflicts damage\nidentical to the\nuser's level.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDesc
text: Recovers half the\ndamage inflicted\non a sleeping foe.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDesc
text: A strong punch\nthrown with\nincredible power.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc
text: An extremely\npowerful kick with\nintense force.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc
text: A full-body slam\nthat may cause\nparalysis.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDesc
text: Large boulders\nare hurled. May\ncause flinching.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc
text: Retaliates any\nphysical hit with\ndouble the power.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc
text: A weak jolt of\nelectricity that\nparalyzes the foe.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc
text: A fighting dance\nthat sharply\nraises ATTACK.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc
text: Curls up to con-\nceal weak spots\nand raise DEFENSE.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc
text: A loud attack\nthat can be used\nonly while asleep.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc
text: Hurls mud in the\nfoe's face to re-\nduce its accuracy.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc
text: Sprays star-\nshaped rays\nthat never miss.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc
text: A chilling attack\nthat lowers the\nfoe's SPEED.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc
text: Endures any at-\ntack for 1 turn,\nleaving 1HP.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc
text: Copies the foe's\neffect(s) and\ngives to the user.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc
text: An icy punch\nthat may\nfreeze the foe.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunchDesc
text: An electrified\npunch that may\nparalyze the foe.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDesc
text: A fiery punch\nthat may burn\nthe foe.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
text:
What a TRAINER needs…\pKnowledge…
Strategy…\lLuck…\lGuts…\lSpirit…\lBravery…\lAnd ability…\pWell, I'm all set in every way!
I'll be unstoppable at every building!\pHuh? POKéMON?
What's that?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
text: Do you know about the FRONTIER\nBRAINS?\pThat's what SCOTT calls the seven\nspecial TRAINERS that run the seven\lfacilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
text: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl\ntold me that I have a lot of talent\lfor battling!\pI like POKéMON CONTESTS more!\pBut I'm no good at CONTESTS!\pI guess having talent and liking\nsomething aren't the same.

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson
text: We came here to chaperon our\ngrandson.\pBut since we're here, we thought\nwe should get some souvenirs.

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift
text: Dear, what do you think of this?\nWouldn't this make a nice gift?\pIt's…PRO…TE…IN?\nIt sounds delicious, doesn't it?

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems
text: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's\nfacilities don't allow the use of items\lduring battles.\pThat rule makes things tougher than\nthey already are!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign
text: This is the BATTLE TOWER!\nKeep the win streak as the toughest\lTRAINER!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign
text: This is the BATTLE PALACE!\nKeep your eyes on POKéMON battles!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign
text: This is the BATTLE ARENA!\nLet the toughest teams gather!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign
text: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!\nAdvance through the Battle Quest!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign
text: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL\nSet your sights on new records!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign
text: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER\nExchange your Battle Points!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
text: Wow!\nIt's huge!\pThe BATTLE TOWER feels special.\nIt's different from the others.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
text: My grand ambition is to conquer both\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON\lLEAGUE.\pAnd if my dream comes true…\pI… I'm going to ask MIMI next door\nif she will be friends with me!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
text: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, maybe I can\nclimb the outside…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
text: I thrive in darkness…\nYes… What is worthy of me?\lNone other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…\pWhat say you to wandering in darkness\nand in utter and total desperation?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
text: I didn't sleep for a week, but then\nI put together the ultimate team!\pI can't see myself losing, no joke.\nWe're storming the BATTLE ARENA!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
text:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?\pIt sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…\pI've never seen him battling in person
ever.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
text: ZIGG!\nI believe in you, little buddy!\pI'll make my little ZIGG any favorite\ntasty treats you like if you win!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant
text: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
text:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.\pYour hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!\lOops, it's almost dinnertime!\pI don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
text: I may not look that impressive now,\nbut I once beat a GYM LEADER.\pWho knows, maybe I should give it\nanother shot at glory.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
text: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for\nthe way I battle, too.\pI win matches in the blink of\nan eye!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon
text: I'm better than my daddy\nat POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
text: Go on, my baby sweetie!\nGo rack up some wins for Daddy!\pYou're just like your mother,\nso you'll be dominating!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
text:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout\lpretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.\pInstead of her, do you know what
I found?\pA whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
text: I sometimes see this really important-\nlooking old man going in there.\pHe has these really awesome POKéMON.\nHe seems really nice, though.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
text:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?\pWhen there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,\lthere shall appear a man among men.\pDon't know that legend?
Well, of course not!\lI just made it up!\pWhat's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
text:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!\pBut I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!\pAnd then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
text: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
text: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
text: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou
text: With you by my side, I can do anything.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
text:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
text:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
text: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
text: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you a good memory?\pI have this feeling there once was\nan odd tree past here.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
text:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign
text: This is the BATTLE DOME!\nYour path to the invincible superstar!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign
text: This is the BATTLE FACTORY!\nSeek out the toughest POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign
text: This is the BATTLE PIKE!\nChoose one of three paths!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
text: This is the BATTLE TOWER.\pTRAINERS bring their best-raised\nPOKéMON for elimination-style matches.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
text: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
text: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs
text: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs
text: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime
text: Please sail with us another time!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
text: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo
text: Then, where would you like to go?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends
text: I'm the best out of all my friends.\nBut here…\lI've been useless!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
text: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER,\nbut I can't find it even though I have\la map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis place is just too big!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
text: I wanted to take a challenge as soon\nas I arrived here.\pBut on the way, I got seasick…\nUrrrrp…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
text:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?\pOnly those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.\pThat's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
text: Hey, bro…\pAre you sure we can make challenges\neven if we don't have any POKéMON?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
text: Uh…\nI'm sure it'll be okay.\pI think…\pBut remember that big scary guy?\nHe said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
text: That's the BATTLE FACTORY.\nYou can rent strong POKéMON there.\pBut it makes me wonder.\nWho's raising those rental POKéMON?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
text: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE\nPIKE because of SEVIPER…\pB-but I came all the way here, so I will\ntry to conquer everything!\l…Shudder…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors
text: Let's play rock, paper, scissors!\nOne, two, three!\p… … … … … …

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge
text: Yay! I won!\nI will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
text: Oh, no…\nI lost.\pI guess I'm not very lucky today.\nI'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge\luntil tomorrow.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
text: I believe I'm the only person here who,\nfor some unknown reason, would choose\lfishing over battling.\pHuh? You can't catch anything here?\nThat's disappointing…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol
text: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no\nmatter what, until I get a Symbol.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
text: Oh? You're off to challenge\nthe BATTLE DOME?\pI'll wish you the best of luck.\nLet us both win our way up and meet\lin challenges.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa
text: Grandpa, over here!\nThe BATTLE DOME is here!\lGo get 'em, Grandpa!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
text: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?\nI won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!\pBut where is the entrance?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
text: There used to be nothing here not all\nthat long ago.\pBut, now look at this place! Amazing!\nI'll bring my mother out to see this.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
text: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER!\pI'm sure to grab attention with\nmy looks and ability!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
text: Munch, munch…\pIt looks like this square's filled with\ntough people.\pMunch, munch…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
text:
Crunch, munch…\pA while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.\pShe had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.\pCrunch, munch…\pShe got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.\pIt was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.\pCrunch, munch…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
text: Huh? Will you listen to yourself?\nThat's nothing!\pWhy, the last time I cheered for him,\nour eyes met and sparks flew!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
text:
Whaaaaaat?!
Pfft!\pThat only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!\pThe DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
text:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!\pYou fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!\pThe DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
text:
Those people squabbling over there…\pIt's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.\pThey used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.\pBut they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.\pThey were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.\pNow they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the\lBATTLE DOME every day now.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
text: I heard a rumor that someone saw\na POKéMON with an unusually long tail\lsomewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pIt must be adorable. I'm sure of it…\pOh, challenges can wait. I feel driven\nto find the delightful creature!

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon
text:
There was someone here using a 
POKéMON I've never seen before.\pI never learned about it at
TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.\pI wonder where you can catch POKéMON
like that.

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NextStopBattleArena
text: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA!\nI'd better get the right POKéMON from\lthe PC Storage System.

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoingThroughEveryChallenge
text: Giggle… I'm going to go through every\nchallenge with just this baby!

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Mya myaaah!

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
text: This is the RANKING HALL.\pThis is where we recognize the immortal\nTRAINERS who left great records in\lBATTLE FRONTIER events.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePikeFactoryRecords
text: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE,\nand BATTLE FACTORY Records

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceArenaPyramidRecords
text: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA,\nand BATTLE PYRAMID Records

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNameOnThisList
text: Hi, is your name on this list?

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThatsSuper
text: Wow, that's super!\nI'll have to try harder, too!

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
text: Oh, is that right?\pIf you saw your friend's name up here,\nI bet it would make you work harder!

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
text: Hmm…\nMy name's not up there…\pWell, it's only natural since I haven't\ntaken any challenges yet.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstTimeHereThisWay
text: Is it your first time here?\nPlease step this way!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
text: The front lines of POKéMON battling!\nWelcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
text: For a first-time visitor, we issue\nthe FRONTIER PASS.\pIt's for use at all the facilities\nin the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHere you are!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ObtainedFrontierPass
text: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe FRONTIER PASS.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_PlacedTrainerCardInFrontierPass
text: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD\nin the FRONTIER PASS.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyBattleFrontier
text: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE\nFRONTIER has to offer!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIsntPlayerYouCame
text: ???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou came out here!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrScottGoodDay
text: GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir!\nGood day to you, sir!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
text:
SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!\pI hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.\pNaturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.\pI also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFacilities
text: I'm your guide to the various facilities\nhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich2
text: Which would you like to learn about?

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo
text: It is the gigantic tower considered\nto be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.\pThere are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS\nin the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,\land LINK MULTI BATTLES.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
text:
The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.\pEvents named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.\pThe Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo
text: The BATTLE PALACE is the red building\non the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThere are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS\nfor SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo
text: The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like\nbuilding at the center-right of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Set KO Tourney\ntakes place at the BATTLE ARENA.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
text:
The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.\pAn event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.\pThe Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo
text: The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped\nlike a POKéMON at the center-left of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Battle Choice\nis conducted there.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo
text: The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous\npyramid.\pAn event called the Battle Quest\nis conducted there.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo
text: The RANKING HALL is located near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThere, you may see the most fantastic\nrecords left by the TRAINERS that\ltook on the many challenges of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo
text: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThe Battle Points you have earned in\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged\lfor fabulous prizes there.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToRules
text: I'm your guide to the basic rules that\nare common to all the challenges\loffered by the facilities in the BATTLE\lFRONTIER.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhat
text: What would you like to learn about?

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelModeInfo
text: All the challenges at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER's facilities come in\ltwo courses--Level 50 and Open Level.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
text:
The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.\pPlease keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any\lPOKéMON below Level 50.\pThis course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTo begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
text:
The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering\lchallenges.\pThe levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of\lyour POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
text:
Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.\pEGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.\pThe numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.\pAt all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not\lpermitted.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo
text: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE\nFRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not\lbe holding the same kind of item.\pPlease make sure that all POKéMON\nentering a challenge are holding\ldifferent items.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFrontierPass
text: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich1
text: Which would you like to learn about?

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
text:
There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with\lsymbols from each of the facilities.\pTo earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,\land may need to win events repeatedly.\pIt's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
text:
It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.\pYou may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.\pOr you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding\lmatches at the BATTLE PIKE or\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID.\pYou may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo
text: Battle Points are rewards given to\nTRAINERS who battled outstandingly\lat the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pYou may trade in your Battle Points\nfor prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE\lCORNER.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
text:
SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome!
Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.\pAnyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally
welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis is my dream come true.
It took me years and years, but I've\lfinally given shape to my dream.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
text:
On reflection, it was a terribly long
journey…\pI left home alone on a quest to find
strong TRAINERS.\pNo one can imagine how much effort
or time it took to make this real.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
text:
But that's all in the past.
No point dwelling on that!\pAll I want for you is to enjoy battling
to your heart's content here.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this
as a memento for all the time our\lpaths crossed on our journeys.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints
text: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
text:
SCOTT: You can check your Battle
Points on your FRONTIER PASS.\pThe more success you have here at
the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle\lPoints you will collect.\pUse your Battle Points the way you
see fit, like trading them for items.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingGreatThings
text: I'm expecting great things from you!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
text:
SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual.
They all lead lives of their own.\pBut when they're in a battle,
it doesn't matter who they are.\pThey're all the same!\pI love the purity of battle,
where everyone is equal.\pThat's why I go everywhere seeking
TRAINERS who are serious about\lbattling, and invite them here.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
text:
SCOTT: Have you met any of
the FRONTIER BRAINS?\pBetter yet, have you obtained any
symbols from them?\pI handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS
as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.\pBut I'm sure that seeing how tough
you are will startle even them!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
text:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?\pI think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.\pWell, guess what?\pYou may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…\lFufufu!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
text:
SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?\p…Wait a second…
Oh!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set\lof silver symbols!\pThat's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!\pNormally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!\pI want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
text:
SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set\lof gold symbols!\pThat's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!\p… … … … … …\p{PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!\pI think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere
text: I must say I have the gift of knowing\na good TRAINER when I see one.\pI'm so glad I had the foresight to\nbring you here!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPocketStuffed
text: Your BERRY POCKET seems to\nbe stuffed.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow
text: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!\nHow you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's fantastic!\nI want you to have this!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow
text: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!\nHow you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's ridiculously spectacular!\nYou've got to have this!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingToHearEvenGreaterThings
text: I'll be expecting to hear even greater\nthings about you now!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBackForThisLater
text: Oops, well, if you have too much\nstuff, come back for this later.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
text:
Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}?
I've heard tales of your exploits.\pMy name is WALLACE.\pI was once the GYM LEADER of
SOOTOPOLIS, but something came up.\pSo now, I've entrusted my mentor JUAN
with the GYM's operation.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pGROUDON and KYOGRE, the two POKéMON
wreaking havoc here, are considered\lto be super-ancient POKéMON.\pBut there aren't just two super-
ancient POKéMON.\pThere is one more somewhere.\pSomewhere, there is a super-
ancient POKéMON named RAYQUAZA.\pIt's said that it was RAYQUAZA that
becalmed the two combatants in\lthe distant past.\pBut even I have no clue as to
RAYQUAZA's whereabouts…

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, do you perhaps\nknow where RAYQUAZA is now?\pIf you do, please tell me.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
text: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN?\pBut that's right here!\nI need you to do better than that!\pPlease, I need you to think about\nwhere RAYQUAZA might be right now.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
text:
WALLACE: MT. PYRE?\pBut when I met the old lady there
earlier, she made no mention of it.\pI very much doubt that the old lady
would try to hide something from me…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this
more carefully for me?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
text: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember?\nHmm… That's a problem…\pCan't you remember somehow?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
text: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR?\pThat's it!\nIt must be the SKY PILLAR!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, there's not a moment to lose!\nWe'll head to the SKY PILLAR right away!

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_PokeCenterSign
text: POKEMON CENTER

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_MartSign
text: POKEMON MART

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentSign
text: GUIDE GENT'S HOUSE\nNew TRAINERS welcome

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_TownSign
text: CHERRYGROVE CITY\nFresh sea air and\nfriendly roads

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_TourIntro
text: New in CHERRYGROVE?\nI'll show you the basics.

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_TourStart
text: Keep this road in mind.\pWest goes back to NEW BARK,\nand north leads deeper into\lJOHTO.

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_TourMart
text: The MART is where you stock\nup before the next route.\pPOKE BALLS, POTIONS, and\nstatus cures save trips back.

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_TourCenter
text: The POKEMON CENTER is open\nday and night.\pHeal up whenever your team\nstarts looking tired.

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_TourRoads
text: That's the town.\pBefore you go, I'll add a\nMAP app to your POKéLINK.

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_InstalledMapApp
text: MAP app unlocked!\pIt shows towns, routes, and\nhow the roads connect.

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_AlreadyInstalledMapApp
text: That MAP app will keep you\nfrom losing your way.

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_FlowerWoman
text: BERRIES grow back after\nsome time.\pPick them when you can,\nbut come back later.

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_RunningGirl
text: I know every shortcut\nbetween the MART and the\lPOKEMON CENTER.

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_ShoreFisher
text: The tide leaves tiny\ntreasures in the sand.\pCheck the shore closely\nwhen you pass by.

label: DebugRoom_Text_MewtwoOffer
text: Create a level 85 MEWTWO\nfor this save file?

label: DebugRoom_Text_PartyFull
text: Your party is full.\nMake room before receiving\lthe debug MEWTWO.

label: DebugRoom_Text_MewtwoGiven
text: MEWTWO joined your party.

label: DebugRoom_Text_MewtwoReceived
text: The debug MEWTWO has already\nbeen received on this save.

text: Restock debug supplies and\nset money to maximum?

text: Supplies and money restored.

text: Money was restored.\pSome supplies could not be\nadded because a pocket was full.

text: Unlock every POKéLINK app?

label: DebugRoom_Text_PokeLinkDone
text: Every registered POKéLINK app\nis now unlocked.

text: Mark every available Fly\ndestination as visited?

label: DebugRoom_Text_FlyDone
text: Available Fly destinations\nwere marked as visited.

text: Warp to NEW BARK TOWN?

label: DebugRoom_Text_ExitPallet
text: Warp to PALLET TOWN?

label: DebugRoom_Text_ExitLittleroot
text: Warp to LITTLEROOT TOWN?

label: DebugRoom_Text_Sign
text: TRISKELION DEBUG ROOM\pThe door returns to NEW BARK.\pTalk to the exit guides for\nNEW BARK, PALLET, or LITTLEROOT.

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundRootFossil
text: {PLAYER} found the ROOT FOSSIL.

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundClawFossil
text: {PLAYER} found the CLAW FOSSIL.

label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
text: DEWFORD is a tiny island community.\nIf something gets trendy here,\leveryone picks up on it right away.

label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
text: DEWFORD TOWN\n“A tiny island in the blue sea.”

label: DewfordTown_Text_GymSign
text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BRAWLY\l“A big wave in fighting!”

label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
text: DEWFORD HALL\n“Everyone's information exchange!”

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD.\pI suppose you're off to deliver that\nLETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
text: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your\nLETTER?\pOr were you meaning to sail back to\nPETALBURG?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
text: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting
text: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe LETTER. I'll be waiting.

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
text: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
text: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
text: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

label: DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedToSetSail
text: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish
text: This is a renowned fishing spot.\nAre you getting the itch to fish?

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
text: I hear you, and I like what\nyou're saying!\pI'll give you one of my fishing RODS.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
text:
And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw
in a little fishing advice!\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen
text: Oh, is that so?\nThat's too bad, then.

label: DewfordTown_Text_HowsYourFishing
text: Yo!\nHow's your fishing?

label: DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes
text: Is that right! That's great!\nHaul in some big ones!

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
text:
Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself!
I'll give you a little fishing advice.\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
text:
I like what's hip, happening, and trendy.
I'm always checking it out.\pListen, have you heard about this new
“{STR_VAR_1}”?\pThat's right!
Of course you know!\pI mean, sheesh,
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIt's the hottest thing in cool!\pWherever you're from,
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis the biggest happening thing, right?

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
text: Hunh?\nIt's not the hip and happening thing?\pWell, hey, you have to tell me,\nwhat's new and what's “in”?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
text:
Hunh?
“{STR_VAR_2}”?\p… …\p…Uh… Yeah! That's right!
Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!\pOf course I know about that!
“{STR_VAR_2},” right?\pYeah, that's it, it's there!
Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}”\lthe coolest, or what?\pIt's the hippest thing in hip.
You think I'd not know about it?\p“{STR_VAR_1}”…
It's, like, so five minutes ago.\pNow, “{STR_VAR_2}” is
what's vital and in tune with the times!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
text: Hmm…\n“{STR_VAR_2},” huh?\pBut personally, I think\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis what's real in cool.

label: DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShareWithMe
text: Well, if you hear of any happening new\ntrends, come share them with me, okay?

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
text: Yeah, absolutely right!\p“{STR_VAR_1}” is the\ndefinition of “in” right now.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pDEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands
FIGHTING-type POKéMON.\pGoing against him with NORMAL-type
POKéMON is asking for trouble.\pFIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious
smack down on NORMAL POKéMON,\lso be careful!\pWhat's worse, the GYM is as dark as
the ocean floor.\pBut it will get brighter after defeating
the TRAINERS in your way.\pHey, okay, go for it!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!\pYour future is bright, too!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro
text: Might is right!\nCome on!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoDefeat
text: Not enough power…

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle
text: Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
text: There's no need for BRAWLY to be\ninvolved!\pI'll crush you!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat
text: But… How?\nHow could I lose so easily?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
text: I'm not going to waste this loss.\nI'll use it to motivate me to train!\pOne day I'll become a GYM LEADER…\pNo, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro
text: Don't you dare brush me off!\nIt's not my fault if you cry!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat
text: Waaaaaaah!\nI lost!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
text: I battle in the dark to make my heart\nstronger.\pBut because it's so dark, I can never\nsee BRAWLY's face…

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro
text: Ufufu…\nAre you stumbling around in the dark?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat
text: Oh, you…\nI don't want to know you!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle
text: You deserve to stay lost and end up\nback at the entrance again!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro
text: I'll show you the gumption of\na sailing man!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat
text: How'd this happen?\nIt's not like me to lose this way!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle
text: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing\nour GYM LEADER.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro
text: If you mean to pass, it has to be\nthrough me!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat
text: Grrrrr!\nVastly overpowered!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle
text: You win!\nGo after that BADGE!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
text:
I'm BRAWLY!
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!\pI've been churned in the rough waves
of these parts, and I've grown tough\lin the pitch-black cave!\pSo you wanted to challenge me?
Let me see what you're made of!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
text: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger\nsplash than I expected!\pYou swamped me!\pOkay, you've got me.\nTake this GYM BADGE!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE\nfrom BRAWLY.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
text:
The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON
up to Level 30, even those you get in\ltrades, obey without question.\pAnd, you'll be able to use the HM move
FLASH outside of battle.\pIf you'd like, use this TECHNICAL
MACHINE, too.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
text: That TM08 contains BULK UP.\pIt's a move that raises both ATTACK\nand DEFENSE stats.\p… … … … … …

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly
text: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY\nin the POKéNAV.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle
text: I can see your talent becoming a giant\nwave to cause a storm of astonishment\lamong TRAINERS one day!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\pBRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
text:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pShow me how much higher
you've gone!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchDefeat
text: Wow!\nSwamped again!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch
text: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep.\nYou can't see the bottom.\lIt's just like the sea of HOENN!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pOh? You only have one POKéMON
that can battle.\pI'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back
with at least two POKéMON.

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CantImagineLifeWithoutTrend
text: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pI can't imagine what life would be like\nwithout “{STR_VAR_1}”!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GettingBoredOfTrend
text: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pBut I'm getting kind of bored with it.\pI should look for the next big thing.

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TeachingMonAboutTrend
text: I'm teaching my POKéMON about\n“{STR_VAR_1},”\lbut it's not going well.\pIt's a bit too much, I think.

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_DeepLinkBetweenXAndY
text: I'm studying up on the hip and trendy\n“{STR_VAR_1}” now.\pIs it true that there's a deep link\nbetween “{STR_VAR_1}”\land “{STR_VAR_2}”?

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_MyHunchWasRight
text: Oh!\nSo, my hunch was right!\pI'm one step closer to being hip and\nhappening, yowza!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NotEasyToKeepUp
text: What?!\nIs that so?!\pIt's not easy for an older fellow like\nme to keep up with trends!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TVShowAboutTrend
text: This whole business about\n“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIsn't there a TV show on it?

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IsTrendMorePopularAcrossSea
text: Across the sea…\pIs “{STR_VAR_1}”\neven more popular?

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CollectTrendMerchandise
text:
I collect official
“{STR_VAR_1}”\llicensed merchandise.\pI have official
“{STR_VAR_1}” DOLLS…\pOfficial “{STR_VAR_1}”
brand clothing…\pAnd officially licensed
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lpicture books.\pHeheh, I own!
I'm not sharing anything with you!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BooksAboutTrend
text:
IDENTIFYING GOOD
“{STR_VAR_1}” &\lBAD “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pTHE LINK BETWEEN
“{STR_VAR_1}” AND\lPOKéMON…\pUSEFUL
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\pIt's neatly jammed with books about
“{STR_VAR_1}.”

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsScream
text: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSCREAM” is the title.

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsSmile
text: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSMILE” is the title.

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LastTrend
text: It's titled “THE LAST\n{STR_VAR_1}”.

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BirthOfTrend
text: It's titled “THE BIRTH OF\n{STR_VAR_1}”.

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_SawTrendCoolestThing
text: I saw “{STR_VAR_1}”!\nCool, huh?\pIt's, like, the coolest thing going!\pIt was awesome!\nIt was the real thing, oh yeah!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_AllegedTrendNotAuthentic
text: Oh, no, no, no.\pThat alleged\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lyou claim to have seen--it's not.\pThe authentic article is much…\nHow should I say it?\lSharper, yet more mellow!\pAh, no matter. It's astonishing!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ComposedTrendThemeSong
text:
Hey, listen, I composed a theme song
for “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p“{STR_VAR_1}”
is really popular right now.\pOkay, listen!
… …\pOh!
{STR_VAR_1}!\pWonderful
{STR_VAR_1}!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WorkOnYourSinging
text: … …\pI dare say, chap, it would pay for you\nto work on your singing before you\ltrifle yourself with\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_OrganizeTrendParty
text: Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we\nshould get together and organize a\l“{STR_VAR_1}” party\lon the island.

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BrilliantIndeed
text: Oh, a smashing good idea!\pIt will settle once and for all\nwho is the best at\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”\lBrilliant, indeed!\pStarting today, our lives will revolve\naround “{STR_VAR_1}”!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendHasBecomePartOfLife
text: I was thinking, though…\pWouldn't you agree that\n“{STR_VAR_1}” has\lgrown from being something trendy to\lbeing a part of our daily lives?

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendWeighsHeavilyOnMind
text:
Beg pardon?
That much, what?\pHowever, it's true that
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lweighs heavily on your mind, whether\lyou're awake or asleep.\pAbsolutely, you're the
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lPROFESSOR, old sport!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IfWeTeamUpWellBeInvincible
text: If you and me team up as a combo,\nwe'll be invincible when it comes to all\lthings “{STR_VAR_1}”!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WellBeTrendDuo
text: Spot on, my friend!\pWe shall be the\n“{STR_VAR_1}” DUO!\pIsn't that a ripe image?\nHahahah!

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GiveYouSludgeBomb
text:
For me, SLUDGE BOMB is at the peak
of popularity. It's the one.\pHunh? You're telling me that you don't
know about SLUDGE BOMB?\pThat's outright pitiful.
I'll give you one.

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LoveSludgeBombButTrendInToo
text: I love SLUDGE BOMB.\pBut POKéMON with the move\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lare in, too.

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLivingOnIsland
text: There's a lot to be said for living on\na small island like this in harmony with\lPOKéMON and the family.

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOnIsland
text: I left the major port of SLATEPORT\nCITY when I married my husband here.\pLife goes by slowly on this little\nisland. But being surrounded by the\lbeautiful sea--that's happiness, too.

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
text: ZIGZAGOON: Guguuh!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
text:
Gorge your eyes on this!\pIt's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the
cutting edge of fashion, yeah!\pOh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
You appreciate my dazzling style!\pOh, you're a delight!
Here you go. I want you to have it!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
text: Oh, you don't have room?\pNow, listen tight, this SCARF is a must-\nhave! Why, I would sell all my items\lin order to get it!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf
text: The SILK SCARF raises the power of\nNORMAL-type moves.\pIt's a marvelous SCARF that will go\nwith almost all POKéMON!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
text:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?\pDid you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?\pHe's so cool…
Everyone idolizes him.

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneCavern
text: There's a stone cavern at the edge\nof town.\pI've heard you can find rare stones\nthere.

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaintedMonCanUseHM
text: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't\nbattle, it can still use a move learned\lfrom a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).

label: EcruteakCity_Text_TownSign
text: ECRUTEAK CITY\nA Historical City\pWhere the Past Meets\nthe Present

label: EcruteakCity_Text_PokeCenterSign
text: POKEMON CENTER

label: EcruteakCity_Text_MartSign
text: POKEMON MART

label: EcruteakCity_Text_BurnedTowerSign
text: BURNED TOWER\pIt was destroyed by a\nmysterious fire.\pPlease stay away, as\nit is unsafe.

label: EcruteakCity_Text_TinTowerSign
text: TIN TOWER\pA legendary POKEMON is\nsaid to roost here.

label: ElmsLab_Text_OakBirchSurprise
text: OAK: Surprise!\pBIRCH: Happy birthday!

label: ElmsLab_Text_WrongPerson
text: OAK: Oh! Pardon me.\pBIRCH: You're not ELM, are you?

label: ElmsLab_Text_ElmSeesOak
text: ELM: PROF. OAK?

label: ElmsLab_Text_ElmSeesBirch
text: ELM: PROF. BIRCH?

label: ElmsLab_Text_ElmBirthdayRuined
text:
ELM: What are you two doing here?\pBalloons? Streamers?
Oh! That's right!\pMy birthday came around again.
I completely forgot!\pThank you both for coming all
this way.

label: ElmsLab_Text_ElmIntroducesPlayer
text: ELM: This is {PLAYER}.\p{PLAYER} is just about to set out\nwith a first POKEMON.

label: ElmsLab_Text_BirchHasHoennStarters
text: BIRCH: Then this is perfect!\pI brought three POKEMON from\nHOENN. They're lively ones!

label: ElmsLab_Text_OakNotOutdone
text: OAK: And the PC network should\nlet me retrieve three from KANTO.\pELM, I hope you don't mind.\nI'll use your PC for a moment.

label: ElmsLab_Text_ElmComeBack
text: ELM: Excellent!\p{PLAYER}, come back here with us.\nWe'll set everything out together.

label: ElmsLab_Text_ElmNineChoices
text:
ELM: Three professors in one lab
is a little crowded, yes.\pOAK: But the LEAGUE is changing.
JOHTO, KANTO, and HOENN are\lnot as separate as they were.\pBIRCH: More fieldwork! More
habitats! More chances to get\lchased by wild POKEMON!\pELM: And more responsibility
for new TRAINERS.\pOAK: Eight sanctioned BADGES
qualify a TRAINER for the first\lChampion Assessment.\pBIRCH: After that, tournament
people start saying things like\linterregional liability.\pELM: For now, choose carefully.
Your first partner will matter.\pTalk to one of us, then check the
POKE BALLS on the table.

label: ElmsLab_Text_ElmAfterStarter
text: ELM: Take good care of that\nPOKEMON.\pI'm sure it will grow wonderfully\nwith you.

label: ElmsLab_Text_OakOffersPokemon
text: OAK: Very well.\pI've retrieved BULBASAUR,\nCHARMANDER, and SQUIRTLE.

label: ElmsLab_Text_OakAfterStarter
text: OAK: Your journey is beginning.\pMeet many POKEMON, and learn\nall you can.

label: ElmsLab_Text_OakDexNavSync
text: OAK: Your POKEDEX can use\na field-search module now.\pI'll activate DEXNAV.

label: ElmsLab_Text_DexNavUnlocked
text: DEXNAV app unlocked!

label: ElmsLab_Text_BirchOffersPokemon
text: BIRCH: How about HOENN's three?\pTREECKO, TORCHIC, and MUDKIP\nare all fine partners.

label: ElmsLab_Text_BirchAfterStarter
text: BIRCH: Take that POKEMON out into\nthe grass now and then.\pThat's where you'll really get to\nknow each other.

label: ElmsLab_Text_ElmOffersPokemon
text: ELM: Then please look at JOHTO's\nthree POKEMON.\pCHIKORITA, CYNDAQUIL, and\nTOTODILE are ready.

label: ElmsLab_Text_AideGreeting
text: There are three POKE BALLS on\nthe table.\pSpeak with a professor, and the\nPOKE BALLS will be prepared.

label: ElmsLab_Text_AideAfterStarter
text: The PROF. looks happy.\pHe says he forgot his own birthday\nagain this year.

label: ElmsLab_Text_ChooseAnotherProfessor
text: You can check the other POKE BALLS,\nor speak with another professor.

label: ElmsLab_Text_TakeBulbasaur
text: Would you like BULBASAUR,\nthe SEED POKEMON?

label: ElmsLab_Text_TakeCharmander
text: Would you like CHARMANDER,\nthe LIZARD POKEMON?

label: ElmsLab_Text_TakeSquirtle
text: Would you like SQUIRTLE,\nthe TINY TURTLE POKEMON?

label: ElmsLab_Text_TakeChikorita
text: Would you like CHIKORITA,\nthe LEAF POKEMON?

label: ElmsLab_Text_TakeCyndaquil
text: Would you like CYNDAQUIL,\nthe FIRE MOUSE POKEMON?

label: ElmsLab_Text_TakeTotodile
text: Would you like TOTODILE,\nthe BIG JAW POKEMON?

label: ElmsLab_Text_TakeTreecko
text: Would you like TREECKO,\nthe WOOD GECKO POKEMON?

label: ElmsLab_Text_TakeTorchic
text: Would you like TORCHIC,\nthe CHICK POKEMON?

label: ElmsLab_Text_TakeMudkip
text: Would you like MUDKIP,\nthe MUD FISH POKEMON?

label: ElmsLab_Text_ReceivedStarter
text: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_1}!

label: ElmsLab_Text_StarterReceived
text: ELM: A wonderful choice!\pTake good care of that\nPOKEMON.\pYour journey should begin\nwhile the day is young.

label: ElmsLab_Text_AlreadyChoseStarter
text: The remaining POKEMON are resting\ninside their POKE BALLS.

label: ElmsLab_Text_OakPokedexApology
text: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}, one moment!\pI came all this way and still had\nto use ELM's PC network.\pAs an apology for being so\nunprepared, please take this.

label: ElmsLab_Text_ReceivedPokedex
text: {PLAYER} received the POKEDEX!

label: ElmsLab_Text_OakExplainPokedex
text: OAK: That POKEDEX records data on\nPOKEMON you meet or catch.\pI've set it for wider listings,\nso your travels should be covered.

label: ElmsLab_Text_AideGivesPokeBalls
text: AIDE: If you're filling a POKEDEX,\nyou'll need these, too.

label: ElmsLab_Text_AideNoRoomForPokeBalls
text: AIDE: Oh! Your BAG is full.\pPlease make room, then come back\nfor these POKE BALLS.

label: ElmsLab_Text_PC
text: The PC is full of research notes\nabout starter POKEMON.

label: ElmsLab_Text_Bookshelf
text: Books about POKEMON habitats are\npacked onto the shelf.

label: ElmsLab_Text_HealingMachine
text: You placed your POKEMON in the\nhealing machine.

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringVictoryRoad
text: ENTERING VICTORY ROAD

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringPokemonLeague
text: ENTERING POKéMON LEAGUE\nCENTER GATE

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
text: EVER GRANDE CITY\p“The paradise of flowers, the sea,\nand POKéMON.”

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pThat incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY…
That was superb work, putting an end\lto that crisis all by yourself.\pOops!\pIt wouldn't be fair to say that you
alone ended the crisis.\pYou overcame that difficult situation
by working as one with your POKéMON.\pWe TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving
them items and by teaching them new\ltechniques for battle.\pBut we ourselves also learn many
things from POKéMON.\pAnd this is where your achievements
are put to the test against what\lothers like you have achieved.\pNow!\pWho can most elegantly dance with
their POKéMON in HOENN?\pShow me right here and now!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
text: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…\pThat was wonderful work.\nYou were elegant, infuriatingly so.\lAnd yet it was utterly glorious!\pKudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou are a truly noble POKéMON\nTRAINER!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text:
WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into
battle…\pAt times they danced like a spring
breeze, and at times they struck\llike lightning.\pIt was with light, yet surefooted,
elegance that you led your POKéMON.\pEven I felt bedazzled by your
masterful performance!\pYou now stand at the glorious peak
of the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI now proclaim you to be the new
HOENN region…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
text: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHere's some advice before you challenge\nthe CHAMPION…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayItsAlreadyOver
text: MAY: Huh?\nWhat, what, what?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}…\nCould it be that…\lIt's already over?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanAdvice
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!\pHow would you like some advice before\nyou challenge the CHAMPION?…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
text: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…\pAre you trying to tell me…\nYou've beaten the CHAMPION?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
text:
PROF. BIRCH: See?
What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?\pDidn't I tell you that you don't need
to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?\p… … … … … … … …
{PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.\pWhen I heard that you defeated your
own father at the PETALBURG GYM,\lI thought perhaps you had a chance…\pBut to think you've actually become
the CHAMPION!\pAh, yes!\pWhat became of your POKéDEX?
Here, let me see.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
text: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways,\ncongratulations!\pNow, go proudly into the final room!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pNo, let me rephrase that properly.\pThe new CHAMPION!\pCome with me.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
text: WALLACE: I'm sorry, but…\pFrom here on, only those TRAINERS who\nhave become CHAMPIONS may enter.\pYou'll have to wait outside with\nPROF. BIRCH.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
text:
MAY: Groan…\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pI'm just joking! That's okay!
That's the rule!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}!
Honestly, congratulations!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
text: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pIt can't be helped if that's the rule.\p{PLAYER}, way to go!\nCongratulations!

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
I am the last of the POKéMON LEAGUE
ELITE FOUR, DRAKE the DRAGON master!\pIn their natural state, POKéMON are
wild living things. They are free.\pAt times, they hinder us.
At times, they help us.\pFor us to battle with POKéMON as
partners, do you know what it takes?\pDo you know what is needed?\pIf you don't, then you will never
prevail over me!

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Superb, it should be said.

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text:
You deserve every credit for coming
this far as a TRAINER of POKéMON.\pYou do seem to know what is needed.\pYes, what a TRAINER needs is a
virtuous heart.\pPOKéMON touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and learn good from wrong.\pThey touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and grow strong.\pGo! Go onwards!
The CHAMPION is waiting!

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
Welcome, my name is GLACIA
of the ELITE FOUR.\pI've traveled from afar to HOENN
so that I may hone my ice skills.\pBut all I have seen are challenges by
weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.\pWhat about you?\pIt would please me to no end if I could
go all out against you!

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat
text: You and your POKéMON…\nHow hot your spirits burn!\pThe all-consuming heat overwhelms.\pIt's no surprise that my icy skills\nfailed to harm you.

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text: Advance to the next room.\pAnd there, confirm the truly fearsome\nside of the POKéMON LEAGUE.

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHonorLeagueChampions
text: WALLACE: This room…\pThis is where we keep records of\nPOKéMON that prevailed through\lharsh battles.\pIt is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS\nare honored.

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecordYouAndYourPartnersNames
text: WALLACE: Come on, let's record your\nname as a TRAINER who triumphed over\lthe POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of\lthe partners who battled with you.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
Ahahaha!\pI'm PHOEBE of the ELITE FOUR.
I did my training on MT. PYRE.\pWhile I trained, I gained the ability
to commune with GHOST-type POKéMON.\pYes, the bond I developed with POKéMON
is extremely tight.\pSo, come on, just try and see if you can
even inflict damage on my POKéMON!

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Oh, darn.\nI've gone and lost.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text:
There's a definite bond between you
and your POKéMON, too.\pI didn't recognize it, so it's only
natural that I lost.\pYup, I'd like to see how far your bond
will carry you.\pGo ahead, move on to the next room.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LeagueAfterVictoryRoad
text: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short\ndistance after the VICTORY ROAD.\pIf you've come this far, what choice\ndo you have but to keep going?

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
text: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD…\pIt's like reliving the path one has\ntraveled in life…\pBelieve in your POKéMON and give it\nyour very best!

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
text:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your
way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pI'm happy for you!
You made my cheering worthwhile!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become
the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pI'll get in touch with you then.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
Go for greatness!

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_MustHaveAllGymBadges
text: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS\nwho have collected all the GYM BADGES\lare permitted to enter.\pTRAINER, let us confirm that you have\nall the GYM BADGES.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_HaventObtainedAllBadges
text: You haven't obtained all the BADGES.\pIf you're bound for the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must return with them.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_GoForth
text: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your\nPOKéMON, and go forth!

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
text:
Welcome, challenger!
I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR.\pI like that look you're giving me.
I guess you'll give me a good match.\lThat's good! Looking real good!\pAll right! You and me, let's enjoy
a battle that can only be staged\lhere in the POKéMON LEAGUE!

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_Defeat
text: Well, how do you like that? I lost!\nEh, it was fun, so it doesn't matter.

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
text: Well, listen to what this loser has\nto say.\pYou've got what it takes to go far.\nNow, go on to the next room and enjoy\lyour next battle!

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
text: Something's happening,\nand I don't like it!\pI've seen shady characters wandering\nin and out of PROF. COZMO's home…

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
text: This region's been known for meteors\nsince the olden days.\pThey say METEOR FALLS was gouged out\nby a falling meteorite long ago.

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
text: See! Take a look!\nThis is my precious AZURILL!\pIt's slick and smooth and plushy, too!

label: FallarborTown_Text_Azurill
text: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
text:
Have you already challenged FLANNERY,
the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?\pThe girl's grandfather was famous.
He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE at one point.\pIt wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY
become a great TRAINER in her own\lright.

label: FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign
text: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE\n“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”

label: FallarborTown_Text_TownSign
text: FALLARBOR TOWN\n“A farm community with small gardens.”

label: FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign
text: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE\n“New moves taught to POKéMON.”

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_DoAllRightInPreliminary
text: We do all right in the preliminary round,\nbut we can never win the appeals…\pMaybe it means I have to watch what\nother contestants are doing…

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_MonAllTheseRibbons
text: See!\nMy POKéMON won all these RIBBONS!\pHave your POKéMON earned any RIBBONS?\nYou can check them on your POKéNAV.

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_CantWinEverywhere
text: I can't beat GYM LEADERS…\pI can't win any CONTESTS…\pI've been here, there, and everywhere,\nand it's all for naught…

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_SuperRankStage
text: POKéMON CONTESTS\nSUPER RANK STAGE!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeThinkImJustKid
text: Fufufufufu.\pI'm going to make everyone think\nI'm just a kid and let them play down.\pThen, I'll shock them and grab\nthe title!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FallarborTentMyFavorite
text:
You know how BATTLE TENTS offer
different events in different towns?\pMy favorite is definitely the BATTLE
TENT in FALLARBOR TOWN.\pI think it's fantastic how TRAINERS
try to win with all their faith in\ltheir POKéMON.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameToCampOut
text:
I heard something about some tent,
so I came to camp out.\pI didn't know that tents these days
are so luxurious!\pSince I'm here, I may as well try
my hand at battling!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
text:
SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
So you came out to this BATTLE TENT!\pThe people in these parts tend to be
easygoing and laid-back.\pBut, you see, what I'm looking for are
people with…\pHow should I say this?\pSomeone bursting with the desire
and the drive to win.\pIf there were a TRAINER like that,
I'd immediately…\pWhoops! Never mind!
Keep working at it!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottMakeChallenge
text: SCOTT: Instead of wasting your\ntime with the likes of me, why not\lmake a challenge?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MeteoriteWillNeverBeMineNow
text: PROF. COZMO: Oh…\nI never should have let myself be\lconned into telling TEAM MAGMA where\lyou can find METEORITES…\pThat METEORITE from METEOR FALLS…\nIt's never going to be mine now…

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
text:
Oh!
Hah?\pThat item…\pCould it be?\pIs it the METEORITE that TEAM MAGMA
took from METEOR FALLS?\pPlease, may I have it?\pI'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseUseThisTM
text: PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents\nmy feeling of gratitude.\lPlease use it!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoingToHelpMyResearch
text: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it.\nThis is really, really great!\pThis is really going to help my research!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWithDisappointment
text: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but…\nI'm crushed with disappointment…

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveMeteorite
text: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that\nMETEORITE?\pI'm not asking for it for free.\nHow about in exchange for this TM?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWentToMeteorFalls
text: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS\non ROUTE 114 with some people from\lTEAM MAGMA.

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorryForCozmo
text: Poor PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSoHappy
text: Look at PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so happy! I think it's cute.

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEvolve
text:
I'm having a hard time deciding if I
should make my SKITTY evolve or not.\pI only have to use this MOON STONE,
but it's so hard to decide…\pIf I make it evolve, it will become
much stronger.\pBut it will look so different, too.

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Miyao?

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_SellNuggetIFound
text: This NUGGET I found here…\nI suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing\las how it has no other use.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheMoveTutor
text:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\pI know all the moves that POKéMON
learn--every one of them--and I can\lteach POKéMON those moves.\pI can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.\pI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ThatsAHeartScaleWantMeToTeachMove
text: Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\pLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TutorWhichMon
text: Which POKéMON needs tutoring?

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TeachWhichMove
text: Which move should I teach?

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_DontHaveMoveToTeachPokemon
text: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that POKéMON.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_HandedOverHeartScale
text: {PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ComeBackWithHeartScale
text: If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_CantTeachEgg
text: Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
text:
Oh, hello.
You are?\pOkay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I can see that you're a TRAINER.\pSo that means you use the POKéMON
Storage System I developed.\pHow I arrived at that conclusion is
a simple deductive process.\pYou spoke to me because you wanted
to access something on this PC.\pOh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.\pHonestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's
great you're using the Storage System.\pIf you could, please visit me at home.
My house is on ROUTE 114.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
text: I wonder what POKéMON looked like\nlong, long ago?\pMaybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge\nof town will know.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlantHardyTrees
text: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant\nseedlings of hardy trees that thrive\leven in volcanic ash.

label: FarawayIsland_Interior_Text_TheFeelingOfBeingWatchedFaded
text: The feeling of being watched faded…

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
text:
No one believes me, but I saw this
gigantic POKéMON in the sky.\pIt seemed to squirm as it flew toward
ROUTE 131.\pBy the way… Sniff…
Um… You, uh…smell singed.\pWere you at a volcano or something?

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym
text: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM,\nbut something's blocking the way.\pAfter all the bother I went through\ntraining on ROUTE 120…

label: FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona
text: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON\nwith me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.

label: FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRainwater
text: The ground absorbs rainwater, and\ntrees grow by drinking that water…\pOur FORTREE CITY exists because\nthere's both water and soil.

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
text:
The CITY consists of homes built on
trees.\pPerhaps because of that lifestyle,
everyone is healthy and lively.\pWhy, even myself--I feel as if I've
grown thirty years younger.

label: FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWindow
text: Living on top of trees is okay.\pBut sometimes BUG POKéMON come in\nthrough windows.\lIt can be really startling.

label: FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTraded
text: There are POKéMON that evolve when\nyou trade them! That's what I heard.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable
text: Something unseeable is in the way.

label: FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope
text: Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
text: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON fled!

label: FortreeCity_Text_CitySign
text: FORTREE CITY\n“The treetop city that frolics with\lnature.”

label: FortreeCity_Text_GymSign
text: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WINONA\p“The bird user taking flight into\nthe world.”

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
text: Merchandise you buy here is sent to\nyour own PC.\pThat's fantastic! I wish they could\nalso deliver me home like that.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
text: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm\nputting my cute DOLLS on it.\pIf I don't, when I decorate my\nSECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get\ldirty or poked with splinters.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pFORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is
a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.\pShe's waiting at the back of this GYM,
behind the rotating doors.\pShe's waiting for new challengers
who are trying to take wing!\pOkay, go for it!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: You did it!\nYou've achieved liftoff!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro
