MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with
instructions.\p“Press the B Button while wearing these
RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!\p“Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race
in the great outdoors!”

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
text:
… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pTo think that you have your very own
POKéMON now…\lYour father will be overjoyed.\p…But please be careful.
If anything happens, you can come home.\pGo on, go get them, honey!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
text: If you use a PC, you can store items\nand POKéMON.\pThe power of science is staggering!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
text: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB\nstudying, then he'll suddenly go out in\lthe wild to do more research…\pWhen does PROF. BIRCH spend time\nat home?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
text: Um, um, um!\pIf you go outside and go in the grass,\nwild POKéMON will jump out!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHavePokemon
text: It's dangerous if you don't have\nyour own POKéMON.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
text:
Um, hi!\pThere are scary POKéMON outside!
I can hear their cries!\pI want to go see what's going on,
but I don't have any POKéMON…\pCan you go see what's happening
for me?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch
text: You saved PROF. BIRCH!\nI'm so glad!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPokemon
text: Are you going to catch POKéMON?\nGood luck!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
text: LITTLEROOT TOWN\n“A town that can't be shaded any hue.”

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
text: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB

label: LittlerootTown_Text_PlayersHouse
text: {PLAYER}'s HOUSE

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsHouse
text: PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
That was good work out there!\pI knew there was something special
about you when I first saw you,\lbut I never expected this.\pOh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX
I gave you?\pI have something to show you.
Let's go to my LAB.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsntItNiceInHere
text: MOM: See, {PLAYER}?\nIsn't it nice in here, too?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
text:
The mover's POKéMON do all the work
of moving us in and cleaning up after.\lThis is so convenient!\p{PLAYER}, your room is upstairs.
Go check it out, dear!\pDAD bought you a new clock to mark
our move here.\lDon't forget to set it!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedInRoom
text: MOM: Well, {PLAYER}?\pAren't you interested in seeing your\nvery own room?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock
text: MOM: {PLAYER}.\pGo set the clock in your room, honey.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_OhComeQuickly
text: MOM: Oh! {PLAYER}, {PLAYER}!\nQuick! Come quickly!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MaybeDadWillBeOn
text: MOM: Look! It's PETALBURG GYM!\nMaybe DAD will be on!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim
text: MOM: Oh… It's over.\pI think DAD was on, but we missed him.\nToo bad.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
text: Oh, yes.\nOne of DAD's friends lives in town.\pPROF. BIRCH is his name.\pHe lives right next door, so you should\ngo over and introduce yourself.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SeeYouHoney
text: MOM: See you, honey!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DidYouMeetProfBirch
text: MOM: Did you introduce yourself to\nPROF. BIRCH?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldRestABit
text: MOM: How are you doing, {PLAYER}?\nYou look a little tired.\pI think you should rest a bit.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TakeCareHoney
text: MOM: Take care, honey!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSomethingFromMom
text: MOM: Oh? Did DAD give you that BADGE?\pThen here's something from your MOM!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfTooHard
text: Don't push yourself too hard, dear.\nYou can always come home.\pGo for it, honey!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav
text: MOM: What is that, honey? A POKéNAV?\nSomeone from DEVON gave it to you?\pWell, honey, how about registering\nyour mom?\p… … …

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RegisteredMom
text: Registered MOM\nin the POKéNAV.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth1
text: Fugiiiiih!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth2
text: Huggoh, uggo uggo…

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ReportFromPetalburgGym
text: INTERVIEWER: …We brought you this\nreport from in front of PETALBURG GYM.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
text: There is a movie on TV.\pTwo men are dancing on a big piano\nkeyboard.\pBetter get going!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
text:
It's the instruction booklet for the
RUNNING SHOES.\p“Press the B Button to run while
wearing your RUNNING SHOES.\p“Lace up your RUNNING SHOES and hit
the road running!”

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
text:
DAD: Hm?\pHey, it's {PLAYER}!\pIt's been a while since I saw you,
but you look…stronger, somehow.\pThat's the impression I get.
But your old man hasn't given up yet!\pOh, yes, I have something for you.
This came to you from someone named\lMR. BRINEY.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLilycove
text: DAD: Hm, a TICKET for a ferry?\pIf I recall, there are ferry ports in\nSLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym
text: I'd better get back to PETALBURG GYM.\pMOM, thanks for looking after the house\nwhile I'm away.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
text: MOM: That DAD of yours…\pHe comes home for the first time in a\nwhile, but all he talks about is POKéMON.\pHe should relax and stay a little longer.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatABreakingStory
text: MOM: Is that a breaking news story?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
text:
We bring you this emergency
news flash!\pIn various HOENN locales, there have
been reports of a BZZT…colored\lPOKéMON in flight.\pThe identity of this POKéMON is
currently unknown.\pWe now return you to the regular
movie program.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WhatColorDidTheySay
text: MOM: {PLAYER}, did you catch that?\pWhat color did the announcer say\nthat POKéMON was?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_StillUnknownPokemon
text: MOM: Well, isn't that something!\nThere are still unknown POKéMON.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ClockIsStopped
text: The clock is stopped…\pBetter set it and start it!

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_HowDoYouLikeYourRoom
text:
MOM: {PLAYER}, how do you like your
new room?\pGood! Everything's put away neatly!\pThey finished moving everything in
downstairs, too.\pPOKéMON movers are so convenient!\pOh, you should make sure that
everything's all there on your desk.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook
text: {PLAYER} flipped open the notebook.\pADVENTURE RULE NO. 1\nOpen the MENU with START.\pADVENTURE RULE NO. 2\nRecord your progress with SAVE.\pThe remaining pages are blank…

label: Common_Text_LookCloserAtMap
text: {PLAYER} took a closer look at the\nHOENN region map.

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ItsAGameCube
text: It's a Nintendo GameCube.\pA Game Boy Advance is connected to\nserve as the Controller.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_OhYoureTheNewNeighbor
text:
Oh, hello. And you are?\p… … … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}, our new next-door
neighbor! Hi!\pWe have a {STR_VAR_1} about the same
age as you.\pOur {STR_VAR_1} was excited about making
a new friend.\pOur {STR_VAR_1} is upstairs, I think.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_LikeChildLikeFather
text: Like child, like father.\pMy husband is as wild about POKéMON\nas our child.\pIf he's not at his LAB, he's likely\nscrabbling about in grassy places.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_TooBusyToNoticeVisit
text: That {RIVAL}!\pI guess our child is too busy with\nPOKéMON to notice that you came\lto visit, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_WentOutToRoute103
text: Oh, {RIVAL} went out to ROUTE 103\njust a little while ago.\pLike father, like child.\n{RIVAL} can't stay quietly at home.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoOften
text:
I think it's wonderful for people to
travel with POKéMON.\pBut you should go home every so often
to let your mother know you're okay.\pShe might not say it, but I'm sure she
worries about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
text:
Huh?
Who… Who are you?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}.
So your move was today.\pUm… I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!\pI…
I have this dream of becoming friends\lwith POKéMON all over the world.\pI… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from
my dad, PROF. BIRCH.\pI was hoping that you would be nice,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.\pOh, this is silly, isn't it?
I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pEheheh…\pOh, no! I forgot!\pI was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
text:
Hey!
You…\pWho are you?\pOh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
Moved in next door, right?\pI didn't know that you're a girl.\pDad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new
next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's\lkid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.\pMy name's BRENDAN.
So, hi, neighbor!\pHuh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have
a POKéMON?\pDo you want me to go catch you one?\pAw, darn, I forgot…\pI'm supposed to go help my dad catch
some wild POKéMON.\pSome other time, okay?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_DoYouHavePokemon
text: Hi, neighbor!\pDo you already have your\nown POKéMON?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
text:
Huh?
Who… Who are you?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}.
So your move was today.\pUm… I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!\pI…
I have this dream of becoming friends\lwith POKéMON all over the world.\pI… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from
my dad, PROF. BIRCH.\pI was hoping that you would be nice,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.\pOh, this is silly, isn't it?
I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pEheheh…\pOh, no! I forgot!\pI was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayGettingReady
text: POKéMON fully restored!\nItems ready, and…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
text:
Hey!
You…\pWho are you?\pOh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
Moved in next door, right?\pI didn't know that you're a girl.\pDad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new
next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's\lkid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.\pMy name's BRENDAN.
So, hi, neighbor!\pHuh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have
a POKéMON?\pDo you want me to go catch you one?\pAw, darn, I forgot…\pI'm supposed to go help my dad catch
some wild POKéMON.\pSome other time, okay?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanGettingReady
text: POKéMON fully restored…\nItems all packed, and…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_ItsRivalsPokeBall
text: It's {RIVAL}'s POKé BALL!\pBetter leave it right where it is.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
text:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI was just checking my POKéDEX.\pThere's still a lot of POKéMON that
I've seen but haven't caught.\pAnd there are many others that
I think will evolve.\pI wonder where I should go catch
some POKéMON next?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
text: MAY: I wonder where I should go catch\nsome POKéMON next?\pWouldn't it be funny if we ran into each\nother, {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
text: BRENDAN: Hey, it's {PLAYER}.\pI was just checking out my POKéDEX.\pThere are still many POKéMON that\nI need to catch, I know, but this\lis looking pretty good.\pChecking this POKéDEX out gives me\nthe urge to hit the road again.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
text: BRENDAN: I'm having a hard time deciding\nwhere I should catch POKéMON next.\pHey, {PLAYER}, if I see you while I'm out\ncatching POKéMON, I can pitch you a\lbattle if you'd like.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchAwayOnFieldwork
text:
Hunh? PROF. BIRCH?\pThe PROF's away on fieldwork.
Ergo, he isn't here.\pOh, let me explain what fieldwork is.\pIt is to study things in the natural
environment, like fields and mountains,\linstead of a laboratory.\pThe PROF isn't one for doing desk work.
He's the type of person who would\lrather go outside and experience\lthings than read about them here.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchIsntOneForDeskWork
text: The PROF isn't one for doing desk work.\nHe's the type of person who would\lrather go outside and experience\lthings than read about them here.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchEnjoysRivalsHelpToo
text: PROF. BIRCH is studying the habitats\nand distribution of POKéMON.\pThe PROF enjoys {RIVAL}'s help, too.\nThere's a lot of love there.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
text:
PROF. BIRCH: So, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI've heard so much about you from
your father.\pI've heard that you don't have your
own POKéMON yet.\pBut the way you battled earlier,
you pulled it off with aplomb!\pI guess you have your father's blood
in your veins after all!\pOh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me,
I'd like you to have the POKéMON you\lused earlier.\p{PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_WhyNotGiveNicknameToMon
text: PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not\ngive a nickname to that {STR_VAR_1}?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MightBeGoodIdeaToGoSeeRival
text:
PROF. BIRCH: If you work at POKéMON
and gain experience, I think you'll make\lan extremely good TRAINER.\pMy kid, {RIVAL}, is also studying
POKéMON while helping me out.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, don't you think it might be
a good idea to go see {RIVAL}?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GetRivalToTeachYou
text: PROF. BIRCH: Great!\n{RIVAL} should be happy, too.\pGet {RIVAL} to teach you what it\nmeans to be a TRAINER.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_DontBeThatWay
text: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way.\nYou should go meet my kid.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchRivalGoneHome
text:
PROF. BIRCH: {RIVAL}?
Gone home, I think.\pOr maybe that kid's scrabbling around
in tall grass again somewhere…\pIf you or your POKéMON get tired,
you should get some rest at home.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeardYouBeatRivalTakePokedex
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI heard you beat {RIVAL} on
your first try. That's excellent!\p{RIVAL}'s been helping with my research
for a long time.\p{RIVAL} has an extensive history as
a TRAINER already.\pHere, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I ordered this for my
research, but I think you should have\lthis POKéDEX.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ReceivedPokedex
text: {PLAYER} received the POKéDEX!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ExplainPokedex
text:
PROF. BIRCH: The POKéDEX is a high-tech
tool that automatically makes a record\lof any POKéMON you meet or catch.\pMy kid, {RIVAL}, goes everywhere
with it.\pWhenever my kid catches a rare POKéMON
and records its data in the POKéDEX,\lwhy, {RIVAL} looks for me while I'm out\ldoing fieldwork, and shows me.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CountlessPokemonAwait
text: PROF. BIRCH: Countless POKéMON\nawait you!\pArgh, I'm getting the itch to get out\nand do fieldwork again!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayGotPokedexTooTakeThese
text: MAY: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou got a POKéDEX, too!\pThat's great! Just like me!\nI've got something for you, too!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCutePokemonWithPokeBalls
text:
MAY: It's fun if you can get a lot of
POKéMON!\pI'm going to look all over the place
because I want different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cute POKéMON, I'll catch
them with POKé BALLS!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OhYourBagsFull
text: Oh? Your BAG's full.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
text: MAY: I wonder where I should go look\nfor POKéMON next?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanGotPokedexTooTakeThese
text: BRENDAN: Huh…\nSo you got a POKéDEX, too.\pWell then, here.\nI'll give you these.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCoolPokemonWithPokeBalls
text:
BRENDAN: You know it's more fun to
have a whole bunch of POKéMON.\pI'm going to explore all over the place
to find different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cool POKéMON, you bet
I'll try to get them with POKé BALLS.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeyYourBagsFull
text: Hey, your BAG's full.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
text: BRENDAN: Where should I look for\nPOKéMON next…

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_SeriousLookingMachine
text: It's a serious-looking machine.\nThe PROF must use this for research.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PCUsedForResearch
text: It's a PC used for research.\nBetter not mess around with it.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CrammedWithBooksOnPokemon
text: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BookTooHardToRead
text: It's a book that's too hard to read.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Now…\p{PLAYER}{KUN} and {RIVAL}, I've had the two
of you help me study POKéMON.\pThanks to your help, new facts
are coming to light.\pIt appears that in the HOENN region,
there are also POKéMON from other\lregions.\pIt goes to show how rich and varied
the natural environments of HOENN\lhappen to be.\pThat's why I think it's necessary for
me to upgrade your POKéDEX to\lthe NATIONAL Mode.\pHere, let me see your POKéDEX units.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayUpgradeSoCool
text: MAY: Eheheh!\pIt's so cool that even my POKéDEX\nis getting updated!\pIt's because you went out and caught\nso many POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanYouCanThankMe
text: BRENDAN: I went out all over HOENN\nand checked out POKéMON.\pYou can thank me for getting\nthe NATIONAL Mode POKéDEX.\pYep, you're lucky, {PLAYER}!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OkayAllDone
text: PROF. BIRCH: Okay, all done!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PokedexUpgradedToNational
text: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded\nto the NATIONAL Mode!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting2
text:
PROF. BIRCH: But listen.
You've become the CHAMPION,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayTakeBreakFromFieldwork
text: MAY: I think I'll take a short break\nfrom fieldwork.\pI think I'll help the PROF here for\na while.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanTakeBreakFromFieldwork
text: BRENDAN: For the time being,\nI'm taking a break from fieldwork.\pI'll be helping out the PROF here\nfor a while.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let's have a look at your POKéDEX.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pYes, there's no doubt about it.\pYou really have completed the HOENN
region's POKéDEX.\pThat's more than just impressive.\pI have a gift for you.\pConsider it my show of appreciation
for the fantastic work you've done.\pMy gift is a rare POKéMON only found
in another region!\pYou can have any one of these
three POKéMON!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CanHaveAnyOneOfRarePokemon
text: PROF. BIRCH: These are rare POKéMON\nonly found in another region!\pYou can have any one of these\nthree POKéMON!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeCyndaquil
text: PROF. BIRCH: The FIRE POKéMON\nCYNDAQUIL caught your eye!\pYou're as sharp as ever!\pSo the CYNDAQUIL is your choice?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeTotodile
text: PROF. BIRCH: The WATER POKéMON\nTOTODILE is your choice!\pYou know how to pick a good one.\pSo, you'll take the TOTODILE?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeChikorita
text: PROF. BIRCH: The GRASS POKéMON\nCHIKORITA is your choice!\pYou sure know what you're doing.\pSo, you'll take the CHIKORITA?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_TakeYourTimeAllInvaluable
text: PROF. BIRCH: Take your time before\nyou decide.\pThey're all invaluable POKéMON.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PickedFinePokemon
text: PROF. BIRCH: I see!\nYou picked a fine POKéMON!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ReceivedJohtoStarter
text: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom PROF. BIRCH!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_NicknameJohtoStarter
text: Want to give a nickname to\nthe {STR_VAR_1} you received?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
You've completed the HOENN POKéDEX,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BetterLeaveOthersAlone
text: You received the promised POKéMON.\nBetter leave the others alone.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForPokemon
text: Oh, you don't have any room for\nthis POKéMON.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhatNextImStayingHere
text:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, after this…
What are you going to do?\pAre you going to keep battling
and sharpening your skills?\pOr are you going to try filling
the NATIONAL POKéDEX?\pI'm staying here to help the PROF.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanPreferCollectingSlowly
text: BRENDAN: Rather than collecting\nPOKéMON, I prefer slowly and \lsteadily raising the one I chose.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
text: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nHave you gone to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
text: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nHave you gone out to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
text:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pSCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}!
It's me, SCOTT.\pI'm aboard the S.S. TIDAL now.
It feels great to be on the sea!\pBy the way…\pThere's this place that I'd like to
invite you to for a visit.\pIf you're interested, board a ferry
at either SLATEPORT or LILYCOVE.\pI'll fill you in on the details when
we meet. I'll be waiting!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: When TEAM MAGMA has roll call, we get\nimportant guarding assignments in\lthe order that we line up.\pThat's why I'm stuck off in this corner.\nI'm always late to roll call!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: I'm always late for training sessions,\ntoo!\pI hate to say it, but I'm wimpy…

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Okay, I'll try to put a little more\neffort into things from now on…

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text:
Our leader told us to dig into
MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug.\pAnd in the course of digging, we came
across something that blew our minds!\pWhat did we find?\pFuhahaha!
I'll tell you if you beat me!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Arrgh!\nTaken down!

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: I won't tell you after all.\nYou'll find out when you get there!\pIt'd be better if you saved surprises\nto the end, don't you think?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro
text:
What, what, what?\pOnly TEAM MAGMA members are supposed
to be in here!\pBut you're not dressed in TEAM MAGMA's
uniform…\pYou rouse my suspicion!
Battle with me!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Defeat
text: Aiyiyi…\nMy pride as a TEAM MAGMA member…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14PostBattle
text: If you suffer from chills, you should\njoin TEAM MAGMA.

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: Hold it right there!\pYou don't really expect me to keep\nmy trap shut and let you waltz by me?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Ooh wow!\nI concede!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: Maybe it would've been better if I did\njust let you go unchallenged…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: Ahah!\nAn intruder!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: Graaah!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: I've already lost.\pDo I really need to keep running\naround in a circle?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Intro
text: Oh, oh!\nAn intruder!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: Mutter…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
text: Actually, I'm no expert at battling…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro
text: I don't have a bone to pick with you.\nI'm just following orders!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Defeat
text: I may have lost, but…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattle
text: We dug up something beyond belief!\nAnd, we got the BLUE ORB!\pAll that's left is for our leader to…\nFufufu… Fwahahaha!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro
text: I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've\njoined TEAM AQUA instead…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat
text: Yeah, I really may not be right for\nTEAM MAGMA…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
text: Don't you get lonely for the sea\nbeing in a place like this?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
text: You can hear tremors here sometimes.\pCould it be the volcano rattling?\nOr is it GROU…\pWhoops!\nNo, no, never mind!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat
text: You're a fiery battler.\nJust like a volcano!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
text: You just happened to win this time,\nbut that doesn't matter.\pTEAM MAGMA's goal is about to be\nreached!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro
text: One of our guys was freaking out that\nhe lost his MAGMA EMBLEM…\pWait a minute!\nWas it you who found it?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Defeat
text: I'm having trouble believing this…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
text: I'm getting this feeling that our plan\nis going to end in failure…

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro
text: What did I do to deserve this guard\nposting?\pMy left ear is burning up!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Defeat
text: I'm getting heat exhaustion…

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9PostBattle
text: Do you think it's odd that we're wearing\nhoods in this magma-filled volcano?

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro
text:
We joined so we can help our leader
achieve his fantastic vision.\pI don't care if you're with TEAM AQUA
or if you're just some kid passing by.\pNo one interferes with us and gets
away with it!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Defeat
text: Oh, no!\nYou're not to be trusted at all!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattle
text: Listen to me.\nTEAM MAGMA is right!\pDon't listen to TEAM AQUA.\nDon't believe their lies!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
text:
I understand everything our leader
says. But you know what?\pDoing stuff like digging up a super-
ancient POKéMON and ripping off\lsomeone's METEORITE…\pI think we're going a little too far.
What do you think?

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat
text: Yeah, I think we are doing something\nwrong somehow.

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattle
text: You know, losing to you cleared my mind.\pThe next time I see our leader,\nI'm going to ask him about what we do.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
text: I want to see GROUDON, too, but they\nwon't let me see even its tail…\pIt's got me feeling really frustrated.\pOh, no!\nI blabbed about GROUDON!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat
text: I guess it's impossible to win if one\ndoesn't have a calm mind…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle
text: I wonder if GROUDON even has a tail?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro
text: Fuhahaha!\nSoon! Very soon!\lOur grand objective will be achieved!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat
text: Grrr…\nI've come so far, but now this?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle
text: MAXIE, sir!\nAn intruder is headed your way!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro
text: You're not finished yet!\nYou're not getting by me easily!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat
text: Was I that easy to knock down?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13PostBattle
text: C-come on, one more match…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
text:
Hehehe!
You made it this far, so I'll tell you!\pThat's right!
Up ahead, GROUDON is sleeping!\pMAXIE went to GROUDON just seconds
ago!\pIt's going to awaken real soon!
Hehe! Hehehe!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaDefeat
text: Taken down again…\nHehe…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle
text: …And while you wasted time with me,\nMAXIE should have awakened GROUDON…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
text:
MAXIE: GROUDON…\pNothing could awaken you from your
sleep bathed in magma…\pThis BLUE ORB is what you sought.
Wasn't it?\pI have brought you the BLUE ORB.
Let its shine awaken you!\pAnd show me…
Show me the full extent of your power!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
text: MAXIE: GROUDON!\nWhat's wrong?\pWasn't the BLUE ORB the key?\pGROUDON!\nWhere have you gone…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
text: MAXIE: Oh, so it was you?\pI've seen you poking around uninvited\nhere and there…\pI get it now!\nYou must have pulled a cheap stunt!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat
text: What makes you so adept at handling\nPOKéMON?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
text:
MAXIE: There has to be some reason
why GROUDON fled…\pThat's what you're trying to say,
aren't you?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pHumph…
You think I didn't know that?\pWith GROUDON gone, there is no longer
any need for this blasted volcano.\pI am going after GROUDON, so this
is where we part!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy
text: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that\nthis boy's got more pep, I suppose…\lBut he's become a bit too peppy…

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
text: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?\pI want to challenge this GYM and see\nhow much better I've become.\pPlease? May I, please?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
text: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY.\pSince you started living with POKéMON,\nyou have grown quite a lot stronger.\pBut don't you think you're pushing it\nto suddenly challenge a GYM?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone
text: WALLY: I'm not pushing it.\pIf I combine forces with RALTS,\nwe can beat anyone!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
text:
WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten a lot stronger since
we met.\p{PLAYER}, I want you and my UNCLE to
understand that.\p{PLAYER}, please, will you have
a battle with me?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowImStrong
text: WALLY: Oh… If you won't battle me,\n{PLAYER}, my UNCLE won't know that I've\lbecome really strong.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally
text: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it?\nOn WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to\lbattle with him just this once?\pI don't think he's going to listen to\nany reason the way he is now.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPleaseBattleMe
text: WALLY: {PLAYER}, please!\nBattle with me, please.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome
text: WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you.\pOkay… Here I come!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdanturf
text: WALLY: UNCLE…\nI'll go back to VERDANTURF…

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBattle
text: {PLAYER}, thank you.\nBeing a TRAINER is tough, isn't it?\pIt's not enough just to have POKéMON\nand make them battle. That isn't what\lbeing a real TRAINER is about.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
text:
UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so
down on yourself.\pWhy, what's keeping you from becoming
stronger and stronger?\pCome on, let's go home.
Everyone's waiting for you.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime
text: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me\nthat you must be the TRAINER who kept\lan eye out for WALLY when he caught\lhis POKéMON.\pWhy don't you visit us in VERDANTURF\nsometime?\lI'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
text:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pWALLY: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!\pI just wanted to tell you that
my uncle bought me a POKéNAV!\pNow I can get in touch with you
anytime, {PLAYER}!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RegisteredWally
text: Registered WALLY\nin the POKéNAV.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
text:
SCOTT: Hehe…
I was watching that match!\pYou're friends with that boy WALLY,
aren't you?\pBut you didn't hold anything back
and beat him impressively.\pYeah! That's what a real POKéMON
battle is all about!\pI idolize TRAINERS like that!\p… … … … … …
I'll be cheering for you!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
text:
WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You look like you have a lot of zip!\lThat's a good thing, wahahahaha!\pFine! I've decided!
I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pMAUVILLE CITY has an underground
sector called NEW MAUVILLE.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and
switch off the GENERATOR.\pThe GENERATOR has been running a bit
haywire. It's getting unsafe.\pHere, this is the KEY to get into
NEW MAUVILLE.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
text:
WATTSON: Don't you worry about it.
It won't be a challenge to you.\pThe entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just
a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.\pThat's it, then, you have my trust!
Wahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
text: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pI knew it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I knew I'd made\nthe right choice asking you!\pThis is my thanks--a TM containing\nTHUNDERBOLT!\pGo on, you've earned it!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
text: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pIt pleases me to no end to see\nthe young step up and take charge!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHealth
text: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON\nbattles and stuff…\pBut if your POKéMON gets hurt,\nyou have to nurse it back to health.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeThrough
text: The roads of this town stretch north\nand south, and east and west.\pBecause of that, we get all sorts of\npeople coming through.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous
text: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet?\pRYDEL, the owner, is a very generous\nman.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBike
text: Even if you're riding a BIKE,\nwild POKéMON could jump you.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign
text: MAUVILLE CITY\n“The bright and shiny city of fun!”

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign
text: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WATTSON\l“The cheerfully electrifying man!”

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BikeShopSign
text: “Ride in gravel and shake up your\nsoul!”\lRYDEL'S CYCLES

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GameCornerSign
text: “The play spot for all!”\nMAUVILLE GAME CORNER

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
text:
Hi, do you check out TV at all?\pThey've added a bunch of cool new
shows recently.\pTV is so cool. I've seen my friends on
TV just out of the blue.\pAnd, sometimes, they even put you on TV
without telling you.\pI wish I would be on TV sometime.\pThat's why I think you should check
out TVs whenever you can.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BeenCheckingOutTV
text: Hi, have you been checking out TVs?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
text: Well, well, what have we here?\nA most energetic customer!\pMe? You may call me RYDEL.\nI'm the owner of this cycle shop.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
text: RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES…\nThey're awfully filthy.\pDid you come from far away?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
text: RYDEL: Is that right?\pThen, I guess you have no need for\nany of my BIKES.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
text:
RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …\pYou're saying that you came all this
way from LITTLEROOT?\pMy goodness!
That's ridiculously far!\pIf you had one of my BIKES, you could
go anywhere easily while feeling the\lgentle caress of the wind!\pI'll tell you what!
I'll give you a BIKE!\pOh, wait a second!\pI forgot to tell you that there are
two kinds of BIKES!\pThey are the MACH BIKE and
the ACRO BIKE!\pThe MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want
to feel the wind with their bodies!\pAnd an ACRO BIKE is for those who
prefer technical rides!\pI'm a real sweetheart, so you can
have whichever one you like!\pWhich one will you choose?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseMachBike
text: {PLAYER} chose the MACH BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseAcroBike
text: {PLAYER} chose the ACRO BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwitchBikes
text: RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch\nBIKES, just come see me!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchBikes
text: RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about\nswitching BIKES?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBikes
text: RYDEL: Okay, no problem!\nI'll switch BIKES for you!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMachForAcro
text: {PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged\nfor an ACRO BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcroForMach
text: {PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged\nfor a MACH BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeIt
text: RYDEL: Good, good!\nI'm happy that you like it!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
text:
Oh? What happened to that BIKE
I gave you?\pOh, I get it, you stored it using your PC.\pWell, take it out of PC storage,
and I'll be happy to exchange it!\pMay the wind always be at your back
on your adventure!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
text: I'm learning about BIKES while\nI work here.\pIf you need advice on how to ride your\nBIKE, there're a couple handbooks in\lthe back.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
text: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE.\pWhich page do you want to read?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
text: A BIKE moves in the direction that\nthe + Control Pad is pressed.\pIt will speed up once it gets rolling.\pTo stop, release the + Control Pad.\nThe BIKE will slow to a stop.\pWant to read a different page?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
text:
A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't
stop very quickly.\pIt gets a little tricky to get around
a corner.\pRelease the + Control Pad a little
before the corner and slow down.\pWant to read a different page?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
text:
There are small sandy slopes
throughout the HOENN region.\pThe loose, crumbly sand makes it
impossible to climb normally.\pBut if you have a MACH BIKE, you can
zip up a sandy slope.\pWant to read a different page?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
text: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE.\pWhich page do you want to read?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
text: Press the B Button while riding,\nand the front wheel lifts up.\pYou can zip around with the front\nwheel up using the + Control Pad.\pThis technique is called a wheelie.\pWant to read a different page?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
text: Keeping the B Button pressed,\nyour BIKE can hop on the spot.\pThis technique is called a bunny hop.\pYou can ride while hopping, too.\pWant to read a different page?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
text:
Press the B Button and the + Control
Pad at the same time to jump.\pPress the + Control Pad to the side
to jump sideways.\pPress it backwards to make the BIKE
change directions while jumping.\pWant to read a different page?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThisIsMauvilleGameCorner
text: This is MAUVILLE GAME CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseForCoins
text: Okay, you wanted some COINS for\nthe games?\pBut you don't have a COIN CASE for\nstowing the COINS.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLookingForCoins
text: Were you looking for COINS?\pIt's ¥1000 for 50 COINS.\nWould you like some?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThankYouHereAreYourCoins
text: Thank you very much!\nHere are your COINS!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
text: Um… You don't appear to have\nenough money…

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsFull
text: Oh?\nYour COIN CASE is full.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoinsThen
text: Oh… You don't need COINS, then?\nGood luck on your adventure!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoinsForPrizes
text: Welcome.\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nprizes here.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WhichPrize
text: Which prize would you like?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsTheTMX
text: So your choice is\nthe {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourHomePC
text: Thank you!\nWe'll send it to your PC at home.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NotEnoughCoins
text: You don't have enough COINS.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForPlacingDecor
text: There isn't any room available for\nplacing {STR_VAR_1}.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_OhIsThatSo
text: Oh, is that so? \nYou need to save some COINS before\lcoming back here.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsX
text: So your choice is {STR_VAR_1}?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo
text: Here you go!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantCarryAnyMore
text: Oh, you can't carry any more than that.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSameDollWantOne
text: I made a mistake and got two of\nthe same DOLLS.\pWould you like one of them?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo2
text: Here you go!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_YouWantItButNotNow
text: Huh?\nYou want it, but not right now?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegative
text: Oh, don't be so negative!\nYou can have this!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJackpot
text: There's a prize I want, but I can't win\nthe jackpot.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseGoNextDoor
text: Hey, kid, if you want to play here,\nyou need a COIN CASE.\pI think the young lady next door\nhad one. Go see her!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLastSoLongTakeCoins
text: My luck can only last so long.\nThis is too much for me.\lHere, take some COINS!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSomethingForEveryone
text: MAUVILLE has something for\neveryone.\pFor me, it's the GAME CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTablesDifferentRates
text: The ROULETTE tables have different\nrates.\pCheck your COINS if you're going to\npick a table.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseTrackOfTime
text: It's easy to lose track of time in here. \nI should get back to work.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinsAreNeededToPlay
text: COINS are needed to play here\nin the GAME CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnlyLuck
text: This ROULETTE thing…\nIt's rather demanding.\pWin or lose, it's only by luck.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_UpTo3CoinsCanBeUsed
text: Up to three COINS can be used to play\nthe SLOTS.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultToStopOn7
text: It's very difficult to make it stop\nright on “7.”\pIf it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME\nbonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
text:
Here's some information for you
about the SLOTS.\pThe more lightning bolts you stock,
the more REEL TIME chances you get.\pIn a game with the maximum five
REEL TIME chances…\pIt is possible to receive four regular
bonuses, then a big bonus.\pThat would total 660 COINS, but it's
very difficult to get.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantPlayWithNoCoinCase
text: You can't play if you don't have\na COIN CASE.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pWATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE
GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.\pIf you challenge him with WATER-type
POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!\pAnd, he's put in switch-controlled
doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!\pHey, go for it!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Whoa, you're electrifying!\nYou've powered the door open!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
text: My electric soul, it'll shatter your\ndreams whole, whoa-yeahah!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
text: That was plugged in, amped up,\nover-driven electric, man!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
text: POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart,\nwhoa-yeah!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
text: I trained under WATTSON!\nThere ain't no way I'll lose easily!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
text: Unplugged and turned off…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
text: WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been\naround for a long, long time.\pHe was battling even before your\ndaddy was born, that tough coot.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro
text: This GYM's got puzzles!\nIsn't it fun?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenDefeat
text: It's no fun to lose…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle
text: WATTSON says he likes setting up\nlittle traps with switches.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro
text: With my charm and my POKéMON's moves,\nyou'll be shocked!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianDefeat
text: I'm shocked by your power!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
text: I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded\nby WATTSON.\pHe was a TRAINER long before we\nbecame TRAINERS.\lHe must know all sorts of things!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloIntro
text: I love shiny things!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloDefeat
text: Oh…\nMy eyes are frazzled…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle
text: MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny\nforehead. It makes me happy!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
text:
I've given up on my plans to convert
the city, I have.\pAnd so, I put my time into making
door traps in my GYM.\pOh? Now, what are you doing here?\pWhat's that? You say you've gotten
past all my rigged doors?\pWahahahah!
Now, that is amusing!\pThen, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of
MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
text: Wahahahah!\nFine, I lost!\pYou ended up giving me a thrill!\nTake this BADGE!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE\nfrom WATTSON.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
text:
With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can
use ROCK SMASH out of battle.\pAnd, it will make your POKéMON a little
bit faster, too.\pHmm…
You should take this, too!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
text: That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.\pIt's a trustworthy move that never\nmisses! You can count on it!\p… … … … … …

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson
text: Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON\nin the POKéNAV.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle
text: I swell with optimism, seeing a promising\nyoung TRAINER like you!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndEndeavor
text: Wahahahah!\nGo forth and endeavor, youngster!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\pWATTSON'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch
text: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!\nI know what you want.\lYou want to battle my POKéMON!\pWahahahaha!\pI'll make sparks fly from you!\nDon't say I didn't warn you!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchDefeat
text: Oof…\nOur batteries ran dry…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
text:
WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our
batteries again.\pWhen we're fully charged up, we'll
gladly accept your challenge.\pSo, come back again sometime,
won't you?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!
I know what you want.\lYou want to battle my POKéMON!\pWahahahaha!\pOops! Wait!
You've only one POKéMON with you!\pCome see me with two or more
POKéMON, all right?

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
text:
Woohoo!\pI hear people call me the ROCK SMASH
GUY, but I find that sort of degrading.\pI think I deserve a bit more respect,
like maybe the ROCK SMASH DUDE.\pWoohoo!\pAnyways, your POKéMON look pretty
strong.\pI like that!
Here, take this HIDDEN MACHINE!

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmash
text:
That HM contains ROCK SMASH.\pIf you come across large boulders
that block your path…\pWell, use that HM move and smash
them right out of your way!\pYes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say!
Woohoo!

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_MonCanFlyOutOfSmashedRock
text: Oh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON\ncould come flying out of hiding.\pWoohoo!

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
text: If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to\nSLATEPORT for some shopping.\pI'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the\nPOKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMailForCoinCase
text: Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL?\nWill you trade it for a COIN CASE?

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoinCase
text: Oh, I'm so happy!\nOkay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGameCorner
text: That COIN CASE can be used\nat the GAME CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
text: Oh, that's disappointing.\pA COIN CASE is needed for the\nGAME CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
text:
There are items that temporarily
elevate the stats of POKéMON.\pThe ones I know you use in battle
are X ATTACK and X DEFEND…\pI do believe that there are others
like them.

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermineBattle
text: Use a certain move, or use an item\ninstead…\pThe TRAINER's decisions determine how\nbattles turn out, I think.

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOverThereSaysWeirdThings
text: That man over there, he says weird\nthings!\pHe's funny in a weird way.\nI doubt I'll forget about him!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDataUpdatedFromRecordCorner
text: When I accessed the RECORD CORNER,\nthe data for what's hot in DEWFORD\lgot updated.\pNow that bit of data is the same\nas my friend's!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerSoundsFun
text: A RECORD CORNER opened upstairs in\nthe POKéMON CENTER.\pI don't know what it's about, but it\nsounds fun. I'll go check it out!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Youngster
text:
Did you know that you can link battle
at the COLOSSEUM here?\pThey put up your record on the wall
for everyone to see.\pIt's embarrassing if you lose more
often than you win…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
text: Hehehe!\pWith this METEORITE, that thing in\nMT. CHIMNEY will…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
text: Heh?\pI don't know who you are, but if you get\nin the way of TEAM MAGMA, don't\lexpect any mercy!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
text: Hold it right there, TEAM MAGMA!\pYou're badly mistaken if you think you\ncan have your way with the world!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
text:
Hehehe!
Even TEAM AQUA joins us!\pBut it's too much trouble to deal with
you all…\pHeh, it doesn't matter!\pWe've got the METEORITE, so off to
MT. CHIMNEY we go!\pHehehe! Be seeing you, you TEAM
AQUA dingbats!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
text:
ARCHIE: Didn't I see you before?
At SLATEPORT's MUSEUM?\pAh, so your name is {PLAYER}.\pAt the time, I thought you were one
of TEAM MAGMA's goons.\pHumph…
You're one odd kid.\pTEAM MAGMA is a dangerous group of
total fanatics.\pThey engage in destruction, claiming
to expand the land mass.\pThey are the rivals to us,
the sea-loving TEAM AQUA!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BossWeShouldChaseMagma
text: BOSS, we should give chase to\nTEAM MAGMA…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
text: ARCHIE: Yes, yes, we must!\nWe've got to hurry.\pThere's no telling what TEAM MAGMA\nwill do at MT. CHIMNEY!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
text: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, you should keep\nan eye out for TEAM MAGMA, too.\pFarewell!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
text:
I… I'm COZMO…
I'm a PROFESSOR…\pTEAM MAGMA asked me to guide them
to METEOR FALLS…\pBut they tricked me.
They even took my METEORITE away…\pAnd then another similar bunch,
TEAM AQUA showed up.\pAfter that…
I don't understand any of it.\pBut that TEAM MAGMA…\pWhat are they going to do with that
METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WhatsTeamMagmaDoingAtMtChimney
text: PROF. COZMO: But that TEAM MAGMA…\pWhat are they going to do with that\nMETEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro
text: This is where we DRAGON users do our\ntraining.\pThe CHAMPION even visits.\nNow do you see how special it is here?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasDefeat
text: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
text: The road ahead remains long and harsh.\pWhen will my POKéMON and I become\nthe best?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRegister
text: I want to know more about your power.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
text: Since we met, we have trained hard\nwith our sights on number one.\pHelp us see how much stronger we've\nbecome!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchDefeat
text: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematch
text: You've obviously kept up your\nPOKéMON training.\pSo long as you remain strong, I, too,\ncan become stronger!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnIntro
text: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\lWe've confidence in ourselves.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnDefeat
text: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle
text: JOHN: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pCome to think of it, I've yet to beat\nmy dear wife in a battle.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons
text: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\pWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRegister
text: JOHN: Young TRAINER, if the chance\narises, will you battle with us again?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro
text: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pThe bond we share as a couple could\nnever be broken.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayDefeat
text: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle
text: JAY: Fifty years of marriage…\pIf we ever argued, we always settled\nit with a POKéMON battle…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons
text: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\pIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchIntro
text: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\lWe've confidence in ourselves.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchDefeat
text: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch
text: JOHN: Married for fifty years…\pOn reflection, the dear wife and I,\nwe battled day in and day out…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEnoughMons
text: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\pWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro
text: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pWe've supported each other all that\ntime. We've made ourselves strong.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchDefeat
text: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch
text: JAY: Fifty years of marriage…\nMany things have happened.\pI hope that we will continue to make\nhappy memories together.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnoughMons
text: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\pIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
text:
STEVEN: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I'm amazed you knew where to find me.\pDo you, uh…maybe think of me as
just a rock maniac?\pNo, that can't be right.\pWe battled alongside each other at
the SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER.\pYou should have a very good idea
about how good I am.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount
a serious challenge, expect the worst!

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_StevenDefeat
text: You…\nI had no idea you'd become so strong…

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
text:
STEVEN: Come to think of it, ever since
our paths first crossed in GRANITE\lCAVE in DEWFORD, I had this feeling.\pI thought that you would eventually
become the CHAMPION.\pMy predictions usually come true.\pAnd where will you go from here?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pFufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeRootFossil
text: You found the ROOT FOSSIL.\pIf this FOSSIL is taken, the ground\naround it will likely crumble away…\pTake the ROOT FOSSIL anyway?

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_LeftRootFossilAlone
text: {PLAYER} left the ROOT FOSSIL alone.

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeClawFossil
text: You found the CLAW FOSSIL.\pIf this FOSSIL is taken, the ground\naround it will likely crumble away…\pTake the CLAW FOSSIL anyway?

label: MirageTower_4F_Text_LeaveClawFossilAlone
text: {PLAYER} left the CLAW FOSSIL alone.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGaveMe
text: I got this from STEVEN, but I don't\nknow what it's good for.\pI think it's called KING'S ROCK.\nDo you want it?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt
text: Why would you want it?\nYou're weird.\pYou can keep it, but keep it a secret\nfrom STEVEN.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere
text: STEVEN's house is right over there!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock
text: Yeah, you think so, too! What are you\nsupposed to do with some weird rock?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
text: Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild\nWAILMER.\pIt's called, uh…\nWhat was it now…\pWAI, WAI, WAI…\pWAILMER watching!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLetter
text: The island's SPACE CENTER has been\nlaunching huge rockets.\pThere's been some kind of an uproar\nover a letter they received recently.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRockets
text: The island's SPACE CENTER has been\nlaunching huge rockets.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
text:
I heard from a SAILOR buddy that
TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.\pI also heard that someone came along
and wiped the floor with them!\pBut MOSSDEEP here's been targeted
by that TEAM MAGMA.\pIf you want to know what they're up to,
go visit the SPACE CENTER.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand
text: I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously\nmore important to me.\pBut you know? When I get back on land\nafter a long voyage, I do feel relief!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFlowers
text: Wouldn't it be nice?\pIf the whole world was covered in\nplants and flowers like this island?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
text:
All life needs the sea to live, even
though it makes its home on the land.\pLife, having run its course, becomes
soil and returns to the land.\pAnd the sea is always connected to
the land.\pYes, like the very shoreline here.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
text: A voyage on a ship is fine.\pBut crossing the sea with POKéMON\nusing SURF…\pNow that's an exhilarating trip!\nWouldn't you agree, youngster?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
text:
This rock has a special meaning to
the people at the SPACE CENTER.\pThey put it here as their wish for
their rockets to fly safely.\pWhen you make a wish, what do you use?
Do you wish upon a star?\pI use a wish tag to make it happen.
That's what I do.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ItsAWhiteRock
text: It's a white rock.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign
text: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADERS: LIZA & TATE\p“The mystic combination!”

label: MossdeepCity_Text_CitySign
text: MOSSDEEP CITY\n“Our slogan: Cherish POKéMON!”

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign
text: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER\n“The closest place to space.”

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
text:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good?
I'm doing great!\pI'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is
pretty strong, so I decided to come\ltake a look-see for myself.\pBut there's something wrong about
this town.\pPeople are going on about a warning
letter and the SPACE CENTER…\pI don't think it concerns me in any
way, though.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
text:
Ahh… It feels great letting the waves
wash over my feet…\pSpeaking of the waves, you know that
island city SOOTOPOLIS?\pI think the GYM there had a new
LEADER come in.\pPeople tell me the new LEADER once
mentored WALLACE.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_OldManGreeting
text: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\pNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\lTRAINERS battle.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_DoorIsLocked
text: The door appears to be locked.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
text: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is\nvisiting my home.\pWould you like to challenge\n{STR_VAR_1}?

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_YouWontBattle
text: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle…

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3
text: Oh, good, good!\pBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\pCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_SaveYourProgress
text: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_HopeToSeeAGoodMatch
text: I hope to see a good match!

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleTie
text: So, it became a standoff.\pIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleWon
text: That was superlative!\pWhy, it was like seeing myself in\nmy youth again!

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleLost
text: Ah, too bad for you!\pBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound
{PLAYER}?\pThe GYM LEADERS here use
PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.\pIf you go up against them with
FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON,\lthey'll inflict horrible damage!\pPlus, they'll come at you with
outstanding combination attacks.\pIf you want to win, you'll need to show
them how tight you are with your\lPOKéMON. Go for it!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Wow, you're astounding!\nYou're one great TRAINER!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
text: Battles hinge on the strength of your\nspirit! The weak-spirited will never win!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat
text: I lost!\nI must temper my spirit again!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
text: The indecisive lose.\nThat's my warning to you.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilIntro
text: Let me see your talent!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilDefeat
text: You possess spectacular talent!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
text: If there are prodigies in the world,\nthen our GYM LEADERS are them!\pHowever, you may be even more talented\nthan them…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
text: Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé\nBALL telekinetically!\pWrooooooooaaaar!\n… … … … … … …\pSometimes, I'm out of sync…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat
text: My POKéMON battling skills are out\nof sync, too!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
text:
A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift
psychically. But this dust bunny…\pWhoooooooooooooooh!
… … … … … …\pNo, I'm not cheating!
I didn't blow on it! Honestly!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
text: When you lose to me, don't be too hard\non yourself.\pIt's not that you're weak--I'm just\ntoo strong!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahDefeat
text: You're just too strong!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
text: I'm not going to get down on myself for\nlosing. I just need to train harder.\pPositive thinking--that's my strong\npoint!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
text: I see it…\nI see your future…\pIf you can beat me, I will tell you\nyour future!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaDefeat
text: I surrender!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
text: You will wage a terrifically intense\nbattle with our GYM LEADERS…\pThe result…\nYou won't hear it from me!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
text: The roads you have traveled…\nWhat you have experienced…\pCome at me with everything you've\nlearned!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat
text: You've traveled a path of greatness!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
text: A bright future awaits those who have\nworked diligently.\pFor those who lazed idly, there is\nonly despair at the end.\pWhat goes around comes around…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro
text: Even at the risk of life, I will win\nthis battle!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat
text: What you do…\nIt horrifies me…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
text: How dare you beat me…\pIt won't be my fault if something\nhorrible befalls you…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
text: Hohoho.\pYou need me to show you how tenacious\nthe PSYCHIC type can be.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
text: Oh! My, my!\nYour battle style is fantastic!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
text: I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me,\nhowever b-badly.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro
text: Let me show you a perfectly awful,\nhorrifying time!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenDefeat
text: N-nooooo!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle
text: Your vitality is contagious!\nGet away from me quickly!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro
text: I may be past my prime, but I suggest\nyou not patronize me.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordDefeat
text: Ah, you overflow with the power\nof youth!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle
text: It seems that I could not overcome\nyour youthful energy.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro
text: You're not getting through to the end!\nNot if I can help it!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyDefeat
text: How could you be so ludicrously\nstrong?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle
text: Humph! You may be strong, but you're\nnot suitable for the PSYCHIC type!\pThe way you battle is somehow brutal!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro
text: Wroooar! Have a taste of my super\nPOKéMON hard-battling power!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasDefeat
text: Oh!\nDone in!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle
text: All right! I think I'll develop a special\ninvincible POKéMON power next.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
text:
TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?\pLIZA: Fufufu… Were you surprised?\pTATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\pTATE: We're twins!
LIZA: We're twins!\pTATE: We don't need to talk because…
LIZA: We can each determine what…\pTATE: The other is thinking…
LIZA: All in our minds!\pTATE: This combination of ours…
LIZA: Can you beat it?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat
text: TATE: What?! Our combination…\nLIZA: Was shattered!\pTATE: It can't be helped. You've won…\nLIZA: So, in recognition, take this.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE\nfrom TATE and LIZA.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
text: TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the\nSP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.\pLIZA: It also lets you use the HM move\nDIVE outside of battle.\pTATE: You should also take this, too.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind
text:
TATE: That TM04 contains…
LIZA: CALM MIND!\pTATE: It raises SP. ATK and…
LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!\pTATE: It's a move that's perfect…
LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!\p… … … … … …

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndLiza
text: Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA\nin the POKéNAV.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBattle
text: TATE: Looks like the bond between you\nand your POKéMON is far stronger than\lthe bond that we share as twins.\pLIZA: You will become even stronger!\nWe've battled you, so we know.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwoMons
text: TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?\pLIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\pTATE: Oops, you have only one…\nLIZA: POKéMON that can battle.\pTATE: We can't battle that way!\pLIZA: If you want to challenge us,\nbring some more POKéMON.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
text: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM\pLIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRematch
text:
TATE: POKéMON…
LIZA: POKéMON…\pTATE: By changing the party's mix…
LIZA: The battle style changes.\pTATE: But me…
LIZA: But me…\pTATE: I'll always be with LIZA!
LIZA: I'll always be with TATE!\pTATE: Our combination…
LIZA: We'll show you again and again!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchDefeat
text: TATE: You and your POKéMON…\nLIZA: It's as if you were siblings!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRematch
text: TATE: You can knock us down,\nbut we'll never stay down!\pLIZA: Because the two of us,\nwe always support each other!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
TATE: You're back again…
LIZA: You're back again…\pTATE: To give us a rematch.
LIZA: To give us a rematch.\pTATE: But…
LIZA: For our match…\pTATE: You brought just one POKéMON!
LIZA: You brought just one POKéMON!\pTATE: We need you to bring at least…
LIZA: Two POKéMON when you come back.

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HmmYourPokemon
text: Hmm!\nYour {STR_VAR_1}…

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblocks
text: It likes {STR_VAR_1}S,\ndoesn't it?\pNo, I'm positive of it! It definitely\nlikes {STR_VAR_1}S!

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_DoesntLikeOrDislikePokeblocks
text: It doesn't appear to like or dislike\nany {POKEBLOCK}S.

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HusbandCanTellPokeblockMonLikes
text: My husband can tell what kind of\n{POKEBLOCK}S a POKéMON likes at a glance.

label: MossdeepCity_House2_Text_SisterMailsBoyfriendInFortree
text: My little sister exchanges MAIL with\nher boyfriend in FORTREE.\pI don't envy her one bit at all.

label: MossdeepCity_House2_Text_PokemonCarriesMailBackAndForth
text: Even though I can't see my friend in\nFORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL\lback and forth for us.\pI'm not lonesome, even though we're\napart.

label: MossdeepCity_House2_Text_Wingull
text: WINGULL: Pihyoh!

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod
text:
Hey there, TRAINER!
A SUPER ROD really is super!\pSay all you want, but this baby can
catch POKéMON off the seafloor!\pWhat do you think?
You want it, don't you?

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_SuperRodIsSuper
text: You bet, you bet!\nAfter all, a SUPER ROD is really super!

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_TryDroppingRodInWater
text: If there's any water, try dropping in\nyour ROD and see what bites!

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
text: Hunh?\nDon't you like to fish?

label: MossdeepCity_House3_Text_GoAfterSeafloorPokemon
text: Go after the seafloor POKéMON with\nyour SUPER ROD.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToFindBases
text: My little brother says he likes to go\nfind people's SECRET BASES.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToVisitBasesAndBattle
text: My little brother says he likes to\nvisit people's SECRET BASES and have\lPOKéMON battles.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBaseNearX
text: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE\nnear {STR_VAR_1}?

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase
text: You should make a SECRET BASE\nsomewhere. I'll go find it!

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_Skitty
text: SKITTY: Miyaan?

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic
text: REVIVE is fantastic!\pGive it to a fainted POKéMON,\nand the POKéMON will arise.\pBut be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore\nthe used-up PP of moves.

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLongest
text: MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.\pOut of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts\nthe longest.

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRare
text:
The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé
BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.\pA NET BALL is effective against
BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.\pA DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON
at the bottom of the sea.

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymLeaderDuoFormidable
text: The GYM LEADERS in this town are\na formidable duo.\pTheir combination attacks are, like,\nexcellent and wow!

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AbilitiesMightChangeMoves
text: Depending on the special abilities of\nPOKéMON, some moves might change\lor not work at all.

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Woman5
text: If I win a whole lot of link battles\nand show everyone how good I am,\lI might get a fan following!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchImminent
text: The rocket's launch is imminent!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_SuccessfulLaunchNumber
text: The rocket launched safely!\nThat's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
text: I know that things are a little\nhaywire right now, but…\pThe rocket's launch is imminent!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
text: I know that things are a little\nhaywire right now, but…\pThe rocket launched safely!\nThat's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
text:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.\pEven if it's 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be no good.\pDespite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It's a dream that never ends.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
text: Those MAGMA thugs have their sights\nset on our SPACE CENTER.\pBut we can't allow anything that minor\nto interfere with our rocket launch!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundThisYouCanHaveIt
text: I was taking a stroll down the beach\nwhen I found this.\pIt's not anything I need, so you can\nhave it.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFamousForMeteorShowers
text: The HOENN region has been famous for \nits meteor showers for a long time.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
text: TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal\nthe rocket fuel.\pOh, by the way, you can have this stone\nI found on the beach.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStrollOnBeachWithMagma
text: With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess\nstrolls on the beach aren't safe.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPokemonComeFromSpace
text: Some people claim that POKéMON came\nfrom space. Could it be true?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaShouldBeatMagma
text: TEAM AQUA should take care of\nTEAM MAGMA!\pBut if they did that, TEAM AQUA will\nbecome bold and brazen, won't they?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
text: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space…\pIt boggles my mind!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
text: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space…\pBut TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil\nthat dream of mine!\pI'm not having any of that!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
text:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that
proclamation already?\pTEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket
fuel on this island.\pI don't know what they'd need it for,
but they can't be allowed to take it.\pI'll keep an eye on things for
a while longer.\pIn the meantime, why don't you go
check out the town?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
text: As promised, we've come for\nthe rocket fuel!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
text: Ran out of fuel…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
text: Don't think you're on a roll just\nbecause you've beaten me!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
text: We gave you fair warning!\nThere's nothing sneaky about us!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
text: Grrr…\nWe should've used sneaky treachery…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
text: Okay, I get it already! The next time,\nwe'll come unannounced.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
text: The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has\nin storage--that's what we're after.\pWe mean to take every last bit of it!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
text: Please, can you spare some fuel?\nEven a chintzy cup will do!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
text: What are we going to do with\nthe rocket fuel?\pHow would I know?\nAsk our leader upstairs!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
text: Our leader said no one, but no one,\ngets past me!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
text: Ack! Ack! Aaack!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
text: Please, tell our leader that\nI never abandoned my post.\lThat I stayed to the bitter end…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
text:
This is…
An intent-to-steal notice?\p“To the staff of the SPACE CENTER:
How are you? We are doing fine.\p“We will soon visit you to take your
rocket fuel.\p“Please don't try to stop us.
We will take the fuel no matter what.\p“Let there be more land!
                                          TEAM MAGMA”

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MossdeepIdealForRockets
text: MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather,\nand its winds are stable.\pIt's an ideal location for launching\nrockets.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WhyWouldMagmaStealRocketFuel
text: Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal\nour rocket fuel in the first place?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WouldveLikedToBeAstronaut
text: If only I was a little younger, I would\nhave liked being an astronaut…\pNo… It's not too late!\nI can and will try!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCantGetAwayWithThis
text: If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel,\nI won't be able to go to space!\pThey can't be allowed to get away\nwith such an outrage!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WishOrdinaryPeopleCouldGoIntoSpace
text: I wish ordinary people could go into\nspace one day…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_DoesMagmaWantToGoToSpace
text: TEAM MAGMA…\nDo they want to go to space, too?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOutnumberedTakeUsOn
text: What's wrong with you?\pYou're outnumbered three to one,\nbut you still want to take us on?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAnswer
text: Good answer!\nThat's what a smart person'll do!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
text: A reckless go-getter, are you?\nOkay, I'll go first!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
text: I lost!\nBut!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
