been feeling frisky!\pSo I've decided to help DOCK make
a ferry.\pAye, after all, a ferry would be able
to carry a lot of people.\pBut, you know, that DOCK is really
something special.\pWith his knack for technology and
my experience, I'm sure that we can\lbuild one great ship, aye!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
text:
The seasons, the weather, where
the moon sits in the sky…\pThese and other conditions make
the sea change its expression.\pThat's right!
The sea is like a living thing!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_GetSeasickEasily
text: I get seasick real easily.\nSo I get to help out here instead.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_ShipDesignMoreLikeBuilding
text: Designing a large ship is more like\nmaking a big building than putting\ltogether a transportation vehicle.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
text: Don't you think it's strange that\na ship made of heavy iron floats?\pIt floats because of a principle\ncalled buoyancy.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JUAN\p“The GYM LEADER with the beauty\nof pure water!”

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY\p“The mystical city where history\nslumbers.”

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoorIsClosed
text: The door is closed.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingHere
text: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and\ndown stairs all the time…\pIf you live in this town, you end up\ngetting physically fit.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
text:
These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared
in the middle of the city!\pAnd, I've never seen them before!\pWhy are they smashing into each
other like that?\pWhy can't they be friends, those
POKéMON?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokemon
text: What? What? What?\nWhat is that green POKéMON?!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
text: GROUDON and KYOGRE…\nWhere did they go?\pWill they cause droughts or downpours\nsomewhere else?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry
text: I just get this sense somehow that\nthe two POKéMON aren't angry.\pI think… They probably can't control\ntheir own power…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRampage
text: That flying POKéMON came down from\nthe sky and stopped the rampaging\lPOKéMON…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLike
text: I… I've never been out of this city.\pI wonder what the world is like on\nthe other side of this round sky?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThisIsWicked
text: Wow!\nThis is wicked!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThatWasWicked
text: Wow!\nThat was wicked!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon
text: Go for it, red POKéMON!\nDon't back off, blue POKéMON!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames
text: … … … … … …\pHi, do you know the names of those\nPOKéMON fighting over there?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThings
text: I was wondering which one would win,\nthe red one or the blue one, but, oh no,\lit's the green one that settles things!\pTalk about a huge turn of events!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
text:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I'm seeing that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
text:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between POKéMON.\pWell, I saw that happen with
my very own eyes!\pWhoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting
text: A big POKéMON is fighting with\nanother big POKéMON!\pPlease, someone make them stop!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky
text: A pretty POKéMON came down from\nthe sky…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrecked
text: Oh, no!\nSOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisDidntGetWrecked
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY didn't get wrecked!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist
text: Hm!\nYou've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS?\lYou're no ordinary tourist.\pBut I suppose that doesn't make you\nan extraordinary tourist, either.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm
text: The city has regained its calm…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
text: Who might you be?\pThis is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\pThe spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at\nMT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.\pPlease leave.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
text:
A person with a strong will and
superior talent…\pA TRAINER who has knowledge and
experience of many kinds of POKéMON…\pIf such a person were to appear, I was
instructed by WALLACE to lead that\lTRAINER to this CAVE.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash
text: Oh, my…\pThe clash between the two awakened\nPOKéMON was quelled by the awakening\lof a third POKéMON…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
text: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN…\pWith the passing of the crisis,\nthe cave, too, shall sleep…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
text:
SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in
the crater of a volcano.\pIf you look up at the sky, the lip of
the crater is also visible.\lSo, all you see is the sky in a circle.\pBut that's what makes the sky above
SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight
text: When two POKéMON that gigantic\nare fighting that savagely, there's\lnot much that we can do.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokemonFlewDown
text: When that third POKéMON flew down,\nI feared the worst.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScenery
text: A circle of a night sky framed by\nthe crater of a volcano…\pAnd in that ring, stars flicker and\nblink as if they were alive…\lIt's my favorite scenery.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
text:
The weather was clear this morning,
but…\pAll of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up,
rain started falling in sheets, and\lthere was thunder and lightning, too.\pThe weather just went completely
wild!\pIs all of this because of those
POKéMON?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
text: Oh?\pIt was you who brought that flying\nPOKéMON here?\pWell, aren't you amazing!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
text: MAXIE: G… GROUDON…\nPlease! Stop what you're doing!\pI know the extent of your power now!\pIf you keep going, all HOENN, not just\nSOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
text:
MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON
weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE…\pAfter all our fruitless scheming and
frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's\lsimple action puts everything right\lagain as if nothing had happened…\pFu…
Fuhahaha…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
text:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?!
Look over here! It's the RED ORB!\lCalm down! KYOGRE!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pIt's no good!
It's not responding at all!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
text:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE and GROUDON both
flew off to who knows where.\pThe weather in HOENN has returned
to its normal state…\pHaha…
Hahaha…\pMaybe what we were trying to do was
something small, even meaningless,\lto POKéMON…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
text:
STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting…
GROUDON… And KYOGRE…\pThe two super-ancient POKéMON
were awakened from a long sleep…\pAnd now they are smashing each other
with their uncontrollable energy…\p…{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pYou being here now I'll take to mean
that you're prepared to become\linvolved in this crisis.\pWell, then, there's someone that
I'd like you to meet.\pCome with me, please.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
text:
STEVEN: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pDoes seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make
you think POKéMON are to be feared?\pBut that's not true.
POKéMON are really more…\p…Why am I asking you this?
You already know.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
text: STEVEN: Okay, here we are!\pInside here you'll find someone named\nWALLACE.\pI think you have what's needed to\nhelp him…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHelpHim
text: STEVEN: I think you have what's\nneeded to help him…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar
text: STEVEN: The SKY PILLAR…\pI've never been there.\nI wonder where it could be?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
text: STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…\pIt's incredible how the two rampaging\nPOKéMON would flee from it in fear…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
text: STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and\nARCHIE have gone away somewhere.\pPerhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to\nreturn those ORBS…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
text:
WALLACE: Oh?
{PLAYER}{KUN}?\pHaven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR
yet?\pI'm sure that you can make it to
the top of the SKY PILLAR…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
text: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pThe leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA,\nI don't think they meant harm.\pIt wouldn't hurt to hear what they\nhave to say for themselves.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
text:
WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
My eyes didn't deceive me.\pThanks to your help, SOOTOPOLIS…
No, all of HOENN was saved.\pOn behalf of the people, I thank you.\pThis is a gift from me.
Please accept it.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
text:
That HIDDEN MACHINE contains
WATERFALL.\pIf you have the RAIN BADGE, a POKéMON
that has learned that HM move can\lforce its way up waterfalls.\pAnd where does one get the RAIN BADGE?
You know, don't you?\pThat's right! You have to beat
the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER.\pWhen you're all set to go, step through
that door.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor
text: WALLACE: I'm sure that you will be\ndazzled by my mentor's breathtakingly\lelegant battle style.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
text:
Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is
a master of WATER-type POKéMON.\pAnd, to get to JUAN, an icy floor
will hamper your progress…\pListen, I'm sorry, but that's all the
advice that I have for you.\pThe rest of the way, you have to
go for it yourself!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
text: Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who\nwas supposedly the best in all HOENN!\pOkay! Check out your TRAINER CARD.\pIf you've gotten all the BADGES, you're\nset for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
text:
Let me ask you.
Did you know?\lAh, I should not be so coy.\pIt was I who taught WALLACE everything
there is to know about POKéMON.\pOnce, I had given up my position as
the GYM LEADER.\pIn my place, I had entrusted WALLACE
with the GYM.\pHowever, a compelling reason arose for
me to make a comeback.\pAh, but enough chatter.
Let us begin our match, shall we?\pPlease, you shall bear witness to
our artistry.\pA grand illusion of water sculpted
by POKéMON and myself!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
text:
Ahahaha, excellent!
Very well, you are the winner.\pFrom you, I sense the brilliant shine
of skill that will overcome all.\pHowever, compared with me or even
WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance.\pPerhaps I should make you a loan
of my outfit?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pHahaha, I merely jest!\pRather than my clothes, I shall reward
you with this, the RAIN BADGE!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE\nfrom JUAN.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
text:
Having the RAIN BADGE shall assure you
the full obedience of all your POKéMON\lto your every command.\pThe RAIN BADGE also allows the use
of the HM move WATERFALL to scale\lwalls of cascading water.\pAnd, so that you never forget the
battle we shared, take this…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterPulse
text: The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you\ncontains WATER PULSE.\pIn use, it will occasionally confuse\nthe target with ultrasonic waves.\p… … … … … …

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJuan
text: Registered GYM LEADER JUAN\nin the POKéNAV.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
text:
The TRAINERS who have gathered all
the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make\lway to the ultimate destination.\pThe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pTravel to the easternmost reaches
of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.\pThere, you shall find the POKéMON
LEAGUE.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeBadge
text: There remains but one BADGE to\nobtain in HOENN.\pIf you wish to challenge the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must obtain the last\lBADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
text: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\pJUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
text:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!\pI shall be delighted to dance with you
as often as you wish!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDefeat
text: Ahahaha, you are the winner!\nYou have defeated me again!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
text:
JUAN: If I told you to become my
apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure.\pI would like to make a gift of my coat
to you.\pBut again, you will refuse.
I imagine that to be so.\pAnd that, my friend, is a certain sign
of nobility!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
text:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!
I shall be delighted to dance with you…\pAh, no, no, no.
You have with you but one POKéMON.\pI wish that you would return with
two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro
text: I'll show you the sublime techniques\nI learned from our LEADER JUAN!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaDefeat
text: Please forgive me, JUAN…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBattle
text: Watch what happens if you crack all\nthe floor tiles.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
text: You came all the way here, but you won't\nget to see JUAN.\pNot if you lose to me, you won't!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat
text: You're strong!\nI was fooled by your cute looks!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBattle
text: You might be good enough to avoid\nbeing wiped out in one hit by JUAN.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
text: The sight of JUAN conducting\na battle…\pThe very beauty of it compelled me to\nbecome a TRAINER.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat
text: You battled with more beauty than\nI could muster…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
text: The grace you bring to battle is\nfabulous.\pOh… I'm so fortunate to have found\nPOKéMON.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro
text: I should teach you how harsh battles\ncan be.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieDefeat
text: Oh.\nYou're strong.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
text: I'll tell you something good.\pIf you want to reach JUAN, you\nneed to walk on each floor tile once.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
text: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level\nin the HOENN region…\pThat's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefeat
text: What a high level you are!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostBattle
text: Rather than being satisfied by being\nin a strong GYM, I imagine training in\lother places will make you stronger.\lBut above all, it looks more fun.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
text: I train my POKéMON together with\nJUAN.\pDon't think I'm a pushover.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaDefeat
text: I was beaten…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBattle
text: I think you have potential.\nWhy don't you stay and train with us?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
text: A graceful glide across the ice while\ncrossing no lines…\pA TRAINER putting on that performance\nwould be elegantly beautiful!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyDefeat
text: Well, excuse me?!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
text: This is really obvious, but how strong\nyou are as a TRAINER has nothing to do\lwith how young or old you are.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro
text: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time\nflies by before you can say, “Oops!”

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyDefeat
text: Oops!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostBattle
text: I wish I could forget about lost causes\nbefore I can manage an “Oops!”

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro
text: I can battle with really rare POKéMON\nif you'd like.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat
text: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look\nat my POKéMON?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
text: I came to this GYM because JUAN\npraised me for my darling POKéMON.\pOh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago\nwhen I was younger…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro
text: Giggle…\nYour grim look is so charming.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefeat
text: Oh, dear.\nI went much too easy on you.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostBattle
text: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN,\nI'm sure. Giggle…

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_DevelopedThisTM
text: For thirty years I've remained in\nSOOTOPOLIS honing my skills.\pI developed a shattering TM.\nI bequeath it to you!

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainBrickBreak
text: TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move\nso horrible that I can't describe it.

label: SootopolisCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
text: KECLEON: Puu puhyaah.

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
text: MT. PYRE…\pAt its peak are two orbs placed side\nby side. Did you know?

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
text: Yes, two orbs side by side…\pThe sight of them together…\nIt is somehow soothing…

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitAndSee
text: Is that so?\nPerhaps you ought to visit and see…

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
text: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\pSOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans.\nEven more than his student WALLACE!\pDo you have any?

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePrettyStrong
text: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
text: Oh, dear…\nThat's a little lonesome.\pTry working a little harder to get\na fan following.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
text: Dedicated fans come over from even\noutside of HOENN.\pIt was really wild when I went to the\nTRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
text:
Listen up, and I'll tell you something
good.\pThere's supposed to be an ancient
ruin in the sea around here.\pThere could be treasures just waiting
to be discovered down there.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwaterWithPokemon
text: Ancient treasures…\pIt would be nice if they existed, but\neven if they didn't, it would be so\lbeautiful to take an underwater\lstroll with my POKéMON.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_Azumarill
text: AZUMARILL: Marurii.

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
text: There appears to be some connection\nbetween SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.\pMy friends and I did some research on\nit at the lab where I used to work.

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedToStudySea
text: My big brother used to study the sea.

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInWhileTakeDoll
text: Hello! You're our first guest in\na good while.\pYou've brightened up my day, so I'll\ngive you a big WAILMER DOLL.

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
text: Take good care of it!

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForYou
text: Oh, you want it, but not right now?\nOkay, then I'll hold it for you.

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisDoll
text: Are you sure?\nYou don't want this DOLL?

label: SootopolisCity_House6_Text_LovePlushDolls
text: I love plush DOLLS!

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromEruptedVolcano
text:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.\pIts crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.\pThat's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.

label: SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKeepSomething
text: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and\nthe outside world…\pIt seems as if the cave was made to\nkeep something from getting out.\pOr am I just imagining things?

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
text:
Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT?
It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pAnyway, I love big SEEDOT.
The bigger the better.\pBut my younger brother, he says that
LOTAD is bigger.\pThat's silly.
SEEDOT has to be bigger than that!\pHuh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you?
P-p-please, show me!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
text:
{STR_VAR_2}!
Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!\pIt might even beat the big LOTAD
my younger brother saw!\pThanks for showing me.
This is my thanks!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion1
text: {PLAYER} received a POTION.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull1
text: Hunh?\nYour BAG is crammed full.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerSeedot
text: {STR_VAR_2}, is it?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT\nthan this one.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotSeedot
text: Oh, now this is quite something…\nBut it's not a SEEDOT!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigSeedot
text: You don't have a big SEEDOT?\nThat's too bad…\pIf you get a big SEEDOT, please\ncome show me.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestSeedotInHistory
text: The biggest SEEDOT in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} giant!\pA SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD\nalways wanted!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
text:
Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD?
It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\pI love, I mean love, big LOTAD!\pMy big brother says that SEEDOT is
bigger.\pBut that's wrong! Everyone knows that
LOTAD is a lot bigger.\pHunh? Do you have a LOTAD?
P-p-please show me!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
text:
{STR_VAR_2}!
Wow, that is big!\pIt might be even bigger than the huge
SEEDOT my big brother saw.\pThanks for showing me!
This is my thanks!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion2
text: {PLAYER} received a POTION.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull2
text: Hunh?\nYour BAG is crammed full.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerLotad
text: {STR_VAR_2}?\pHmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD\nthan this one here.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotLotad
text: Well, isn't this something!\nBut it's no LOTAD!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigLotad
text: Don't you have a big LOTAD?\nHow disappointing…\pIf you get a big LOTAD, please\ncome show me!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestLotadInHistory
text: The biggest LOTAD in history!\n{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} colossus!\pA LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT\nalways wanted!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
text: PP UP is great!\pIt raises the POWER POINTS, the PP,\nof a POKéMON move.

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
text: What…\nWhat is happening?\pI really want to know, but it's too\nscary to go outside.

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
text: Do you know FULL RESTORE?\pFull restoration of HP!\nEradication of all status problems!\pIt's truly an item of your dreams!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_DidSomethingAwaken
text: This weather…\nDid something awaken?

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_OnlyAmusementWatchingBattles
text: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\pNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\lTRAINERS battle.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_DoorAppearsToBeLocked
text: The door appears to be locked.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
text: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1}\nis visiting my home.\pWould you like to challenge\n{STR_VAR_1}?

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_YouWontBattle
text: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle…

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_KeepItTo3On3
text: Oh, good, good!\pBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\pCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_SaveProgressBeforeBattle
text: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_HopeToSeeGoodMatch
text: I hope to see a good match!

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Tie
text: {STR_VAR_1}

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_B1F_Text_MatchEndedUpDraw
text: The match ended up a draw.

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_BrilliantStandoff
text: So, it became a standoff.\pIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Won
text: {STR_VAR_1}

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_ThatWasSuperlative
text: That was superlative!\pWhy, it was like seeing myself in\nmy youth again!

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Lost
text: {STR_VAR_1}

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_TooBadForYou
text: Ah, too bad for you!\pBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
text:
WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest
TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.\pThis town's GYM is led by the TRAINER
who taught WALLACE.\pBut the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be
even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.\pHow strong could they be?

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
text: Everyone in town has taken refuge\nand won't come out of their homes.\pEven I would rather not venture\noutside.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBeFriendsWithPokemon
text: Whenever, wherever, and whatever\nhappens, I will always be friends with\lPOKéMON.\pBecause it's fun to be with POKéMON!

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ArentPokemonOurFriends
text: Aren't POKéMON our friends?\pWhy are they going wild this way?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingReady
text: This is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS.\pUnfortunately, we're still getting\nthings ready. Please come back later!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
text: Welcome!\pThis is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
text: Is this your first visit here?\pBefore you enter, please save\nyour game.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
text: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pUp to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
text: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pThere appear to be TRAINERS gathered\nin every room.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
text: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
text: I will time your progress.\nBest of luck!\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
text: Please do visit us again!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
text: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
text: I hope you give it your best.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
text: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
text: Thank you for playing!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
text:
Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct
an event called the Time Attack.\pIt is a race that measures how long
you take to reach our owner on\lthe rooftop from this counter.\pThe fastest times are posted on
the Time Board--try competing with\lyour friends.\pIn TRAINER battles along the way,
neither Exp. Points nor money will\lbe awarded.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwoPokemon
text: Oh, I'm sorry, but you appear to have\nonly one POKéMON with you.\pYou will need at least two POKéMON\nto enter this event.

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
text:
Hm! Hm!\pYou finally came!
Yes, you have arrived!\pWait! Don't say it!
I know why you came all the way\lhere by yourself!\pYou wanted to see me, the owner
of the TRAINER HILL, because…\pYou want to form a tag team with me!
Wa-hoo!\p…Uh?
That's not it?\pAnyway, I watched you on your way up.
Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelousGift
text: For a marvelous someone like you,\nI have the most marvelous gift!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterForThis
text: Oh, no, full up with things!\nYou'll be back later for this!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
text:
Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get
here marvelously quickly?\pHow splendid! You needn't have
hurried so to see me!\pThat is so delightful. I'll have the Time
Board at the reception updated!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick
text: But, oh…\nYou weren't very quick getting here.

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
text: Perhaps it would please me more if you\narrived zippier next time.\pThen, I should be pleased to form\na tag team with you!\pUntil we meet again, amigo!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillToFindPartner
text: I had the TRAINER HILL built for but\none reason and one only!\pTo find the most suitable partner\nwith whom I may form a tag team!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ChallengeTime
text: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
text: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS\nand POKéMON combos are ahead?\pAll I know is that I'll knock aside\nanyone that stands in my way!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
text: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this\nTRAINER HILL from all over.\pI can't wait to test the waters!\pI'll knock aside anyone that stands\nin my way!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
text: Do you see the Time Board over there?\pMy friends and I are trying to see who\ncan reach the top in the least time.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
text: Do you know when they're opening\nthis place up?\pI'm waiting here to be the first\nchallenger ever!

label: TrainerHill_Elevator_Text_ReturnToReception
text: Would you like to return to\nthe reception counter?

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
text:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted
on the hull.\pThis is the submarine TEAM AQUA
stole in SLATEPORT!\pTEAM AQUA must have gone
ashore here.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
text:
My papa told me.\pHe says this tunnel is full of
timid POKéMON.\pThey get all scared of loud noise and
make a big uproar.\pSo they had to stop the big tunnel
project.\pBut there's one man. He's trying to dig
the tunnel by himself!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
text: There was a man who dug a tunnel for\na lady he loved.\pI don't really get it, but hey!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
text: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash\nis never blown in this direction.\pThe air is clean and delicious here.\nLiving here should do wonders for even\lfrail and sickly people.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
text: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding\na hot winning streak.\pSo I decided to make my BATTLE TENT\ndebut in this town.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
text:
Did you see the cave next to the
POKéMON MART?\pThere's a guy in there who's trying to
bust up boulders so he can bust out\lthrough to the other side.\pIt'd be great if we could go through…
It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
text: That cave next to the POKéMON MART\nis now a tunnel to the other side.\pIt's great--it's easy to go shop for\nnew DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
text: VERDANTURF TOWN\p“The windswept highlands with the\nsweet fragrance of grass.”

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_WandasHouse
text: WANDA'S HOUSE

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign
text: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE\n“Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
text: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\p“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
text:
Which CONTEST are you entering?
Want a piece of advice?\pIn any CONTEST, for example, a CUTE
CONTEST, I don't think they judge you\lonly on cuteness in the first round.\pYou need to work out ways for raising
POKéMON better.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
text: I raised my POKéMON to be cute.\pI found out you can put POKéMON in\na CONTEST for cuteness!\pI'm so glad I raised my POKéMON with\nloving care…

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
text: My POKéMON rules!\pIt's cool, tough yet beautiful, cute,\nand smart. It's complete!\pI may as well go for wins in every\nsingle CONTEST.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_NormalRankStage
text: POKéMON CONTESTS\nNORMAL RANK STAGE!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
text:
If it doesn't like a certain move,
a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it.\pIt doesn't matter how strong it is,
either.\pFor example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE
nature probably won't enjoy hurting\lits opponents.\pIf it can't seem to live up to its
potential, it's probably failing at\lusing a disliked move against its will.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
text: My big sister is gentle usually.\nBut when she gets angry,\lshe's really, really scary!\pI bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary\nif it gets angry!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
text:
My feelings toward my POKéMON…
The attraction runs deep…\pOh, hi, you didn't see that, did you?
Well, it doesn't matter.\pHow would you like this TM for
your POKéMON?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionMutual
text: My feelings toward my POKéMON…\nI'm sure the attraction is mutual!\pThey battle exactly the way I want\nthem to!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
text: What kind of moves have you taught\nyour POKéMON?\pI think you would give yourself\nan advantage if they knew how to\lheal or protect themselves.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
text:
SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I thought I might see you here.\pA BATTLE TENT's a place where
you can meet tough TRAINERS.\pIt doesn't matter what the rules are,
or how battles are waged, either.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do
the best you can!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottVisitRegularly
text: SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes\nof seeing tough TRAINERS in action\lin whatever the situation.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_SeeHowMuchPokemonLikesYou
text: Let me see your POKéMON.\nI'll check to see how much it likes you.\pOh.\nYour POKéMON…

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_AdoresYou
text: It adores you.\nIt can't possibly love you any more.\lI even feel happy seeing it.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryHappy
text: It seems to be very happy.\nIt obviously likes you a whole lot.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_LikesYouQuiteALot
text: It likes you quite a lot.\nIt seems to want to be babied a little.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_GettingUsedToYou
text: It's getting used to you.\nIt seems to believe in you.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_NotUsedToYou
text: It's not very used to you yet.\nIt neither loves nor hates you.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryWary
text: It's very wary.\nIt has scary viciousness in its eyes.\lIt doesn't like you much at all.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_DetestsYou
text: This is a little hard for me to say…\pYour POKéMON simply detests you.\nDoesn't that make you uncomfortable?

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_Pikachu
text: PIKACHU: Pika pika!

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGatherAtPokemonLeague
text: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY,\nis the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pThe TRAINERS who gather there are\nall frighteningly well skilled.

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFourInARow
text: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the\nrules say that you have to battle the\lELITE FOUR all in a row.\pIf you lose to any of them, you have\nto begin your challenge again from the\lfirst one.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCrucial
text: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL\nis crucial.\pIt jacks up the power of some moves\neven though it's only for one battle.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuidesForBattleTent
text: They don't seem to sell any winning\nstrategy guides for the BATTLE TENT…\pIt seems one must rely on one's\nown wits after all…

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnWeakenedPokemon
text: The NEST BALL works better on\nweakened POKéMON.\pVERDANTURF is the only place you can\nbuy it.

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaithInYourPokemon
text: You can't consider yourself a real\nTRAINER if you don't have faith\lin your POKéMON.\pOnly those people who can believe\nin their battling POKéMON can win\lthrough to the very end.

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitForBattleTent
text:
The reason why anyone would visit
VERDANTURF…\pIt's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without
saying.\pOr is there somebody here that you
came to see?

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeech
text:
WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm
not feeling down anymore.\pBecause I have a new purpose in life.
Together with my RALTS, I'm going\lto challenge POKéMON GYMS and become\la great TRAINER.\pPlease watch me, {PLAYER}.
I'm going to be stronger than you.\pWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you
to another battle.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeechShort
text: WALLY: Please watch me, {PLAYER}.\nI'm going to get stronger than you.\pWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you\nto another battle.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallysNextDoor
text:
UNCLE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
WALLY's next door.\pBut, boy, there's something I have to
tell you.\pThis natural environment is doing
wonders for WALLY's health.\pMaybe it's not just the environment.
It could be POKéMON that are giving\lthe boy hope.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallySlippedOff
text: WALLY's gone away…\nHe slipped off on his own…

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyGoneThatFar
text: UNCLE: Is that right?\nWALLY's gone away that far all by\lhimself…\pWell, I have to give him credit--he is\nmy little brother's son.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_MeetWanda
text:
WANDA: You are?
Oh, right, I get it!\pYou're the {PLAYER} who WALLY was
telling me about.\pI'm WALLY's cousin.
Glad to meet you!\pI think WALLY's become a lot more lively
and healthy since he came here.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DontWorryAboutWally
text: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY.\nHe'll be just fine.\pI know my little cousin, and he has\nPOKéMON with him, too.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_CanSeeGirlfriendEveryDay
text: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend\nevery day.\lHappy? You bet I am!

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendDriven
text:
My daughter's boyfriend is a very
driven and passionate sort of person.\pHe's been digging a tunnel nonstop
just so he can see my daughter.\pMy daughter's a little concerned,
so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendWasDigging
text: It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend\nwas digging the tunnel by hand!\pIt's so incredible!

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_IfAnythingHappenedToWally
text: If anything were to happen to WALLY,\nI would never be able to look his\lparents in PETALBURG in the eye…

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyWasInEverGrande
text: WALLY was in EVER GRANDE?\pHis parents in PETALBURG would be\nastonished to hear that!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
text:
WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI bet you're surprised to see me here!\pI made it all the way here, and it's
all thanks to you!\p{PLAYER}, losing to you that time
made me stronger!\pBut I'm not going to lose anymore!\pI'm going to win! For the POKéMON who
gave me courage and strength!\pOkay… Here I come!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat
text: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBattle
text: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today,\n{PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll\lcatch up to you!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
text: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten stronger since that last\ntime! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!\pOkay… Here I come!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat
text: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle
text: WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time,\ntoo… But one of these days, {PLAYER},\lI'm going to catch up to you…\pAnd challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro
text: I've made it this far a couple times,\nbut the last stretch is so long…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarDefeat
text: My dream ends here again…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle
text: You've made it this far. Keep the\nmomentum going and become the\lCHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro
text: I didn't come all this way to lose now.\nThat possibility doesn't exist!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertDefeat
text: Impossible…\nI lost?

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle
text: I lost here…\pThat means I lack the qualifications\nto become the CHAMPION…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro
text: This seemingly infinite and harsh road\nlives up to its name of VICTORY.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeDefeat
text: Your battle style is fantastic…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle
text: You seem to have the potential for\nbecoming the CHAMPION.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro
text: What is the VICTORY ROAD?\nI'll tell you if you win!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyDefeat
text: Okay!\nWell done!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle
text: Getting through here safely--that's\nthe final test for any TRAINER aiming\lto become the POKéMON CHAMPION.\pThat's why it's called the VICTORY\nROAD.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro
text: I have nothing to say to anyone\nthat's come this far. Come on!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnDefeat
text: This is a disgrace…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle
text: Humph, go right on ahead.\nSee if I care.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
text: The thought that I'm getting closer to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE…\pI'm getting stage fright…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelDefeat
text: I couldn't do a thing…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle
text: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant\nagain… What a letdown…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro
text: To win your way through the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you need the trust of your\lPOKéMON.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat
text: Your relationship is based on\nsolid trust.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle
text: By being together all the time, trust\ngrows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro
text: This isn't the goal. It's only a place\non the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleDefeat
text: That's the way!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle
text: You'll do fine, for sure!\nYour POKéMON are all eager to go!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro
text: My POKéMON are cosmically\nawe inspiring!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat
text: I've never met anyone like you before.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle
text: Even outside of battle, I sense\nincredible power emanating from you\land your POKéMON.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro
text: Okay, no need to get your back up!\nRelax, let's take it easy!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleDefeat
text: Whoa!\nWonderful!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
text: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD.\pBut it's not all that different from\nthe path you've taken so far.\pTry to enjoy things the rest of\nthe way!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro
text: I trained together with my whole family,\nevery one of us!\lI'm not losing to anyone!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat
text: Better than my family?!\nIs that possible?!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle
text: I was better than everyone in my\nfamily. I've never lost before…\pI've lost my confidence…\nMaybe I'll go home…

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro
text: I'd heard that there was a tough\nlittle kid around. Do they mean you?

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenDefeat
text: The little shrimp is tough!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle
text: The rumors I heard, that tough little\nkid is from PETALBURG CITY.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro
text: You must be getting a little tired.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat
text: No signs of tiring at all!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
text: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE\nare long and grueling challenges.\lBeware of fatigue!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro
text: You shouldn't get complacent just\nbecause you have a lot of GYM BADGES.\pThere's always going to be someone\nwho's better than you!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieDefeat
text: You're better than me!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle
text: Gaze on your collected BADGES and\nremember the TRAINERS you've faced.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro
text: I've come this far, but the tension's\ngiving me awful stomach pain…

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixDefeat
text: Ooh…\nIt hurts…

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle
text: I can't help getting all tense knowing\nthat I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pIt's all I can do to feign calm.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro
text: The elite among the elite gather in\nthis cave.\pHow are you finding it?

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat
text: Not rattled in the least bit!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle
text: You do have guts! I like that!\nKeep it going!

label: VioletCity_Text_TownSign
text: VIOLET CITY\nThe City of\nNostalgic Scents

label: VioletCity_Text_PokeCenterSign
text: POKEMON CENTER

label: VioletCity_Text_MartSign
text: POKEMON MART

label: VioletCity_Text_SproutTowerSign
text: SPROUT TOWER\nExperience the Way\nof POKEMON

label: VioletCity_Text_GymWatcher
text: FALKNER uses FLYING-type\nPOKEMON.\pBring a steady team before\nyou challenge him.

label: VioletCity_Text_TowerWatcher
text: The SAGES train inside\nSPROUT TOWER.\pIt's a good first test\nbefore the GYM.

label: VioletCity_Text_PokemonCenterGirl
text: TRAINERS come down from\nthe tower looking worn out.\pHeal before you go back in.

label: VioletCity_Text_SchoolKid
text: STATUS moves are on the\ntest.\pI know the answers, but\nusing them in battle is\lharder.

label: azale_cut_house_Text_ForestPrepperIntro
text: ILEX FOREST is beautiful,\nbut poison can make it\lfeel very long.\pTake this PECHA BERRY.

label: azale_cut_house_Text_ForestPrepperAfter
text: The best CUT path is the\none you planned before\lstepping into grass.

label: azale_cut_house_Text_ForestPrepperBagFull
text: Your BAG is packed tight.\pMake room and I will hand\nover the berry.

label: azale_cut_house_Text_CharcoalKid
text: Charcoal makers learn to\nread the forest by smell.\pFresh leaves mean the path\nwas used recently.

label: azalea_kurts_house_Text_ApricornApprentice
text: KURT can tell an APRICORN\napart by sound.\pI still need to look\ntwice.

label: azalea_kurts_house_Text_SlowpokeKid
text: SLOWPOKE naps like it has\nnever heard of deadlines.\pMaybe that is wisdom.

label: cherrygrove_house0_Text_PokeBallNeighborIntro
text: I had one spare POKE BALL.\pTake it before ROUTE 30\nmakes you wish you had.

label: cherrygrove_house0_Text_PokeBallNeighborAfter
text: A spare POKE BALL is a\nlittle courage with a\lbutton on it.

label: cherrygrove_house0_Text_PokeBallNeighborBagFull
text: Your BAG is too full?\pMake room and I will keep\nit by the door.

label: cherrygrove_house0_Text_WindowWatcher
text: The sea wind changes before\nrain does.\pOld sailors swear TRAINERS\nshould learn that too.

label: cherrygrove_house1_Text_RestockGrandmother
text: CHERRYGROVE is a fine\nplace to learn your habits.\pIf a route feels rough,\nstep back and restock.

label: cherrygrove_house1_Text_RoutePacer
text: I count my steps between\ntown and the MART.\pA short route feels longer\nwhen your team is tired.

label: cherrygrove_house2_Text_NotebookGirl
text: Every TRAINER tells you\nsomething about a route.\pThe loud ones are not\nalways the dangerous ones.

label: cherrygrove_house2_Text_QuietTrainer
text: A quiet team can still be\nready.\pI check moves before I\ncheck the weather.

label: goldenrod_bike_shop_Text_NeedsPlainBadge
text: These are imported HOENN\nBIKES, tuned for serious\lroadwork.\pCome back after earning\nGOLDENROD's PLAIN BADGE.

label: goldenrod_bike_shop_Text_OfferBike
speaker: Owner
text:
I used to hear shops gave
BIKES away for advertising.\pThat is not much of a
business plan, is it?\pStill, you beat WHITNEY,
so I can spare one import.\pChoose carefully. For now,
you get one HOENN BIKE.

label: goldenrod_bike_shop_Text_ChoseMachBike
text: The MACH BIKE is built\nfor speed.\pOnce it gets going, it\nreally moves.

label: goldenrod_bike_shop_Text_ChoseAcroBike
text: The ACRO BIKE is built\nfor tricks and control.\pIt rewards careful hands.

label: goldenrod_bike_shop_Text_CancelChoice
text: No rush.\pA BIKE choice is worth\nthinking through.

label: goldenrod_bike_shop_Text_TakeCare
text: Take good care of it.\pThose HOENN parts are\nnot easy to replace.

label: goldenrod_bike_shop_Text_AlreadyGotMachBike
text: How is the MACH BIKE?\pFast riders should mind\ntight corners.

label: goldenrod_bike_shop_Text_AlreadyGotAcroBike
text: How is the ACRO BIKE?\pTrick riding is all about\ntiming.

label: goldenrod_bike_shop_Text_TireCustomer
text: I came to browse and got\na lecture on tires.\pHonestly? Good lecture.

label: goldenrod_deptstore_1f_Text_DeliveryClerkIntro
speaker: DeliveryClerk
text:
Welcome to GOLDENROD
DEPT. STORE!\pWe also support DELIBIRD
DELIVERY for TRAINERS.\pI'll add the order app to
your POKéLINK.

label: goldenrod_deptstore_1f_Text_DeliveryUnlocked
speaker: System
text: POKéLINK Delibird Delivery\napp unlocked!

label: goldenrod_deptstore_1f_Text_DeliveryClerkAfter
text: Place an order from the\napp and a courier will\ltry to reach you.

label: goldenrod_deptstore_6f_Text_RestShopper
text: A long route feels shorter\nwith cold drinks packed.

label: goldenrod_deptstore_roof_Text_RooftopShopper
text: The roof is quiet today.\pClear-out sales bring the\nreal crowds.

label: goldenrod_flower_shop_Text_BerryFloristIntro
text: CONFUSION makes battles\nlook silly until it costs\lyou.\pA PERSIM BERRY helps.

label: goldenrod_flower_shop_Text_BerryFloristAfter
text: Plants need steady hands.\pSo do confused POKEMON.

label: goldenrod_flower_shop_Text_BerryFloristBagFull
text: Your BAG has no room?\pSet something aside and\ncome back for the berry.

label: goldenrod_flower_shop_Text_NoiseGardener
text: Flowers near GOLDENROD\nlearn to grow around\lnoise.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_CoinCaseGiverIntro
speaker: CoinCaseGiver
text: You came to the GAME CORNER\nwithout a COIN CASE?\pI keep a spare for people\nwho learn that lesson once.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_CoinCaseGiverAfter
text: The COIN CASE keeps your\ncoins out of your BAG.\pThat makes losing track of\nthem feel official.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_CoinsClerkIntro
text: Welcome to the GOLDENROD\nGAME CORNER.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_BuyCoinsPrompt
text: Would you like to buy\nsome coins?

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_ThankYouHereAreYourCoins
text: Thank you!\nHere are your coins.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_NotEnoughMoney
text: You do not have enough\nmoney.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_CancelBuyCoins
text: Take your time.\nThe machines will wait.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_CoinCaseFull
text: Your COIN CASE is full.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_NeedCoinCase
text: You need a COIN CASE\nto use coins here.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_PrizeClerkIntro
text: Coins may be exchanged\nfor prizes here.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_WhichPrize
text: Which prize counter\nwould you like?

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_WhichPokemonPrize
text: Which POKEMON prize\nwould you like?

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_WhichItemPrize
text: Which item prize\nwould you like?

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_ConfirmPrize
text: So your choice is\n{STR_VAR_1}?

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_NotEnoughCoins
text: You do not have enough\ncoins.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_CancelPrize
text: Please come back after\nwinning more coins.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_HereYouGo
text: Here you go!\nUse it well.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_ReceivedAbra
text: {PLAYER} received ABRA!

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_ReceivedSandshrew
text: {PLAYER} received SANDSHREW!

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_ReceivedDratini
text: {PLAYER} received DRATINI!

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFlipIntro
text: VOLTORB FLIP is a small\nrisk table.\pPick cards to bank coins.\nPick VOLTORB and lose them.\pPlay a round?

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFlipRound
text: Round {STR_VAR_1}.\nBanked coins: {STR_VAR_2}\pPick a card.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFlipSafeOne
text: Safe card!\nYou banked 1 coin.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFlipSafeTwo
text: A 2-card!\nYou banked 2 coins.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFlipSafeThree
text: A 5-card!\nYou banked 5 coins.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFlipKeepGoing
text: You have {STR_VAR_2} coins\nbanked.\pFlip again?

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFlipCashOut
text: You cashed out\n{STR_VAR_1} coins!

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFlipVoltorb
text: VOLTORB!\pThe table clears your\nbanked coins.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFlipNoCoins
text: No coins banked.\nYou stepped away.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_ArcadeAttendantAfter
speaker: ArcadeAttendant
text: POKELINK games are good\nbetween battles.\pReal coins are for the\nmachines, though.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_SlotsFan
text: I count three spins,\nthen breathe.\pIt does not help, but\nit feels professional.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_VoltorbFan
text: VOLTORB FLIP rewards\nknowing when to leave.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_PrizeFan
text: The prize DRATINI is\nexpensive for a reason.

label: goldenrod_game_corner_Text_TiredGambler
text: I had a hot streak.\nThen I kept playing.

label: goldenrod_house0_Text_GreatBallNeighborIntro
text: Big city, bigger bags,\nright?\pTake this GREAT BALL.\nYou will see something\lworth trying it on.

label: goldenrod_house0_Text_GreatBallNeighborAfter
text: A good BALL is not a\npromise.\pIt is just a better\nchance.

label: goldenrod_house0_Text_GreatBallNeighborBagFull
text: Your BAG is full already?\pCome back after the city\nteaches you to pack light.

label: goldenrod_house0_Text_ListMaker
text: GOLDENROD can make every\nerrand feel urgent.\pI make a list before I\nstep outside.

label: goldenrod_house1_Text_TrainDreamer
text: The train station makes\npeople dream about far\laway cities.

label: goldenrod_house1_Text_TowerWatcher
text: I came for shopping and\nspent an hour staring at\lthe RADIO TOWER.

label: goldenrod_house2_Text_GymFan
text: WHITNEY's fans argue about\nstrategy like it is\lweather.

label: goldenrod_house2_Text_CoinCaseOwner
text: I keep my COIN CASE away\nfrom my snack money.\pThat rule has saved me\nmore than once.

label: goldenrod_train_station_Text_PatientCommuter
text: I bought a ticket before\nchecking the schedule.\pNow I am learning\npatience.

label: goldenrod_train_station_Text_MagnetFan
text: The MAGNET TRAIN feels\nfaster in your chest than\lon the clock.

label: goldenrod_underground_corridor_Text_AbraCabIntro
speaker: AbraCabDispatcher
text:
Need a ride without touching
traffic?\pABRACAB uses registered
teleport lanes under town.\pYour POKéLINK can handle
the dispatch app.

label: goldenrod_underground_corridor_Text_AbraCabUnlocked
text: POKéLINK AbraCab app\nunlocked!

label: goldenrod_underground_corridor_Text_AbraCabAfter
text: ABRACAB fares are cheaper\nthan sore feet.\pMostly.

label: goldenrod_underground_entry_n_Text_CoolAirRegular
text: The underground is cooler\nthan the street.\pThat is why half the city\nends up down here.

label: goldenrod_underground_entry_s_Text_CrowdListener
text: If you hear a crowd below,\nit might be a bargain or\lit might be trouble.

label: gym_azalea_Text_BugsyIntro
text: I'm BUGSY.\pBugs look fragile until\nyou study how they adapt.\pLet's see how your team\nhandles a swarm!

label: gym_azalea_Text_BugsyDefeat
text: Excellent observation!

label: gym_azalea_Text_ReceivedHiveBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the\nHIVE BADGE!

label: gym_azalea_Text_HiveBadgeInfo
text: The HIVE BADGE means you\nunderstand momentum.\pKeep watching the small\ndetails. They win battles.

label: gym_azalea_Text_BugsyNeedIlex
text: I can't take a challenge\nwhile ILEX FOREST is unsafe.\pTEAM ROCKET was seen near\nthe old shrine.\pPlease clear that first.

label: gym_azalea_Text_BugsyPostBattle
text: ILEX FOREST's recovery is\nalready changing local data.\pYour POKéLINK should be\nworth checking often.

label: gym_azalea_Text_AlIntro
text: BUG POKEMON evolve fast.\nSo do good TRAINERS!

label: gym_azalea_Text_AlDefeat
text: You evolved faster!

label: gym_azalea_Text_LiaMiaIntro
text: Two eyes miss details.\nFour eyes catch them!

label: gym_azalea_Text_LiaMiaDefeat
text: We blinked first!

label: gym_azalea_Text_GymTrainerPostBattle
text: BUGSY says every battle is\nfield research.

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_WhitneyIntro
text: Hi! I'm WHITNEY!\pCute POKEMON, tough POKEMON,\nsurprising POKEMON...\pGOLDENROD loves all of them,\nand so do I!

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_WhitneyDefeat
text: No way! You were amazing!

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_ReceivedPlainBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the\nPLAIN BADGE!

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_PlainBadgeInfo
text: The PLAIN BADGE means you\nkept your balance in chaos.\pThat's harder than it sounds\nin GOLDENROD.

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_WhitneyPostBattle
text: You should visit the RADIO\nTOWER before leaving town.\pTrainers who listen hear\ntrouble before it arrives.

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_CarrieIntro
text: Normal type doesn't mean\nordinary!

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_CarrieDefeat
text: That was not ordinary.

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_VictoriaIntro
text: GOLDENROD battles are loud,\nbright, and very real!

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_VictoriaDefeat
text: You handled the spotlight.

label: gym_goldenrod_Text_GymTrainerPostBattle
text: WHITNEY's team turns simple\nmoves into big moments.

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_FalknerIntro
text:
I am FALKNER, VIOLET's
GYM LEADER.\pMy FLYING-type POKEMON
are trained to punish\lcareless moves.\pShow me what your team
can do.

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_FalknerDefeat
text: You handled that well.

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_ReceivedZephyrBadge
text: {PLAYER} received the\nZEPHYR BADGE!

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_ZephyrBadgeInfo
text: That BADGE proves you can\nhandle JOHTO's first GYM.\pKeep training before you\nhead for AZALEA.

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_FalknerPostBattle
text: A strange wind has been\nmoving through ILEX FOREST.\pIf you hear trouble there,\nface it before BUGSY.

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_AbeIntro
text: The elegant battle style\nof bird POKEMON is mine!

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_AbeDefeat
text: I lost altitude!

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_RodIntro
text: FALKNER trains us to read\nevery gust.\pWhat does your team read?

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_RodDefeat
text: Your timing was better.

label: johto_gyms_violet_Text_BirdKeeperPostBattle
text: FALKNER checks every battle.\nWe all train seriously here.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_AideNeedsBadge
text: League test?\nNot yet.\pWin the PLAIN BADGE first.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_AideOfferTrial
speaker: LeagueAide
text: PLAIN BADGE?\nGood.\pThe League has a little test.\pNot a hard one.\nJust enough to see if you quit.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_AideDeclineTrial
text: No rush.\pPaperwork waits better\nthan people do.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_AideTrialStarted
text: Three stations.\pFirst trainee.\nSecond trainee.\pThen the evaluator.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_AideRewardWaiting
text: You passed.\pThe evaluator has your\nreward papers.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_AideAfterTrial
text: Badges, badges...\pWhy are they always shiny?

label: johto_name_rater_Text_TraineeNeedsBadge
text: League test?\nNot yet.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_TraineeNeedsDesk
text: Check in at the desk.\pRules first.\nThen battling.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_Trainee1Intro
text: First test.\nDon't overthink it.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_Trainee1Defeat
text: You didn't.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_Trainee1After
text: You didn't overthink it.\pThat helps here.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_Trainee2NeedsFirst
text: First test first.\pThe forms say so.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_Trainee2Intro
text: Second test.\nTry not to look tired.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_Trainee2Defeat
text: You looked a little tired.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_Trainee2After
text: You looked a little tired.\pStill counts.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_EvaluatorNeedsBadge
text: PLAIN BADGE first.\pThen my clipboard\ngets interested.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_EvaluatorNeedsDesk
text: Desk first.\pThis office likes order.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_EvaluatorNeedsStations
text: Finish the stations.\pThen come back.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_EvaluatorIntro
speaker: Evaluator
text: Last test.\nNo speech.\pBattle.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_EvaluatorDefeat
text: Good.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_EvaluatorPassed
text: Good.\nYou listen.\pYou adjust.\nThat matters.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_PseudoRewardIntro
text: You passed.\pThese POKEMON are rare.\nThey are also a lot of work.\pPick one.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_ConfirmPseudoChoice
text: Choose {STR_VAR_1}?\pThis choice sticks.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_DratiniChoice
text: DRATINI grows slowly.\pThen suddenly it doesn't.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_LarvitarChoice
text: LARVITAR eats a lot.\pMountains worry about that.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_BeldumChoice
text: BELDUM is stubborn.\pIt mostly solves problems\nheadfirst.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_BagonChoice
text: BAGON wants the sky.\pIt starts on the ground.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_ReceivedPseudo
text: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_1}!

label: johto_name_rater_Text_AfterPseudoGift
text: Raise it slowly.\pThat is the point.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_CancelPseudoChoice
text: Take your time.\pThis choice sticks.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_PseudoAlreadyReceived
text: Still raising it?\nGood.\pRare does not mean easy.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_EeveeOffer
speaker: GiftNPC
text: That EEVEE likes you.\pIt changes easy.\nYou look like you travel.\pWant to raise it?

label: johto_name_rater_Text_ReceivedEevee
text: {PLAYER} received EEVEE!

label: johto_name_rater_Text_AfterEeveeGift
text: Take good care of it.\pIt has a lot of ways\nto grow.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_EeveeDeclined
text: That's fine.\pEEVEE waits better\nthan I do.

label: johto_name_rater_Text_EeveeAlreadyReceived
text: How's EEVEE?\pStill deciding what to be?

label: mart_azalea_Text_ForestShopper
text: I buy REPEL before I buy\na snack here.\pThe forest has opinions\nabout shortcuts.

label: mart_cherrygrove_Text_CautiousShopper
text: Before POKE BALLS came in,\neveryone bought POTIONS.\pNow everyone buys both.

label: mart_violet_Text_TowerShopper
text: ESCAPE ROPE is not giving\nup.\pIt is knowing when a tower\nhas taught you enough.

label: mr_pokemons_house_Text_MrPokemon
text: I'm MR. POKEMON.\pPeople bring me strange\nfinds from all over JOHTO.\pEvery so often, one of them\nturns into a real mystery.

label: mr_pokemons_house_Text_FieldAssistant
text: MR. POKEMON keeps careful\nnotes on every oddity.\pI am just here to compare\na shell to a stone.

label: pokecenter_azalea_Text_BugCatcherBeforeBadge
text: BUGSY takes notes.\pI lost.\pNow I am notes.

label: pokecenter_azalea_Text_BugCatcherAfterBadge
text: HIVE BADGE?\pThen he took notes\non you.

label: pokecenter_azalea_Text_ForestLocalBeforeRocket
text: The forest feels wrong.\pTrees should not feel\nbusy.

label: pokecenter_azalea_Text_ForestLocalAfterRocket
text: The forest is quiet\nagain.\pBetter quiet.

label: pokecenter_azalea_Text_RocketWaryTrainer
text: TEAM ROCKET stepped\non my lunch.\pI stepped on their foot.\pFair.

label: pokecenter_azalea_Text_EncountersFanBeforeApp
text: I write down wild\nPOKéMON.\pThen I lose the paper.

label: pokecenter_azalea_Text_EncountersFanAfterApp
text: Encounters app?\pShow-off.

label: pokecenter_cherrygrove_Text_TiredYoungster
text: I made it from NEW BARK.\pThen I healed.\pThen I felt brave again.

label: pokecenter_cherrygrove_Text_PokeLinkKidBeforeMap
text: My POKéLINK says I'm\nin CHERRYGROVE.\pThanks, I guess.

label: pokecenter_cherrygrove_Text_PokeLinkKidAfterMap
text: Map app?\pGood.\pNow get lost\nprofessionally.

label: pokecenter_cherrygrove_Text_AntidoteTip
text: Buy ANTIDOTES.\pYou'll say you don't\nneed them.\pThen you will.

label: pokecenter_cherrygrove_Text_KantoTraveler
text: KANTO is across the\nwater.\pFeels close.\pStill far.

label: pokecenter_ecruteak_Text_OldWoman
text: ECRUTEAK is old.\pThe floorboards know\nmore than I do.

label: pokecenter_ecruteak_Text_TowerTraveler
text: I came for towers.\pI found stairs.\pMany stairs.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_VsSeekerCoachIntro
text: Some TRAINERS want a rematch\nafter they have time to train.\pYour POKéLINK can track those\nsignals with VS SEEKER.\pI'll activate it for you.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_VsSeekerUnlocked
text: POKéLINK VS Seeker app\nunlocked!

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_VsSeekerCoachAfter
text: Check VS SEEKER when old rivals\nstart itching for another battle.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_WhitneyFanBeforeBadge
text: WHITNEY is cute.\pThat is not a plan.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_WhitneyFanAfterBadge
text: PLAIN BADGE?\pShe cried, didn't she?

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_RadioListenerBeforeApp
text: RADIO TOWER is north.\pThey talk for free.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_RadioListenerAfterApp
text: You got Radio?\pTry not to hum indoors.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_BikeFanBeforeBike
text: BIKE SHOP has HOENN\nBIKES.\pFast one.\pWeird one.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_BikeFanMach
text: MACH BIKE?\pBlink less.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_BikeFanAcro
text: ACRO BIKE?\pHop outside.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_DayCareHint
text: Eggs like steps.\pNobody knows why.\pThey just do.

label: pokecenter_goldenrod_Text_DepartmentShopper
text: I went for POTIONS.\pI bought a scarf.\pFor my POKéMON.

label: pokecenter_route32_Text_Hiker
text: Shortcuts are lies.\pGood lies.

label: pokecenter_route32_Text_Picnicker
text: I packed lunch.\pMy POKéMON packed\nappetite.

label: pokecenter_violet_Text_SageResting
text: The tower sways.\pI swayed back.\pThat was not wisdom.

label: pokecenter_violet_Text_BirdKeeperBeforeBadge
text: FALKNER looks calm.\pHis birds do not.

label: pokecenter_violet_Text_BirdKeeperAfterBadge
text: ZEPHYR BADGE?\pThen you already\nlooked up.

label: pokecenter_violet_Text_PokeLinkUserBeforeFlashlight
text: My screen is bright.\pThe sages say no.

label: pokecenter_violet_Text_PokeLinkUserAfterFlashlight
text: Flashlight app?\pGood.\pDark caves hate that.

label: pokecenter_violet_Text_HoennTraveler
text: I came from HOENN.\pYour tower is polite.\pIt only almost falls.

label: radio_tower_1f_Text_RadioProducerIntro
text:
Old POKéGEAR, new POKéLINK...
same problem.\pA TRAINER misses half of JOHTO
if they never tune in.\pHere, I'll install the RADIO
app on your POKéLINK.

label: radio_tower_1f_Text_RadioUnlocked
text: POKéLINK Radio app\nunlocked!

label: radio_tower_1f_Text_RadioProducerAfter
text: The RADIO app can carry\nlocal shows and odd alerts.\pKeep it handy after GYMS.\nStories travel fast here.

label: radio_tower_2f_Text_NightProducerIntro
text: Night requests are rough.\pA spare AWAKENING keeps\nme awake.\pYou might need it more.

label: radio_tower_2f_Text_NightProducerAfter
text: Sleep moves are cute\nuntil you miss a whole\lturn.

label: radio_tower_2f_Text_NightProducerBagFull
text: Your BAG is full?\pI will keep it on the\ndesk for now.

label: radio_tower_2f_Text_LetterReader
text: We read every letter on\na quiet day.\pSome trainers write better\nthan DJs talk.

label: radio_tower_3f_Text_RecordingTech
text: Recording rooms look calm\nbecause panic has to be\lquiet.

label: radio_tower_3f_Text_SoundRunner
text: If a DJ says one more\ntake, bring water.\pOne more take means six.

label: radio_tower_4f_Text_TimingHost
text: The best show clocks the\nsilence too.\pToo much chatter ruins\nthe next song.

label: radio_tower_5f_Text_LightOperator
text: Up here, everyone acts\nrelaxed around the lights.\pNobody is relaxed around\nthe lights.

label: route30_house1_Text_BerryKeeperIntro
text: ROUTE 30 is all berries\nand surprise battles.\pHere, an ORAN BERRY.\nIt can turn a close fight.

label: route30_house1_Text_BerryKeeperAfter
text: Give that berry to a\nPOKEMON before trouble,\lnot after.

label: route30_house1_Text_BerryKeeperBagFull
text: No room? Berries bruise\nif you cram them in.\pCome back after making\nspace.

label: route30_house1_Text_PathWatcher
text: The north path changes\nonce you know where\lTRAINERS are standing.

label: sprout_tower_1f_Text_SageNicoIntro
text: SPROUT TOWER is where new\nTRAINERS learn patience.\pShow me how you battle.

label: sprout_tower_1f_Text_SageNicoDefeat
text: You kept your focus.

label: sprout_tower_1f_Text_SagePostBattle
text: Take your time here.\nThe tower rewards patience.

label: sprout_tower_1f_Text_Pilgrim
text: The tower sways in strong\nwind.\pIt has stood that way\nfor years.

label: sprout_tower_2f_Text_SageJinIntro
text: A good TRAINER adjusts\nwhen a battle changes.\pLet me see if you can.

label: sprout_tower_2f_Text_SageJinDefeat
text: Good adjustment.

label: sprout_tower_2f_Text_SagePostBattle
text: I train with different\nPOKEMON to stay sharp.

label: sprout_tower_2f_Text_ElderBeforeGift
text: You made it to the top\nand battled well.\pTake HM05. It will help\nwith dark places.

label: sprout_tower_2f_Text_FlashlightReady
text: POKéLINK flashlight calibrated!

label: sprout_tower_2f_Text_ElderBagFull
text: Your BAG is full.\pReturn when you can carry\nHM05.

label: sprout_tower_2f_Text_ElderAfterGift
text: Use FLASH when a cave\ngets too dark to read.

label: sprout_tower_entry_Text_CautiousPilgrimIntro
text: SPROUT TOWER creaks like\nit is breathing.\pI brought extra REPEL.\nTake one if you want quiet.

label: sprout_tower_entry_Text_CautiousPilgrimAfter
text: REPEL helps when you are\ntrying to reach the next\lset of stairs.

label: sprout_tower_entry_Text_CautiousPilgrimBagFull
text: Too much in your BAG?\pTravel light before\nclimbing.

label: sprout_tower_entry_Text_FloorWatcher
text: The tower sways, but the\nfloor is honest.\pWatch the paths more than\nthe walls.

label: violet_house0_Text_TowerOldMan
text: SPROUT TOWER bends with\nthe wind, not against it.\pThat is a good lesson for\nnew TRAINERS.

label: violet_house0_Text_LandingGirl
text: The tower bells sound\ndifferent after a battle.\pMaybe it is just me\nbreathing harder.

label: violet_house1_Text_FisherMother
text: My son says every pond has\na secret.\pI say every secret still\nneeds a good line.

label: violet_house1_Text_MapReader
text: VIOLET sits between caves,\ntowers, and long grass.\pNo wonder travelers keep\nchecking their maps.

label: violet_trainerschool_Text_StatusTeacherIntro
text: VIOLET's routes love status\nlessons.\pA PARALYZE HEAL is boring\nuntil it saves a trip.

label: violet_trainerschool_Text_StatusTeacherAfter
text: Speed matters.\pPARALYSIS cuts into more\nthan pride.

label: violet_trainerschool_Text_StatusTeacherBagFull
text: Make room in your BAG\nand I will keep the lesson\laside.

label: violet_trainerschool_Text_TypeStudent
text: I wrote TYPE MATCHUPS on\nmy notebook.\pThen a trainer won because\nhis POKEMON held on.

label: violet_trainerschool_Text_FalknerStudentBeforeBadge
text: FALKNER's pupils watch\nhow you handle height.\pA grounded plan still\nneeds good timing.

label: violet_trainerschool_Text_FalknerStudentAfterBadge
text: You beat FALKNER?\pThen you know even birds\nhate bad timing.

label: violet_trainerschool_Text_ItemStudent
text: My teacher says items are\npart of a plan.\pUsing them late is panic.\nPacking early is prep.

label: violet_trainerschool_Text_Chalkboard
text:
TRISKELION CHRONICLES
FIELD NOTES\pPOKEMON from many regions
can appear across JOHTO.\pMoves, abilities, items,
and evolutions follow newer\lbattle discoveries.\pYour POKéLINK opens from
the START menu after you\lpick it up at home.\pApps include MESSAGES,
PHONE, GLOOMSCROLL,\lTETRIS, RADIO, and more.\pCheck POKéLINK often.
Some leads update as your\lbadges and route progress\lchange.

label: gText_AbnormalWeatherEnded_Rain
speaker: AbnormalWeatherEnded
text: The massive downpour appears to\nhave stopped…

label: gText_AbnormalWeatherEnded_Sun
speaker: AbnormalWeatherEnded
text: The intense sunshine appears to\nhave subsided…

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge0
