label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach2
text:
Um… Are you {PLAYER}?
My name is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to become a POKéMON TRAINER,
but I don't know what to do…\pSo I thought maybe I could ask you for
advice because you're so famous.\p{PLAYER}, could you give me advice?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching2
text: Oh, but…\pI sincerely want to become a POKéMON\nTRAINER!\pPlease, can you answer my questions?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode2
text:
Thank you!
Here's my first question right away!\pThe BATTLE TOWER has two levels,
Level 50 and Open Level, right?\pWhich level do you think is more
suitable for me?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks2
text: Oh, the {STR_VAR_1} challenge?\nUnderstood!\pIf I have another question, I'll come\nback here for your advice!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach3
text:
Oh? Huh? You're…
No, that can't be true.\pThere isn't any way that someone
like me could meet {PLAYER}.\p…You really are {PLAYER}?
I can't believe I'm talking to you!\pWhen something this good happens,
only terrible things will happen to me\lnow, I just know it…\p…I'm sorry…
I'm… {STR_VAR_1}…\pThere isn't anything special about
me that I can be proud of…\pI shouldn't even say anything about
myself because you'll forget…\pI had this dream that if I ever met
you, {PLAYER}, that maybe I could ask\lyou for advice as a TRAINER.\pBut I don't think you would agree
to that.\p…Or will you be so kind as to give
me advice?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching3
text:
I knew it…\pIt had to happen because I'm such
a really boring nobody…\pBut I thought just maybe…
You won't reconsider, will you?\pBut I can't give up just like that.
I'll ask you while I'm still lucky!\pPlease, will you be so kind as to give
me advice?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode3
text:
Really? I can't believe it!
I can't believe you'll advise me!\lI… I'm so happy…\pWhat I want to ask you is really
trivial, but I can't decide…\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, they let you
choose Level 50 or Open Level.\pWhich course do you think even I may
have a chance at?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks3
text:
{STR_VAR_1}? Okay!
But do you really think someone like\lme would have a chance?\pI'll do my best, even though I don't
think it will work.\pThank you very much for spending
time with someone like me.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach4
text:
Oh! You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?\pI've heard that you're tough at
POKéMON!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I'll be your friend!\pDid you know?\pYou can't win at the BATTLE FRONTIER
if all you know is what they teach at\lthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\pI'm willing to listen to your advice.
You'll agree, of course?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching4
text: Huh? Why are you refusing me?\nIt's me who's asking you!\lYou have to reconsider!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode4
text:
Okay, so there is this something.
I want you to decide it for me.\pYou know that the BATTLE TOWER has
Level 50 and Open Level Rooms?\pWhich do you think would be good
for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks4
text:
Okay, {STR_VAR_1} is suitable for me?
Thank you!\pKnowing that you made the decision,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.
Bye!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach5
text:
Oh, hi, there! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I know you because you're famous!\lCall me {STR_VAR_1}! Glad to meet you!\pI'm a TRIATHLETE, so I keep myself
fit even while I raise POKéMON.\pI'm also involved with other things
like work, napping, ballroom dancing…\pBeing this busy, it's not so easy for
me to become a decent TRAINER.\pSo, I have a proposition!\pThere must be a reason why we met.
So, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how about sharing your\lwisdom with me every so often?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching5
text: Oh, but, please?\nA guy like me needs someone like\lyou, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHonestly, I need your advice!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode5
text:
Thank you! That's more like it!
So, let's start with an easy one!\pYou know about the BATTLE TOWER's
two courses, right?\lYou know, Level 50 and Open Level.\pMe being a busy guy, which one should
I gear up for?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks5
text: {STR_VAR_1}, huh? Okay, gotcha.\nI'll find time somehow and give it a go!\p…Whoops, I'd better go to work!\nThanks! See you around!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach6
text:
No way! Uh-uh!
Are you maybe the real {PLAYER}?\pA-hah! Awesome! I'm {STR_VAR_1},
so pleased to meet you!\p{PLAYER}, you're very strong,
aren't you?\pEveryone's talking about you!\pOh! I just had this great idea!
I'll get advice off you, {PLAYER}!\lI'm sure it will make me tougher!\pIsn't it a great idea?
Please, I want your advice!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching6
text: Ahahaha, you can pretend to be mean,\nbut you can't fool me!\lYou really mean okay, don't you?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode6
text:
Yay! I knew you'd have a big heart,
{PLAYER}!\pWhat should I ask you first?
…Oh, I thought of something!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pIf I were to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge, which way should I go?\pLevel 50 or Open Level?
Which suits me more?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks6
text:
Oh-oh-oh!
{STR_VAR_1}, you say!\lThank you for a totally cool reply!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach7
text:
I beg your pardon, but…
Are you {PLAYER}?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I am delighted to
make your acquaintance.\pI have long been an admirer
of yours…\p… … … … … …\pUm… I hope you don't find this
request too much of a burden, but…\pMay I become your apprentice,
{PLAYER}?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching7
text:
Oh…!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\p…I must have fainted from shock.
I'm sorry, I must have misheard you.\pPlease! Please say that you will
accept me as your apprentice!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
text:
Oh… I'm delighted!\pI don't wish to waste your time,
so please advise me on this.\pI plan to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge soon.\pHowever, there are two levels…\pWhich would be most suitable for me?
Level 50 or Open Level?

text: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice!\nI see. I will do my best!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!

text:
Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}!
You spoke to me!\lI… I'm overjoyed!\pMe! My name is {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pI'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER},
the big name in POKéMON circles!\pOh-oh-oh, I know!
May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?\pPlease take me in as your apprentice!
I want to learn from you!

text: Waaaah!\n{PLAYER} turned me down…\lIt… It's an invaluable experience!\p{PLAYER}, please! I want to hear\nan affirmative answer this time!\pI beg you for your guidance!

text:

{PLAYER} said yes!\pI won't be able to sleep tonight…

for me, Level 50 or Open Level?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
text: {STR_VAR_1}! Perfectly understood!\nI understand perfectly!\lI'm deliriously delighted!\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me\nsome more another time.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
text:
Whoa! Could you be…
Might you be… {PLAYER}{KUN}?!\lThat strong and famous TRAINER?\lWell, hello, aren't I just the luckiest!\pHello, the name's {STR_VAR_1}!\pI've been on the lookout for
a POKéMON teacher.\pAnd with impeccably good timing,
along came you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSo, there you have it, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let me apprentice under you!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
text: Gwaaaah!\nYou're quite cool and tough…\pDon't be that way, please.\nI'm asking you!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
text:
Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply!
Excellent, I might add!\pSo how about a first piece of advice
on the BATTLE TOWER?\pIf I were to go, what would be better?
Level 50 or Open Level?

text: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nOK, A-OK!\lI'll go show my mettle, like, jam!\pAll right, I'll look to you as my mentor!\nAdios!

text:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
The police were looking for you!\p… … …
Of course I'm lying!\pMe, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way

I'm not very good at battling.\pSo, how about you becoming my master
about all things POKéMON?

text:
If you're going to act cold like that,
I'll show you what I'll do!\pWaaah! Waaah! Waaah!
Hiccup!\pHahaha, that was my FAKE TEARS!\pCome on, will you please be
my POKéMON master?

text:
Yippee!

text:
Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better!

I hope you'll keep teaching me!

text:

am I!\pYour turn now, tell me a little about
yourself, give it a try!\pUh-huh, uh-huh!
{PLAYER}{KUN}'s your name,\land POKéMON's your game!\pAnd you're at a delicate age

that you're the tenth TRAINER\lI've spoken to today.\pLet's make that a celebration!
Become my mentor for commemoration!

text:
That's it!
{PLAYER}, you've got the spirit!\pSo here's my first question
that begs your suggestion!\pIt's about the BATTLE TOWER,
and it hinges on my power!\pLevel 50 and Open Level there be,
which is the one that's good for me?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
text: Okay, {STR_VAR_1} it is, you say!\nI'll go and take it on my way!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!

text:
Say, hey, aren't you {PLAYER}?
What should I do? Talk to you?\lWhy not? I'm already talking to you!\p{PLAYER}, are you surprised at me?
I'd better tell you who I happen to be!\p{STR_VAR_1} is what you can call me.
The brightest star in guitardom,\lthat's me!\pAre you receiving me?
You are receiving me!\pMy luck's at its best,
I'll hit you with a request!\p{PLAYER}, let me be your underling!
I want you to teach me everything!

text: You're turning me down, then?\nI'll just have to ask you again!\p{PLAYER}, I beg to be your underling!\nI need you to teach me everything!

text:
Lucky, yeah, woohoo!
Should I pop a question to you?\pSince we're near the BATTLE TOWER,
how about a question about its power?\pOf the choices you see,
which is the right one for me?

text: If {STR_VAR_1} is what you suggest,\nit must be the very best!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!

text:

Ouch, ouch! Oooh, that feels great!\pMy name's {STR_VAR_1}.

advice?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching13
text: Oh, why?\pI won't be a big bother, I promise!\nPlease?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
text: Thank you. Mighty good of you!\n…Cough! Cough!\pOogh, I have to toughen up quick…\pI'll be heading off to the BATTLE TOWER\nright away, but what would be better\lfor me? Level 50 or Open Level?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
text: Hm, all right. That's {STR_VAR_1}.\nI'll go there right away.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up for\nhelp--after all, you're my mentor!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
text:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…?\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me all self-conscious.\pI… I'm {STR_VAR_1}.\pI'm really embarrassed to say this,
but I explore ancient ruins and such.\pI'm even more embarrassed to admit
I'm interested in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, you have a reputation as
a tough TRAINER…\pIt's hard for me to say this,
but I want to ask something.\pCould you become my teacher and
give me advice?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
text: Please don't brush me off like this!\nI can't live with the humiliation.\pPlease become my teacher!\nI need your advice!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
text:
Th-thank you…\pBut please don't look at me like that.
It makes me all flustered.\pPlease, answer me without looking
at my eyes.\pAt the BATTLE TOWER…
Which level should I attempt?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
text:
Oh… Okay!
I'll try my hand at that.\pI hope I can make a valiant challenge
without getting all flustered…\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
If we meet again, I hope you will be\las helpful.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
text:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really real?\pYou may call me {STR_VAR_1}.\pI have been toying with the idea of
apprenticing under a strong TRAINER.\pSo, I must say I'm lucky you came along!
…You really are {PLAYER}{KUN}, yes?\pNo, no, if you are real, it's fine.
I merely want you to recognize me\las your apprentice.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
text:
Oh?
But what would compel you to refuse?\pI apologize for being skeptical about
your identity.\pPlease accept my apology and
accept me as your apprentice.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
text:
You really are accepting me?
I don't wish to celebrate prematurely.\pIf it is true, I apologize.
But now, I need your advice.\pIf I were to enter the BATTLE TOWER,
what would be worthy of me?\lLevel 50 or Open Level?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
text:
{STR_VAR_1}?
Are you certain?\pI see. If that's the case, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI realize I can annoy, but it delights
me that you have accepted me.\pLet us meet again!

text:

Oh, {PLAYER}!\pI'm all tangled up in a dilemma
that I can't decide.\pI can't decide what I should make
my {STR_VAR_1} hold.\pPlease tell me, {PLAYER}.
What item should I make it hold?

text: Oh, really? I shouldn't make\nmy {STR_VAR_1} hold anything?

text: Waaaah! Please don't be mean!\pThat item {STR_VAR_1} was already\nrecommended to me before, sob…\pOr do you mean I shouldn't make\nmy {STR_VAR_2} hold anything?

text:

Great! I wanted to ask you something!\pDo you make your POKéMON hold items?
I want to make mine hold items, but…\pWhat item would be good for
{STR_VAR_1} to hold?\pWhat do you think?

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing1
text: Huh? You mean my {STR_VAR_1} doesn't\nhave to hold anything?

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem1
text: Oh, I get it! I'll do that!\nThanks for teaching me!

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem1
text: Oh, wow! One {STR_VAR_1}, huh?\nOkay, I'll do that!\pThanks for teaching me!

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended1
text: Oh, uh, no, that's not what I meant.\nI want to know about a different item\lthan the ones I already know.\pOr do you mean that my POKéMON doesn't\nhave to hold anything this time?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem2
text: {PLAYER}, hello!\nIt's about my {STR_VAR_1}…\pI want to make it hold a good item.\nWhat would be good for it?

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing2
text: Oh, then my {STR_VAR_1} doesn't have\nto hold anything?

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem2
text: Okay, I got it!\nSee you again!

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem2
text: Oh, the item {STR_VAR_1}?\nUnderstood!\pI'll do my best to find one!\nSee you again!

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended2
text:
Somebody taught me about
the {STR_VAR_1} already.\pI want my POKéMON to hold a different
kind of item.\pOr do you think {STR_VAR_2} doesn't
have to hold anything?

text:
Hello, {PLAYER}…
I'm sorry to disturb you, but I have\lsomething else I wanted to ask you.\pI don't think I'm good enough to win
matches on my own, so I'm thinking of\lmaking my {STR_VAR_1} hold an item.\pBut I don't know what would be good.\p{PLAYER}, please, could you decide
for me?

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing3
text: A POKéMON belonging to someone like me\nwould be better off without an item?

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem3
text: I understand…\nYou're saying I shouldn't rely on items.\lI'll do my best not to!\pThank you very much!

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem3
text: The item {STR_VAR_1}, okay.\nI'm not sure if I can get one…\lNo! I'll do my best to get it.\pThank you very much!

text:

the item {STR_VAR_1} very well?\pOr do you mean I shouldn't make
my {STR_VAR_2} hold anything?

text:

There's something I wanted to ask you.\pYou know how you decided which
POKéMON I should have for me?\pBut I never asked you what item
it should be holding.\pSince you already gave me advice,
how about seeing this to the end?\pWhat would be good? I want to make

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing4
text: Oh! So my {STR_VAR_1} should do\nthe best it can empty-handed?

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem4
text: If you think that's best, I'll do that.\pKnowing that you made the decision,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.\nBye!

text:

Not bad. I'll use it!\pKnowing that you made the decision,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.
Bye!

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended4
text: Huh? What are you saying?\nYou told me about the {STR_VAR_1}\lalready before.\pOr do you mean my {STR_VAR_2} should\ndo the best it can empty-handed?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem5

put that saying to good use.\pI seem to have run dry on what advice
I need.\pI do believe it's high time I bid you
farewell and strike out on my own.\pThank you, my mentor!
I apologize for my skepticism!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
text: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nFALLARBOR SITE!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
text: Now, do you wish to take the challenge\nof a Set KO Tourney?

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
text: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainFallarborTent
text:
In the FALLARBOR BATTLE TENT,
we undertake the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up
in the order that they are to appear in.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with a fine prize.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
text: Before showing you to the BATTLE\nTENT, I must save. Is that okay?

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
text: We offer two levels of challenge,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
text: Very well, now select your\nthree POKéMON, please.

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
text:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.

text:

required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.

text:
My dear challenger!\pYou did not save the game before
shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
text: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nVERDANTURF SITE!\pHere, the TRAINER's trust toward\nPOKéMON is tested.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
text: Do you wish to take the VERDANTURF\nBATTLE TENT challenge?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainVerdanturfTent
text:
In the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,
there is one crucial rule that must\lbe obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with a prize.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnFortified

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode

Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pCome back when you have made
your preparations.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
text: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AchievedThreeWinStreak

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
text: Welcome to the BATTLE TENT\nSLATEPORT SITE!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nTournament.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
text: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap challenge?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSlateportTent
text:
Here at the SLATEPORT BATTLE TENT,
we hold Battle Swap events\lusing rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win three times in\la row, you will earn a fine prize.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
text: We look forward to your next visit.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_StepThisWay
text: Please step this way.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnRentalMonsSaveResults
text: Thank you for participating!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.\nPlease wait.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnMonsExchangeRentals
text: I will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WonThreeMatchesReturnMons
text:
Congratulations!
You've won three straight matches!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange
for our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.
Please wait.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwardYouThisPrize
text: In recognition of your 3-win streak,\nwe award you this prize.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NoRoomInBagMakeRoom
text: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\pPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeenWaitingForYou
text: We've been waiting for you!\pBefore we resume your challenge,\nI must save the game.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
text: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't\nsave before you quit playing last time.\pAs a result, you have been disqualified\nfrom your challenge.

text: The Battle Swap rules are listed.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
text: Which heading do you want to read?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
text: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
text: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
text: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the third TRAINER in the event.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
text:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
text: The POKéMON of the SLATEPORT\nBATTLE TENT are all rentals.\pAll rental POKéMON are kept at\nLevel 30.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed2
text: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT\nrules are listed.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
text: Which heading do you want to read?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
text: Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,\nPOKéMON are required to think and\lbattle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
text:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDepending on its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
text:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
text:
When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
text: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
text: At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of\nyour opponents will be adjusted to\lmatch the levels of your POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will\nhave any POKéMON below Level 30.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
text: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT\nrules are listed.

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap
text: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…\pI beg your pardon?\nCan we sail to this place on the map?\pI know someone who will help you better.\nPlease wait.

label: EventTicket_Text_ThatPass
text: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…\pOh?\nThat PASS…

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
text:
Aye, mate, are you the one who brought
that mighty odd PASS?\pI'll tell you, you're trying to reach a
tiny spit of an island far in the south.\pThere's no telling what we'll encounter
once we reach there, aye.\lThat shivers my timbers!\pAll aboard!

label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
text: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to\nsee or do on this forgettable island.\pWhat say we sail back to LILYCOVE?

label: EventTicket_Text_SailHome
text: Aye, right, then!\nSail home we will!

label: EventTicket_Text_AsYouLike
text: Aye, right, as you like, then.

label: SouthernIsland_Interior_Text_Sign
text: “All dreams are but another reality.\nNever forget…”

label: SouthernIsland_Exterior_Text_Sign
text: “Those whose memories fade seek to\ncarve them in their hearts…”

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
text:
What's up, youngster?\pWhat, it's you who's supposed to have
a tattered old map?\pLet's have a look.
… … … … … …\pBoy, this is quite a ways away.
I'm afraid I can't help you…

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyHoldOnASecond
text: BRINEY: Hold on a second!\pWhat's the idea of turning down\nsomeone that I owe so much to?

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
text: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm terribly sorry.\pYou came to me seeking my help,\nand we almost turned you away.\pWell, let me make things right.\pWe'll sail right away, of course!\pLet's find this island on\nthis OLD SEA MAP!

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
text:
Is it you who brought that odd
ticket?\pWhere you're trying to go is an island
that's far, far away.\pNo one knows what awaits there…\pThe very thought excites my blood
as a sailing man!\pGet on board, youngster!

odd tickets?\p… … …Hm.\pThese tickets will get you to islands

or what may happen there.\pThe very thought excites my blood
as a sailing man!\pGet on board, youngster!

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman6
text: DAD: Hiyah! Haah! Dwah!\p…Oh? {PLAYER}!\pYou caught me right in the middle\nof a POKéMON training session!

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman7
text: DAD: {PLAYER}!\pWho would've thought you'd become\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pOkay!\nI won't be left behind!

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman8
text:
DAD: Hm? {PLAYER}?
What good timing!\pThis time, I'm going to challenge
you to battle.\pI'm waiting in the PETALBURG GYM.
Accept my challenge anytime!

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman9
text: DAD: …You amaze me, {PLAYER}.\nHow much higher will you soar?

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven1
text:
STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHave you been to MAUVILLE
already?\pYou should visit the BIKE SHOP
and get a MACH BIKE.\pThen, try exploring the GRANITE
CAVE thoroughly.\pYou may make a new discovery
there.

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven2
text: STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI've met a lot of different\nTRAINERS so far.\pBut you're one of a kind.\nYou're not like anyone else.

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven3
text:
STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pWhen you're on an adventure with
your POKéMON, what do you think?\pDo you consider them to be strong
partners?\pDo you think of them as fun
companions?\pDepending on how you think, your
adventure's significance changes.

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven4
text:
STEVEN: Hello?
{PLAYER}{KUN}?\pI'm involved in a spot of trouble
at the SPACE CENTER.\pI'm sorry, but I can't talk now.
Bye!

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven5
text:
STEVEN: Oh!
{PLAYER}{KUN}!\pThere's no need to talk.
It's past time for talking.\pYou have to believe in yourself
and do what's right.

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven6
text: … … … … … …\pSTEVEN appears not to be getting\nthe call…

label: MatchCall_Text_Steven7
text:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}… Congratulations
for entering the HALL OF FAME.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pI hope we can meet again
somewhere!

label: MatchCall_Text_BirchRegisterCall
text:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I've already heard about you!\pIt seems your POKéNAV's been
upgraded with MATCH CALL.\pWell, I should register, too!\pThat way, I'd be able to examine
your POKéDEX even while you're\lout in the field.\p… … … … … …

label: MatchCall_Text_RegisteredBirch
text: Registered PROF. BIRCH\nin the POKéNAV.

label: MatchCall_Text_UnusedProfBirch
text: PROF. BIRCH: When one has both\nthe POKéDEX and POKéNAV, studying\lPOKéMON becomes more fun, eh?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
text:
MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSince you called me, the POKéNAV
must be working properly!\pOther people will be registered,
so try calling them up, too!\pGood! Good!
You seem to be quite happy!\pHm…
How could I know that?\pIt's because I'm looking down at
you from my office window!\pWahahaha!
See you again!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
text:
MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pWhat's wrong? Have you forgotten
about that little errand of mine?\pI need you to deliver my letter
to STEVEN in DEWFORD.\pAfter that, deliver our parcel to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.\pYou remember, don't you?\pNow, since I am a busy PRESIDENT,
I have to go! Bye-bye!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
text: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAh, so you've met STEVEN!\nI'd better reward you, then!\pWhen you visit RUSTBORO again,\ncome see me at my office.\pI'll be waiting for you!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
text:
MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pDid you know that DEVON was
digging the RUSTURF TUNNEL?\pBut we shut down the operation to
protect the POKéMON in the area.\pIt's a no-brainer, really.\pIt's more important to let POKéMON
live in peace than worry about our\lown convenience.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone5
text: MR. STONE: Hello, hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI heard from someone in PETALBURG\nthat you're NORMAN's child!\pNo wonder you're such a capable\nbeing!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
text: MR. STONE: What's that?\pYou battled your own father and\ndefeated him?\pThat's astounding!\pI had no idea that I befriended\nsomeone so special! Wahaha!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone7
text:
Hello!
This is DEVON CORPORATI…\lOh, hello, {PLAYER}!\pOur PRESIDENT was here a little
while ago, but he's gone out.\pOur PRESIDENT is busy, but you
seem to be just as busy, {PLAYER}.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
text: …Huh? …What's that?\pGROU… Yes? …DON?\pYou're breaking up…\n…can't hear…\pBZZZZ…

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
text: …Huh? …What's that?\pSeaflo… Yes? …Caver…?\pYou're breaking up…\n…can't hear…\pBZZZZ…

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
text:
MR. STONE: {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's me!\pYou were apparently involved in all
sorts of things, but I, being busy,\lhaven't a clue exactly what!\pHowever, I urge you to take
the road you believe in and walk it.\pI'll always be in your corner!
Take care!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone11
text:
MR. STONE: … … … … … …
Is this maybe {PLAYER}{KUN}?\pYour voice is so full of confidence,
I didn't recognize you right off!\pHm! You must come visit us at DEVON
sometime!

label: GiddyText_WhenYouSeeTheSettingSunDoesIt

label: GiddyText_LyingBackInTheGreenGrass

label: GiddyText_SecretBasesAreSoWonderful

label: MoveTutor_Text_ThisMoveCanOnlyBeLearnedOnce
text: This move can be learned only\nonce. Is that okay?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
text:
Heh! My POKéMON totally rules!
It's cooler than any POKéMON!\pI was lipping off with a swagger in
my step like that when the CHAIRMAN\lchewed me out.\pThat took the swagger out of my step.\pIf you'd like, I'll teach the move
SWAGGER to a POKéMON of yours.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerDeclined
text: What, no? Can't you get into\nthe spirit of things?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerWhichMon
text: All right, which POKéMON wants to\nlearn how to SWAGGER?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTaught
text: I'll just praise my POKéMON from now\non without the swagger.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
text:
Did you know that you can go from
here a long way in that direction\lwithout changing direction?\pI might even be able to roll
that way.\pDo you think your POKéMON will
want to roll, too?\pI can teach one the move ROLLOUT
if you'd like.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutDeclined
text: You don't need to be shy about it.\nLet's roll!

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon
text: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if\nthe POKéMON looked like me.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTaught
text: Rolling around in the grass makes me\nhappy. Come on, let's roll!

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
text:
There's a move that gets stronger
when you keep using it in a row.\pIt's a BUG-type move, and it is
wickedly cool.\pIt's called FURY CUTTER.
Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterDeclined
text: We're not on the same wavelength.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterWhichMon
text: Yay!\nShow me which POKéMON I should teach.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTaught
text: I get a thrill watching to see if\nthe move keeps hitting in succession!

label: MoveTutor_MimicTeach
text: Ah, young one!\pI am also a young one, but I mimic\nthe styles and speech of the elderly\lfolks of this town.\pWhat do you say, young one?\nWould you agree to it if I were to\loffer to teach the move MIMIC?

label: MoveTutor_MimicDeclined
text: Oh, boo! I wanted to teach MIMIC\nto your POKéMON!

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicWhichMon
text: Fwofwo! And so I shall!\nLet me see the POKéMON\lyou wish me to teach.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught
text: MIMIC is a move of great depth.\pCould you execute it to perfection\nas well as me…?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
text:
I want all sorts of things!
But I used up my allowance…\pWouldn't it be nice if there were
a spell that made money appear when\lyou waggle a finger?\pIf you want, I can teach your POKéMON
the move METRONOME.\pMoney won't appear, but your POKéMON
will waggle a finger. Yes?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeDeclined
text: Okay. I'll be here if you change\nyour mind.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon
text: Okay! I'll teach it!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught
text: When a POKéMON waggles its finger\nlike a METRONOME, all sorts of nice\lthings happen.\pWouldn't it be nice if we could\nuse it, too?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
text:
Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN
POWER to stay awake.\pShe should just take a nap like I do,
and SLEEP TALK.\pI can teach your POKéMON how to
SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined
text: Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake\nwith HIDDEN POWER, too…

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon
text: Ah, an appreciative child!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught
text: I've never once gotten my wife's\ncoin trick right.\pI would be happy if I got it right\neven as I SLEEP TALK…

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
text:
When I see the wide world from up
here on the roof…\pI think about how nice it would be
if there were more than just one me\lso I could enjoy all sorts of lives.\pOf course it's not possible.
Giggle…\pI know! Would you be interested in
having a POKéMON learn SUBSTITUTE?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined
text: Oh, no?\pA POKéMON can make a copy of\nitself using it, you know.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteWhichMon
text: Giggle…\nWhich POKéMON do you want me to\lteach SUBSTITUTE?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught
text: We human beings should enjoy our\nown lives to the utmost!\pI hope you'll get that way, too!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
text:
I can't do this anymore!\pIt's utterly hopeless!\pI'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER,
so I can't win at the MOSSDEEP GYM\lno matter how hard I try!\pArgh! Punch! Punch! Punch!
Punch! Punch! Punch!\pWhat, don't look at me that way!
I'm only hitting the ground!\pOr do you want me to teach your
POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined
text: Darn! You're even making fun of me?\nPunch! Punch! Punch!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon
text: What? You do? You're a good person!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught
text: I want you to win at the MOSSDEEP GYM\nusing that DYNAMICPUNCH!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
text:
Sigh…\pSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER is really
lovably admirable.\pBut that also means I have many
rivals for his attention.\pHe's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE.
I couldn't even catch his eye.\pPlease, let me teach your POKéMON
the move DOUBLE-EDGE!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined
text: Oh…\nEven you rejected me…

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon
text: Okay, which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
text: I won't live for love anymore!\nI'll become tough!

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach
text:
I don't intend to be going nowhere
fast in the sticks like this forever.\pYou watch me, I'll get out to the city
and become a huge hit.\pSeriously, I'm going to cause
a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!\pIf you overheard that, I'll happily
teach EXPLOSION to your POKéMON!

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionDeclined
text: Gaah! You're turning me down because\nI live in the country?

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionWhichMon
text: Fine! An EXPLOSION it is!\nWhich POKéMON wants to blow up?

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTaught
text: For a long time, I've taught POKéMON\nhow to use EXPLOSION, but I've yet\lto ignite my own EXPLOSION…\pMaybe it's because deep down,\nI would rather stay here…

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan30

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan40

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan60

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan90

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan110

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan120

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan130

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan160

label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Upcoming
text:

It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pSLATEPORT's most popular kind of guy,
the ENERGY GURU, is in the news again!\pHe promises to, “Stupendously go for
it in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!”\pWhile he refused to elaborate on what
he will stupendously go for, the\lENERGY GURU advised, “Save up your\lmoney. That'll be good…”\pIt sounds like a trip to SLATEPORT
would be well worth your while that day.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.

you've always dreamt about…\pYou may be in for fateful encounters
with them all!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.

It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pWe have big news for everyone

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Intro
text: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pSince you're already here, how would\nyou like to battle?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0AcceptBattle
text: Okay!\nHere we come!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0DeclineBattle
text: Hunh?\nOh, you can't now…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Defeated
text: Waaargh! You're too strong!\nAbout me losing… Please keep it secret!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PostBattle
text: What do you think of my SECRET BASE?\nCome visit me again tomorrow.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PreChampion
text: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pFeel free to hang out!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Intro
text: There're a lot of places where\nyou can make a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?\pOh, would you like to have a battle?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5AcceptBattle
text: Okay, here goes!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5DeclineBattle
text: Oh…\nYou can't now, okay.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Defeated
text: Hmmm… It's our loss…\nBut don't tell anyone!\lIt's a confidential secret!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PostBattle
text: If you're in this area again,\nI hope you'll visit me.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PreChampion
text: There're a lot of places where you can\nmake a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro
text:
This is a popular spot.
It's always taken.\pOh! Were you thinking about
taking this spot, too?\pI'll tell you what, you can have this
spot if you can beat me.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1AcceptBattle
text: Okay!\nI'm going to defend my SECRET BASE!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1DeclineBattle
text: Hunh? Is that right?\nYou're not interested in this spot?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Defeated
text: I can't keep going!\nI surrender!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PostBattle
text: Okay, when I move one day,\nthis place will be yours!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion
text: This is a popular spot.\nIt's always taken.\pI waited a long time for it to open.\nI finally got to use it!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
text: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.\pWould you like to see how strong I am?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6AcceptBattle
text: I'm going to go all out!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6DeclineBattle
text: Oh.\nSome other time, then!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Defeated
text: Hmm… I've still got lots to learn.\nI have to study some more.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PostBattle
text: Thanks for battling with me.\nPlease come back again tomorrow.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PreChampion
text: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
text: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.\pSo, how would you like a battle?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2AcceptBattle
text: That's the way!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2DeclineBattle
text: When you're ready, give me a shout!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Defeated
text: Aww! Done in!\nBut it's still fun to battle!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle
text: Well, anyway, I should go buy some\ndecorations and furniture.\pI want my SECRET BASE to be a place\nother people can enjoy.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion
text: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
text:
I simply adore shopping for decorations
and furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just
as much.\pIf you would be so kind, will you battle
with my POKéMON?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7AcceptBattle
text: Thank you.\nShall we begin?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7DeclineBattle
text: Oh.\nHow disappointing…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Defeated
text: I concede…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PostBattle
text: That was all in good fun!\nI should go enjoy shopping now.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PreChampion
text: I simply adore shopping for decorations\nand furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just\nas much.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro
text: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?\pBut since you found me, how about we\nhave a battle?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3AcceptBattle
text: I'm not going down easily!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3DeclineBattle
text: Oh… Are you maybe tired from searching\nfor this place?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Defeated
text: I went down…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PostBattle
text: Where's your SECRET BASE?\nI should go visit you there.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PreChampion
text: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
text: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!\pIn the meantime, want to battle?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8AcceptBattle
text: This is my SECRET BASE.\nI can't lose!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8DeclineBattle
text: I'll battle with you anytime.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Defeated
text: Huh?\nDid I just lose?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PostBattle
text: I won't lose at collecting decorations.\nCome visit again!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PreChampion
text: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro
text:
I found a spot I liked, and I did it up
with my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow
stronger with it.\pThat's what I do.
Want to battle with me?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4AcceptBattle
text: Show me what you're made of!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4DeclineBattle
text: I guess there are times when you're not\ninto it.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Defeated
text: I know exactly what you're made of now.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PostBattle
text: We can both become stronger.\nLet's keep at it!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion
text: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up\nwith my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow\nstronger with it.\pEvery day is a great day.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro
text: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?\pWant to see my taste in battling?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9AcceptBattle
text: There's no holding back!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9DeclineBattle
text: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style\nanytime.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Defeated
text: You're supremely talented!\nYour power seems to be limitless…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PostBattle
text: What did you think of my style?\nI'll keep on polishing it!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PreChampion
text: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYouPlanningOnGoingInThere
text:
Are you planning on going deep
in there?\pHow about bringing me back some
SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS?\pI can make you something good if
you bring me the ingredients.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
text: If you bring me four each of the\nSHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS,\lI can make you a SHELL BELL…\pYou can get those ingredients\nevery day.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
text: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS!\nAnd enough of them, too!\pWould you like me to make you\na SHELL BELL with them?

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
text: All righty, then! I'll make you\na SHELL BELL right away.\p… … … … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pThere! Done!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
text:
Have a POKéMON hold on to that.
It'll love it, that's for certain.\pWhy, the SHELL BELL's chime…
It's simply sublime!\pYou can get its ingredients every day,
so I can make you more.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WantedToMakeShellBell
text: Oh… Is that so…\nI wanted to make a SHELL BELL…

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
text: You don't have space in your BAG\nif I were to make it for you.\pYou should make room and come back\nfor a SHELL BELL.

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoalSaltNowNothing
text: There was some SHOAL SALT here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoallShellNowNothing
text: There was a SHOAL SHELL here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.

label: gText_WantToUseSurf
text: The water is dyed a deep blue…\nWould you like to SURF?

label: gText_PlayerUsedSurf
text: {STR_VAR_1} used SURF!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinIntro
text: If you have POKéMON with you, then\nyou're an official POKéMON TRAINER!\lYou can't say no to my challenge!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinDefeated
text: Arrgh, I lost…\nI should have trained mine more…

label: Route102_Text_CalvinPostBattle
text: Listen, you. If you're strong,\nyou should have told me before!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
text: I've been working hard at this since\nI saw you before.\pI'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegisterShort
text: I'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
text: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately\ntrained my POKéMON.\lYou can't say no to my challenge!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchDefeated
text: Arrgh, I lost…\nIs my training method not right?

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchPostBattle
text: If you're going to get stronger,\nI'll get stronger, too.

label: Route102_Text_AllenIntro
text: Did you just become a TRAINER?\nWe're both beginners!

label: Route102_Text_AllenDefeated
text: I called you because I thought\nI could beat you…

label: Route102_Text_AllenPostBattle
text: I haven't won once yet…\nI wish I would win soon…

label: Route102_Text_RickIntro
text: Hahah! Our eyes met!\nI'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!

label: Route102_Text_RickDefeated
text: Ow! Down and out!

label: Route102_Text_RickPostBattle
text: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER,\nyou have to challenge! It's a rule!

label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
text: I'm going to keep winning and aim\nto be the best TRAINER.\pHelp me further my career!

label: Route102_Text_TianaDefeated
text: I ended up furthering your career…

label: Route102_Text_TianaPostBattle
text: To keep winning my way up, I see that\nI have to catch more POKéMON.

label: Route103_Text_DaisyIntro
text: Did you feel the tug of our\nsoul-soothing fragrance?

label: Route103_Text_DaisyDefeated
text: You weren't led astray by our aroma…

label: Route103_Text_DaisyPostBattle
text: Aromatherapy is a form of mental\nhealing that works with fragrances.

label: Route103_Text_AmyIntro
text: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!

label: Route103_Text_AmyDefeated
text: AMY: Uh-oh, we lost.

label: Route103_Text_AmyPostBattle
text: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.

label: Route103_Text_AmyNotEnoughPokemon
text: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.

label: Route103_Text_LivIntro
text: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.

label: Route103_Text_LivDefeated
text: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister…

label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
text: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut we still lost…

label: Route103_Text_AmyLivRegister
text: LIV: Really, we're a lot better…\nIt's true! We'll show you next time!

label: Route103_Text_LivNotEnoughPokemon
text: LIV: If you want to battle us,\nyou have to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchIntro
text: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchDefeated
text: AMY: Aww, boo!\nWe couldn't win again…

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchPostBattle
text: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchNotEnoughPokemon
text: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchIntro
text: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchDefeated
text: LIV: Awww, we lost again…\nBig sister…

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
text: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut why did we lose again?

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchNotEnoughPokemon
text: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!

label: Route103_Text_AndrewIntro
text: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up!\nI'm getting frustrated and mean!\lThat's it! Battle me!

label: Route103_Text_AndrewDefeated
text: Gah! Lost it!\nI'm even more annoyed now!

label: Route103_Text_AndrewPostBattle
text: Gah, I'm still boiling mad…\nGrrrrr…

label: Route103_Text_MiguelIntro
text: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable!\nDon't be shy--I'll show you!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelDefeated
text: Oh, my gosh!\nMy darling POKéMON!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelPostBattle
text: My delightful POKéMON looks darling\neven when it's fainted!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRegister
text: I'll get you to come out and look in\non my delightful POKéMON again!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchIntro
text: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable\nPOKéMON has become more darling!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchDefeated
text: Oh!\nMy darling POKéMON!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchPostBattle
text: The more I spend time with it,\nthe more adorable my POKéMON becomes.

label: Route103_Text_PeteIntro
text: This sort of distance…\nYou should just swim it!

label: Route103_Text_PeteDefeated
text: Oh, that's good going!

label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
text: Oh, I understand where you're coming\nfrom now.\pIf I had a POKéMON that trusty,\nI'd want to SURF on it, too!

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleIntro
text: Watch where you're going!\nWe're going to crash!

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleDefeated
text: Groan…

label: Route103_Text_IsabellePostBattle
text: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing…\nSorry for almost crashing into you.

label: Route103_Text_RhettIntro
text: Whoa!\nHow'd you get into a space this small?

label: Route103_Text_RhettDefeated
text: Whoa!\nThe kid can rock!

label: Route103_Text_RhettPostBattle
text: Do you like cramped quarters\nlike this?

label: Route103_Text_MarcosIntro
text: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?

label: Route103_Text_MarcosDefeated
text: My one-man show is ruined…

label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
text: I was playing my guitar where few\npeople were around, but a lot of fans\lhave gathered.\pHeh, maybe I should turn pro.

label: Route104_Text_GinaIntro
text: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our\nPOKéMON!

label: Route104_Text_GinaDefeat
text: GINA: Losing upsets me!

label: Route104_Text_GinaPostBattle
text: GINA: You are strong!\nWe have to train lots more!

label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
text: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON?\nThen, we don't battle with you.\pIf there's only one POKéMON, it will\nbe lonesome. That's not nice.

label: Route104_Text_MiaIntro
text: MIA: We are twins, so we battle\nPOKéMON together.

label: Route104_Text_MiaDefeat
text: MIA: We battled together, but we\nboth lost…

label: Route104_Text_MiaPostBattle
text: MIA: We will train our POKéMON more\nand be strong like you.

label: Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
text: MIA: You want to battle with us?\pIt's a big no-no if you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you.\lWe're too strong for you!

label: Route104_Text_IvanIntro
text: Why keep it a secret?\nI'm the WATER POKéMON expert!\pHuh?\nYou don't know me?

label: Route104_Text_IvanDefeat
text: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may\nsay so, but I guess not… Bleah…

label: Route104_Text_IvanPostBattle
text: I got too into fishing.\nI forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…

label: Route104_Text_BillyIntro
text: Leaving footprints in the sand is\nso fun!

label: Route104_Text_BillyDefeat
text: Waah! I got sand in my runners!\nThey're all gritty!

label: Route104_Text_BillyPostBattle
text: I want to leave my footprints in\nthe sand everywhere, but they\ldisappear quickly…

label: Route104_Text_HaleyIntro
text: Should I…\nOr shouldn't I?\pOkay, sure, I will battle!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyDefeat
text: I shouldn't have battled…

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostBattle
text: If you're faced with a decision and\nyou let someone else choose for you,\lyou will regret it, however things\lturn out.

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1
text: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2
text: You're strong, but should I register\nyou in my POKéNAV?\lMaybe I shouldn't…\pOkay, sure, I will register you!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
text: Come on, battle with me!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchDefeat
text: Ohh…\nI thought I could win…

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch
text: I made the decision to battle, so\nI can accept this loss with grace.\pI am still upset about losing!

label: Route104_Text_WinstonIntro
text: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge.\nI have a lot of money.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonDefeat
text: Why couldn't I win?

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostBattle
text: There are some things money can't buy.\nThat's POKéMON…

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1
text: Hm?\nAh, you've obtained a POKéNAV.\pI will gladly register you.\nAfter all, I have plenty of money.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2
text: Hm?\nAh, you've obtained a POKéNAV.\pI will gladly register you.\nAfter all, I have plenty of money.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchIntro
text: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch\nof things about POKéMON.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchDefeat
text: I lost again?\nWhy couldn't I win?

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch
text: I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't\nseem to win at POKéMON…\pIt's so deep, the world of POKéMON…

label: Route104_Text_CindyIntro
text: We must have been fated to meet.\nMay I ask you for a battle?

label: Route104_Text_CindyDefeat
text: Oh, my!

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostBattle
text: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister1
text: Hello, we meet again.\pWe seem to be drawn together. Let's\nregister each other in our POKéNAVS.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister2
text: We should commemorate how we seem\nto be drawn to each other.\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchIntro
text: Hello, we meet again.\nMay I ask you for a battle?

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchDefeat
text: Oh, my…\nI did the best that I could…

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostRematch
text: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.

label: Route104_Text_DarianIntro
text: I fished up a tough-looking POKéMON!\pIt has this magical quality to it!\nIt surely looks tough, yes it does!

label: Route104_Text_DarianDefeat
text: What the…

label: Route104_Text_DarianPostBattle
text: Hey, MAGIKARP, you sure don't live up\nto your name, do you?

label: Route105_Text_FosterIntro
text: There's supposed to be a mystical\nrock around here.\lDo you know anything about it?

label: Route105_Text_FosterDefeated
text: I was thinking too much about that\nrock, while my POKéMON remained weak…

label: Route105_Text_FosterPostBattle
text: I can spend hours and hours staring\nat a nice rock without growing bored.

label: Route105_Text_LuisIntro
text: Whew! I was worried that a kid was\ndrowning when I saw you.\pYou seem to be okay, so what do you\nsay to a battle?

label: Route105_Text_LuisDefeated
text: Glub… Glub…

label: Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle
text: If you are drowning, the signal is to\nwave one arm toward the beach.

label: Route105_Text_DominikIntro
text: Swimming the deep blue sea…\nIt feels the greatest!

label: Route105_Text_DominikDefeated
text: I lost…\nNow I'm feeling blue…

label: Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle
text: Why is the sea blue?\pI learned about that at the MUSEUM in\nSLATEPORT, but I forgot.

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyIntro
text: My body feels lighter in the water.\nIt's as if I've gotten slimmer!

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyDefeated
text: I'm floating…

label: Route105_Text_PostBattle
text: Your body weight is reduced to just\none tenth in the water.\pThat would make me…\nWhoops! I'm not telling you my weight!

label: Route105_Text_ImaniIntro
text: The blue, blue sky…\nThe vast sea…\lIt's so peaceful…

label: Route105_Text_ImaniDefeated
text: I lost while I was lounging!

label: Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle
text: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be\nwith. Giggle.

label: Route105_Text_AndresIntro
text: I'm convinced that the sea keeps\nsecrets from us.

label: Route105_Text_AndresDefeated
text: Yes…\nI am no good at battling…

label: Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle
text: I'm sure there are many secrets to be\ndiscovered in the world's seas.\pI mean to find them all!

label: Route105_Text_AndresRegister
text: Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing\nto register me in your POKéNAV?

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchIntro
text: I've told you that I'm weak…\nAre you sure you want to do this?

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchDefeated
text: Yes…\nI didn't think I could win.

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle
text: I may be weak at battling, but my\ndrive to explore can't be bested.\pI will travel the seas all around\nthe world!

label: Route105_Text_JosueIntro
text: I'm exhausted from swimming.\nI'm just not used to it.\pI need a battle for a change of pace!

label: Route105_Text_JosueDefeated
text: I lost because I battled at sea.

label: Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle
text: Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better\nmatch than the sea.

label: Route106_Text_ElliotIntro
text: Which do you prefer, fishing in the\nsea or a stream?

label: Route106_Text_ElliotDefeated
text: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost\nspectacularly!

label: Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle
text: Fishing is the greatest whether it's\nin the sea or a stream.\lYou agree with me, right?

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRegister
text: Fishing's great, but so is battling.\nIf you don't mind, can we meet again?

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
text: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing.\nI'll show you an impressive battle!

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchDefeated
text: I lost again spectacularly!

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle
text: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest!\nYou agree with me, right?

label: Route106_Text_NedIntro
text: What do people do if they need to go\nto a washroom?\pWhat if my ROD hooks a big one while\nI'm in the washroom? I just can't go…

label: Route106_Text_NedDefeated
text: I lost because I'm trying to not go\nto the washroom…

label: Route106_Text_NedPostBattle
text: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook\na big one!

label: Route106_Text_DouglasIntro
text: Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in\nthe water you can't catch me!

label: Route106_Text_DouglasDefeated
text: I give up!

label: Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle
text: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…

label: Route106_Text_KylaIntro
text: The sea is my backyard. I'm not going\nto take it easy because you're a kid!

label: Route106_Text_KylaDefeated
text: Did you take it easy on me by any\nchance?

label: Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle
text: Drifting along with the waves…\nI love it! Why don't you give it a try?

label: Route107_Text_DarrinIntro
text: Yawn…\pI must have drifted off to sleep while\nI was drifting in the waves.

label: Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated
text: Ahaha, I lost…\nI'll take a snooze, I think…

label: Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle
text: Floating and being rocked by\nthe waves--it's like sleeping in\la plush, comfy bed.

label: Route107_Text_TonyIntro
text: The sea is like my backyard.\nLet's battle!

label: Route107_Text_TonyDefeated
text: I lost on my home field…\nI'm in shock!

label: Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle
text: I swim the seas with a heart full of\ndreams…\pIt's a song!\nAnyways, I'm swimming some more.

label: Route107_Text_TonyRegister
text: You've shocked me to the bone!\nWell, so you won't forget me…

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchIntro
text: Swimming in the big, wide sea,\nmy POKéMON has grown stronger!

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated
text: What a shock!\pMy POKéMON has gotten stronger, but\nI stayed weak as a TRAINER!

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle
text: What you learn in battle makes you\na stronger TRAINER.\lThe waves taught me that.

label: Route107_Text_DeniseIntro
text: Do you know a little town called\nDEWFORD?

label: Route107_Text_DeniseDefeated
text: I hate this!

label: Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle
text: A weird saying is getting really\ntrendy at DEWFORD HALL.

label: Route107_Text_BethIntro
text: Did you want to battle me?\nSure, I'll go with you!

label: Route107_Text_BethDefeated
text: I wasn't good enough for you.

label: Route107_Text_BethPostBattle
text: I think you're going to keep getting\nbetter. I'll go for it, too!

label: Route107_Text_LisaIntro
text: LISA: We challenge you as a sister\nand brother!

label: Route107_Text_LisaDefeated
text: LISA: Awesome.\nYou're in a different class of tough.

label: Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle
text: LISA: Do you have any friends who\nwould go to the beach with you?

label: Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon
text: LISA: If you want to battle with us,\nbring more POKéMON.

label: Route107_Text_RayIntro
text: RAY: We always battle POKéMON,\nme and my sister.\pI always lose, but we can beat you\n2-on-2!

label: Route107_Text_RayDefeated
text: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level\nthan us!

label: Route107_Text_RayPostBattle
text: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.\nI raised it, and now it's my important\lpartner!

label: Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon
text: RAY: If you want to battle us,\ngo bring some more POKéMON!

label: Route107_Text_CamronIntro
text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm nowhere near tired!

label: Route107_Text_CamronDefeated
text: That exhausted me…

label: Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle
text: I still have swimming and running left\nto do after this.\pAm I going to be okay?

label: Route108_Text_JeromeIntro
text: My dream is to swim the world's seven\nseas!

label: Route108_Text_JeromeDefeated
text: I won't be able to swim the seven seas\nlike this…

label: Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle
text: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of\nthe pleasures of swimming!

label: Route108_Text_MatthewIntro
text: Ahoy, there! Are you going out to\nthe ABANDONED SHIP, too?

label: Route108_Text_MatthewDefeated
text: I'm sinking!\nGlub… Glub…

label: Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle
text: Some people even go inside that\nABANDONED SHIP.

label: Route108_Text_TaraIntro
text: My liar of a boyfriend told me that\nI look great in a bikini…

label: Route108_Text_TaraDefeated
text: Oh, boo!

label: Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle
text: Even if it's a lie, I love being told\nI look great…\lWe girls are so complex…

label: Route108_Text_MissyIntro
text: I love the sea!\nI forget all my worries when I swim!

label: Route108_Text_MissyDefeated
text: When I lose a battle, I get all\nstressed out!

label: Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle
text: Work off your stress by swimming!\nIt's so healthy!

label: Route108_Text_CoryIntro
text: I love WATER-type POKéMON.\nI love other POKéMON, too!

label: Route108_Text_CoryDefeated
text: Waaah! I lost!\nWaaah! Waaah!

label: Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle
text: Shouting is good for me!\nIt uplifts me!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRegister
text: I love tough TRAINERS, too!\nRegister me in your POKéNAV!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchIntro
text: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchDefeated
text: Waaah! I lost again!\nWaaah! Waaah!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle
text: If you're faced with a challenge,\ntry shouting at the sea!

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaIntro
text: I take huge pride in my POKéMON.\nWe'll show you one speedy battle!

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaDefeated
text: That wasn't cute at all.

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle
text: Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't\nmind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…

label: Route109_Text_DavidIntro
text: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!\nThis is what you call “cut”!

label: Route109_Text_DavidDefeated
text: Aiyah!\nFlubbed out!

label: Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle
text: Hiyah!\pMy sculpted abs have nothing to do\nwith POKéMON battles!

label: Route109_Text_AliceIntro
text: Are you properly protected against\nthe sun?

label: Route109_Text_AliceDefeated
text: Ouch, ouch, ouch!

label: Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle
text: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!

label: Route109_Text_HueyIntro
text: I've laid anchor in ports around\nthe world, but SLATEPORT's the best.

label: Route109_Text_HueyDefeated
text: You're the best!

label: Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle
text: In the best port was the best\nTRAINER…

label: Route109_Text_EdmondIntro
text: Urrrrppp…\nBattle? With me?

label: Route109_Text_EdmondDefeated
text: Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh…\nUrrrrpppp…

label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
text: I'm usually stronger than this!\nI'm just seasick as a dog!\pI'm a SAILOR, but…

label: Route109_Text_RickyIntro
text: I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP\nat the SEASHORE HOUSE…

label: Route109_Text_RickyDefeated
text: Groan…

label: Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle
text: I'm getting famished… My inner tube\nlooks like a giant doughnut…

label: Route109_Text_RickyRegister
text: Will you have another match with me\nwhen I'm not all thirsty?

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro
text: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in\nme for a battle!

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchDefeated
text: I lost…\nIt's because I'm hungry…

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle
text: When you eat on a beach, everything\nseems to taste a little better.

label: Route109_Text_LolaIntro
text: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like\na giant flower?

label: Route109_Text_LolaDefeated
text: Mommy!

label: Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle
text: If you look at the beach from the sky,\nit looks like a big flower garden!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRegister
text: Me?\nI'm here every day!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro
text: I'm not losing to you again!\nThat's why I have my inner tube!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchDefeated
text: Mommy!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle
text: If I have an inner tube, me and my\nPOKéMON's cuteness goes way up!

label: Route109_Text_AustinaIntro
text: I can't swim without my inner tube,\nbut I won't lose at POKéMON!

label: Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated
text: Did I lose because I have an inner\ntube?

label: Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle
text: My inner tube is a fashion item.\nI can't be seen without it.

label: Route109_Text_GwenIntro
text: Hi, big TRAINER.\nWill you battle with me?

label: Route109_Text_GwenDefeated
text: Oh, you're strong.

label: Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle
text: How did you get to be so strong?

label: Route109_Text_CarterIntro
text: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch\nhimself a big one!

label: Route109_Text_CarterDefeated
text: This dude just lost one…

label: Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle
text: This dude thinks you're a big one.\nNo, you're a big-one-to-be!

label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
text: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.\pI wish you wouldn't disturb our\nprecious time together.

label: Route109_Text_PaulDefeated
text: PAUL: Well, I give up.

label: Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle
text: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that\nwe're here.\lThis is just our private world of two!

label: Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon
text: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON battle\ltogether.

label: Route109_Text_MelIntro
text: MEL: We're, like, totally in love.\nOur romance is heating up all of HOENN!

label: Route109_Text_MelDefeated
text: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault!\nPAUL will hate me!

label: Route109_Text_MelPostBattle
text: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me?\nPlease don't be angry.

label: Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon
text: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON\lbattle together.

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerIntro
text: Tadaah! See?\nMy inner tube's round!

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerDefeated
text: Oh, oh!\nToo bad!

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle
text: After I showed you my round inner\ntube, too…

label: Route109_Text_HaileyIntro
text: I can't swim, so I'm pretending\nto swim.

label: Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated
text: I thought so!\nI didn't think we could win.

label: Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle
text: When I learn how to swim, I think\nmy POKéMON will become tougher.

label: Route109_Text_ElijahIntro
text: For a guy as macho as me, this kind\nof POKéMON is the perfect match!

label: Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated
text: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?

label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
text: For a guy as macho as me, a port\nis the perfect setting!\pI guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.

label: Route110_Text_JacobIntro
text: Whoa! Watch it!\nI guess you're not used to BIKE racing.

label: Route110_Text_JacobDefeated
text: Whoa!\nMy brakes failed!

label: Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle
text: Flat tires and brake problems can\ncause serious injury!\lInspect your BIKE for problems!

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro
text: Yo, you!\nCan you keep up with my speed?

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyDefeated
text: Crash and burn!

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
text: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON.\nI need to reconsider this…

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro
text: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminDefeated
text: I shouldn't panic during POKéMON\nbattles…

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
text: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister
text: I'll keep chugging on without stressing.\nGive me a shout if you're up to it.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
text: Aren't you going a little too fast?\nTake it easy and let's battle.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated
text: I didn't panic, but I still lost…

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle
text: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
text: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.\pYou have to complete the three events\nof swimming, cycling, and running.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailDefeated
text: POKéMON battles are hard, too!

label: Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle
text: I'm exhausted, so I need a break.\nIt's important to get proper rest.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRegister
text: You know, I like you!\nLet's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
text: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while\ncycling?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated
text: Wow…\nHow could you be so strong?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
text: Were you going after a record?\pI'm sorry if I held you up!

label: Route110_Text_JasmineIntro
text: I've been riding without stopping.\nMy thighs are like rocks!

label: Route110_Text_JasmineDefeated
text: I'm worried about muscle cramps…

label: Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle
text: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES?\nNo wonder you're so strong!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardIntro
text: I have foreseen your intentions!\nI cannot possibly lose!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated
text: I failed to prophesize my own demise!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
text: I see your future…\pHmm…\nI see a shining light…

label: Route110_Text_JaclynIntro
text: Ahahahaha!\nI'll dazzle you with my wonders!

label: Route110_Text_JaclynDefeated
text: I wondrously lost!

label: Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle
text: You managed to win only because it was\na wonder! Yes, a wonder!\lDon't think you can win all the time!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinIntro
text: Could I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?

label: Route110_Text_EdwinDefeated
text: I wanted to complete\nmy collection…

label: Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle
text: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know,\nmy passion as a collector is ignited!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRegister
text: I like collecting MATCH CALL\nregistrations, too…

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
text: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?\pCould I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchDefeated
text: Your POKéMON…\nI envy you.

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle
text: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON\nmine!

label: Route110_Text_DaleIntro
text: Hey!\nDon't sneak up behind me like that!

label: Route110_Text_DaleDefeated
text: I lost!\nDrat!

label: Route110_Text_DalePostBattle
text: Fishing is all about concentration.\nYou have to focus on the floater.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelIntro
text: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show\noff my delightful POKéMON.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelDefeated
text: Oh, dear, this won't do.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle
text: Rather than battling, perhaps I should\nshow off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
text: That wasn't close to what I could\ndo to show off my POKéMON.\pI'll have you as my captive audience\nas often as possible!

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchIntro
text: Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show\noff my POKéMON as often as you like!

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchDefeated
text: Oh, dear, this won't do.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle
text: I don't think that I could ever stop\nfrom showing off my POKéMON.\pBut I like to battle, too!

label: Route110_Text_TimmyIntro
text: I found some cool POKéMON in the grass\naround here!

label: Route110_Text_TimmyDefeated
text: Being cool isn't enough to win…

label: Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle
text: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you\njust caught.

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro
