text: I fell off CYCLING ROAD…\pI'll get over my embarrassment by\nbattling with you!

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaDefeated
text: Oops!\nI ended up losing!

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle
text: Falling… Losing…\nThis is so humiliating for me!

label: Route110_Text_JosephIntro
text: Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can't\ngroove, you get left behind!

label: Route110_Text_JosephDefeated
text: You got into the groove all right…

label: Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle
text: This isn't going to bring me down!\nLosing has made me a better man!

label: Route110_Text_KalebIntro
text: When cute POKéMON help each other…\nYou won't see a more adorable sight!

label: Route110_Text_KalebDefeated
text: Have you no compassion or pity?

label: Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle
text: Okay, okay, you've done the best you\ncould, my pretties.

label: Route111_Text_DrewIntro
text: Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you.\nBut I think they look better on me.\pLet's decide who they look better on\nwith a battle!

label: Route111_Text_DrewDefeat
text: I couldn't see what was happening at\nmy sides because of the GO-GOGGLES.

label: Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle
text: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to\nget through sandstorms.\lThat makes me happy!

label: Route111_Text_HeidiIntro
text: I'm having a picnic in the desert.\pYou can always find a TRAINER,\nso I can enjoy a battle here, too!

label: Route111_Text_HeidiDefeat
text: Ohhh! You're mean!

label: Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle
text: When you're battling in a sandstorm,\nwatch out for your POKéMON's HP.\pIt can faint if you don't keep\nan eye on it!

label: Route111_Text_BeauIntro
text: Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me\nfeel like a superhero.\lRight now, nobody can beat me!

label: Route111_Text_BeauDefeat
text: I can't win on spirit alone…

label: Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle
text: I'm going to be a real hero one day.\nI'm going to work harder to make me\land my POKéMON stronger.

label: Route111_Text_BeckyIntro
text: I heard there are fossils to be found\nin the desert. Where could they be?

label: Route111_Text_BeckyDefeat
text: I came up short…

label: Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle
text: If they can find fossils in the desert,\nit must have been a sea before.

label: Route111_Text_DustyIntro
text: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\lI am to be challenged?

label: Route111_Text_DustyDefeat
text: While I have searched for ruins,\nI've not searched for strong POKéMON.

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle
text: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years?\nWhich was it now?

label: Route111_Text_DustyRegister
text: I haven't been searching for any\ntough POKéMON.\pBut, for some reason, I sure do like\nPOKéNAVS.

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro
text: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years?\nAnyway, am I to be challenged?

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchDefeat
text: I've found no ruins, nor have I found\nany strong POKéMON…

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
text:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years
I've searched?\pHmm… It could even be fifty…
How long have I been at this?

label: Route111_Text_TravisIntro
text: I'm full of pep!\nAnd my POKéMON is peppy, too!

label: Route111_Text_TravisDefeat
text: My POKéMON lost its pep…

label: Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle
text: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep,\nI can't help looking.

label: Route111_Text_IreneIntro
text: I don't know where you're going,\nbut would you like to battle?

label: Route111_Text_IreneDefeat
text: Oh, you're disgustingly good!

label: Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle
text: I'm thinking that I should go to\nMT. CHIMNEY, but the view around\lhere is very nice, too.

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeIntro
text: To train myself, I challenge all\nwhom I meet!

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeDefeat
text: Uncle! I give up!

label: Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle
text: All I can do is keep training until\nI can defeat strong TRAINERS such\las yourself.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonIntro
text: Show me how much you've toughened\nyour POKéMON.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonDefeat
text: I see, you've toughened them\nconsiderably.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle
text: POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much\nthrough battling.\pWhat's important is to never give up\neven if you lose.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
text: There is much to be learned from\nyour training style.\pI request a rematch if it\nbehooves you.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
text: We're training here to elevate our\ngame to the next level.\lStay and train with us!

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchDefeat
text: Ooh, you're decent!

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch
text: Since you're that strong, you should\naim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeIntro
text: Oh, your POKéMON look like serious\nactors.\lI have to ask you for an engagement.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeDefeat
text: They didn't just look strong,\nthey are strong!

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle
text: I thought I was raising my POKéMON\ndiligently, but, oh no, there is still\lmuch to be done.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRegister
text: I wish I could become friends with\nmore strong people like you!

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro
text: You can make POKéMON stronger or\nweaker depending on the moves you\lteach them.\pWhat kinds of moves do your POKéMON\nknow?

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchDefeat
text: You've taught them good moves!

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch
text: Maybe I should have stopped my\nPOKéMON from evolving until they\llearned better moves…

label: Route111_Text_CeliaIntro
text: I shouldn't have come to a place like\nthis for a picnic!

label: Route111_Text_CeliaDefeat
text: Aww!\nI really shouldn't have come!

label: Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle
text: In a sandstorm like this, I can't set\nthe places for a picnic even with my\lGO-GOGGLES on…

label: Route111_Text_BryanIntro
text: How tough are you?\nWe shall expose that secret!

label: Route111_Text_BryanDefeat
text: Oh! Your strength!\nIt is shrouded in mystery!

label: Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle
text: This desert hoards mysteries in\nits shifting sands!

label: Route111_Text_BrandenIntro
text: I'll give you some of my sandwich\nif you'll lose.

label: Route111_Text_BrandenDefeat
text: Tch! I thought a sandwich would be\nenough of a bribe…

label: Route111_Text_BrandenPostBattle
text: My SANDSHREW loves eating\nmy sandwiches.

label: Route111_Text_TyronIntro
text: This is my favorite kind of POKéMON!

label: Route111_Text_TyronDefeat
text: Wait!\nDid you get a good look at my POKéMON?

label: Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle
text: When having a battle, I get a kick out\nof showing off my POKéMON.\pI bet everyone feels that way when\nthey enter a battle!

label: Route111_Text_CelinaIntro
text: Show me how to put a little excitement\ninto my life.

label: Route111_Text_CelinaDefeat
text: Oh… My…\nThat was too much excitement.

label: Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle
text: My pulse is still racing.\nYou're one fabulous TRAINER.

label: Route111_Text_HaydenIntro
text: When you're as famished as I am,\nthere is no room for pity!

label: Route111_Text_HaydenDefeat
text: Groan…

label: Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle
text: My stomach is grumbling!\nMaybe I can grill some BERRIES…

label: Route111_Text_BiancaIntro
text: Did you come from MAUVILLE?\nThen you should be full of energy!

label: Route111_Text_BiancaDefeat
text: Ooh lala!\nThat's a lot to take!

label: Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle
text: This road here…\nYou have quite a ways to travel.

label: Route112_Text_BriceIntro
text: Hahahaha!\nHow about we have a battle?\lYou and me!\lHahahaha!

label: Route112_Text_BriceDefeat
text: I lost!\nHahahaha!

label: Route112_Text_BricePostBattle
text: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose!\nHahahaha-hatchoo!

label: Route112_Text_TrentIntro
text: My legs are solid from pounding up\nand down the mountains.\pThey're not going to buckle easily,\nfriend!

label: Route112_Text_TrentDefeat
text: Ouch! My legs cramped up!

label: Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle
text: Try hiking, and I mean really\npounding, on these mountain trails\lwith a heavy pack weighing dozens of\lpounds.\pThat, my friend, will get your body\ninto serious shape.

label: Route112_Text_TrentRegister
text: Ow, my legs have cramped up.\nCan you grab me some bandages from\lmy backpack?\pNo, that's my POKéNAV!\nOh, fine, I'll register you.

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchIntro
text: I've been keeping fit by hiking.\nPower, I have in spades!

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchDefeat
text: I got trumped in power?

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle
text: I hear there are some seriously tough\nTRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.\pI intend to get up there and give them\na challenge!

label: Route112_Text_LarryIntro
text: I'm strong.\nI won't cry if I lose.

label: Route112_Text_LarryDefeat
text: Waaaah!

label: Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle
text: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy!\nSnivel…

label: Route112_Text_CarolIntro
text: When you're out on a picnic, why,\nyou simply have to sing!\lCome on, sing with me!

label: Route112_Text_CarolDefeat
text: Oh, you're so strong!

label: Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle
text: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad\nat singing or POKéMON.\pIf you have the most fun, you win!

label: Route112_Text_BryantIntro
text: I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH!\nTake a look!

label: Route112_Text_BryantDefeat
text: What a bumpy ride that was!

label: Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle
text: I like the way you battle.\nIt has a certain flair to it.

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaIntro
text: Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER!\nPlease, I need a romantic battle!\lI'm somewhat decent!

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaDefeat
text: Oh, how strong you are!\nYou've given me quite a shock!

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle
text: Are you busy right now?\nI was thinking that maybe we can have\la rematch right now…\lBut it's all right if you're busy.

label: Route113_Text_JaylenIntro
text: Can you guess why it's so cool\naround here?

label: Route113_Text_JaylenDefeat
text: Peeuuw!\nThat stinks!

label: Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle
text: The volcanic ash blocks the sun,\nso it doesn't get very warm.\pThat's good for me--I can't stand heat!

label: Route113_Text_DillonIntro
text: The volcano's eruption is proof that\nthe earth is alive.

label: Route113_Text_DillonDefeat
text: You're some kind of strong!

label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
text: Ouch! Owww! I can't see!\nI got ashes in my eyelashes!\pGet it? Ashes and eyelashes?\pOkay, that was bad, sorry…

label: Route113_Text_MadelineIntro
text: I use this parasol to ward off this\nfilthy, yucky volcanic ash from\lmy dear NUMEL.

label: Route113_Text_MadelineDefeat
text: Huff, huff…\nI am exhausted…

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle
text: You're very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRegister
text: Here, slide under my parasol.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
text: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while?\nMay I invite you to battle?

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchDefeat
text: Oh, how super!

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch
text: You've remained very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!

label: Route113_Text_LaoIntro
text: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!

label: Route113_Text_LaoDefeat
text: With honor I admit defeat!

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle
text: I must refine the art of concealment.\nI bid thee farewell.

label: Route113_Text_LaoRegister
text: Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja\ntechnique of POKéNAV registration!

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchIntro
text: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchDefeat
text: With honor I admit defeat!

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch
text: My flawless concealment was let down\nby my immature battle skills…\pI bid thee farewell.

label: Route113_Text_LungIntro
text: Thanks for finding me!\nBut we still have to battle!

label: Route113_Text_LungDefeat
text: I'll use my ninjutsu on you…\n“VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!\p…What?\nIt's already over?

label: Route113_Text_LungPostBattle
text: You know what's crummy about hiding?\nIt's lonely if no one comes along.

label: Route113_Text_ToriIntro
text: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.

label: Route113_Text_ToriDefeat
text: TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going\nto get some more ashes.

label: Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle
text: TORI: How much ash do we have?\nEnough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.

label: Route113_Text_ToriNotEnoughMons
text: TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we didn't, we would lose!

label: Route113_Text_TiaIntro
text: TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.

label: Route113_Text_TiaDefeat
text: TIA: We couldn't win… It's boring,\nso I'm getting some more ashes.

label: Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle
text: TIA: We have a lot of ashes!\nI think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!

label: Route113_Text_TiaNotEnoughMons
text: TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we don't, we won't win!

label: Route113_Text_CobyIntro
text: Pfft, with these wings I can\nflick you away!

label: Route113_Text_CobyDefeat
text: A… What?

label: Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle
text: I don't know what to say when I get\nbeaten so easily…

label: Route113_Text_SophieIntro
text: The warmth here is making me drowsy.\nBattle with me so I can stay awake.

label: Route113_Text_SophieDefeat
text: This is a dream.\nI'm sure of it…

label: Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle
text: Losing burns me up…\nI'm just going to sleep right here!\lZzz!

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceIntro
text: Were you maybe in the middle\nof gathering volcanic ashes?

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceDefeat
text: Ehehe.\nWe got beaten cleanly.

label: Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle
text: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.

label: Route113_Text_WyattIntro
text: Y-you want to battle with me?\nEven though I just caught my POKéMON?

label: Route113_Text_WyattDefeat
text: Y-you're all happy to win?\nEven though it's only me?

label: Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle
text: Oh, so now you want to say a word to\nthe loser?\pAren't you just the coolest?\nHumph!

label: Route114_Text_LennyIntro
text: Yodelayhihoo!\p… …\pYou're supposed to shout\n“yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't\lecho here!

label: Route114_Text_LennyDefeat
text: Yodelayhihoo!

label: Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle
text: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there\nwas someone copying me and shouting\lback, “Yodelayhihoo.”

label: Route114_Text_LucasIntro
text: If you're not prepared, you shouldn't\nbe up in the mountains!

label: Route114_Text_LucasDefeat
text: The mountains are unforgiving…

label: Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle
text: In the winter, mountains turn deadly\nwith blizzards and avalanches.

label: Route114_Text_ShaneIntro
text: Camping's fun! You can fish, roast\nmarshmallows, and tell spooky stories!\pBut the best of all are the POKéMON\nbattles!

label: Route114_Text_ShaneDefeat
text: Way too strong!

label: Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle
text: I think it's great that I can go\ncamping with my POKéMON.

label: Route114_Text_NancyIntro
text: I need to exercise after a meal.\nLet's have a match!

label: Route114_Text_NancyDefeat
text: Oh, no!

label: Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle
text: I just had a tasty meal.\nI'm getting drowsy…

label: Route114_Text_SteveIntro
text: Ufufufufufu…\nWant to battle against my POKéMON?

label: Route114_Text_SteveDefeat
text: M-My POKéMON…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostBattle
text: A big body that's all lumpy and hard,\nenormous horns, and vicious fangs…\pUfufufufu…\nI wish I had a POKéMON like that…

label: Route114_Text_SteveRegister
text: Don't forget what you've done to me!\nI'll make it so you can't forget!

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchIntro
text: Ufufufufufu…\nCome on, battle my POKéMON…

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchDefeat
text: I feel so lucky getting to see your\nPOKéMON…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostRematch
text: Ufufufufufu…\pWhen I see POKéMON battling, I get all\nshivery and shaky…

label: Route114_Text_BernieIntro
text: If you're lighting a campfire,\nmake sure you have water handy.

label: Route114_Text_BernieDefeat
text: Thanks for dousing my fire!

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle
text: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\pDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.

label: Route114_Text_BernieRegister
text: You set my spirit on fire.\nLet's register each other!

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchIntro
text: Have you learned to keep water handy\nfor campfires?

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchDefeat
text: I got hosed down before I could\nflare up, I guess.

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch
text: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\pDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeIntro
text: If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand\na chance against me.\lSo, bring on your POKéMON!

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeDefeat
text: If we were fishing, I would've won…

label: Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle
text: I think I'll try my luck at landing\na big one at METEOR FALLS.\pThere has to be something in there.\nI just know it.

label: Route114_Text_NolanIntro
text: I like to fish. But I also like to\nbattle!\pIf anyone challenges me, I'm there,\neven if I'm fishing.

label: Route114_Text_NolanDefeat
text: I like to battle, but that doesn't\nmean I'm good at it…

label: Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle
text: This time I'll do it!\pI always think that, so I can't walk\naway from fishing or POKéMON.

label: Route114_Text_TyraIntro
text: TYRA: Well, sure.\nI'm in the mood for it.\lI'll teach you a little about POKéMON.

label: Route114_Text_TyraDefeat
text: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!

label: Route114_Text_TyraPostBattle
text: TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY\nabout POKéMON.

label: Route114_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
text: TYRA: Giggle…\nIf you want to battle with us, just one\lPOKéMON isn't enough!

label: Route114_Text_IvyIntro
text: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?

label: Route114_Text_IvyDefeat
text: IVY: What an amazing battle style!

label: Route114_Text_IvyPostBattle
text: IVY: I started training POKéMON\nbecause TYRA, my student mentor,\ltaught me!

label: Route114_Text_IvyNotEnoughMons
text: IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nI think it must feel lonesome.

label: Route114_Text_KaiIntro
text: I landed a big one!\nA huge one, I tell you!

label: Route114_Text_KaiDefeat
text: What was that about?\nDid mine lose in size?

label: Route114_Text_KaiPostBattle
text: Okay!\nI'll just fish me a bigger one!

label: Route114_Text_CharlotteIntro
text: Me!\nI'm not just a pretty face!

label: Route114_Text_CharlotteDefeat
text: That wasn't cute in the least!

label: Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle
text: I don't want a POKéMON that's\njust cute.\pI adore cute ones that have a quirk\nor two!

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaIntro
text: Have you made your POKéMON evolve\nvery much?

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaDefeat
text: Oh, I see.\nThat's good to know.

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaPostBattle
text: Some POKéMON change so much when\nthey evolve, it's startling!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyIntro
text: Hm…\nYou seem rather capable…\lLet me keep you company!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyDefeat
text: You're much stronger than\nI'd imagined!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostBattle
text: There is no such thing as a born genius.\nIt all depends on effort!\lThat is what I believe…

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRegister
text: Hmm… A loss this thorough has been\na distant memory.\pIf you would allow it, I wish for\nanother opportunity to do battle.

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchIntro
text: Hm… As always, your agility speaks\nfor itself.\lCome, keep me company!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchDefeat
text: As strong as ever!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch
text: All it takes is effort!\pI lost because I haven't put in enough\neffort!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiIntro
text: You!\pMy MACHOP!\pDemand a battle!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiDefeat
text: Ouch, ouch, ouch!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle
text: My MACHOP crew!\pSo long as they seek power, I will\ngrow strong with them!

label: Route115_Text_NobIntro
text: My strongest skill is busting bricks\nwith my forehead!

label: Route115_Text_NobDefeat
text: Ugwaaaah!\nMy head is busted!

label: Route115_Text_NobPostBattle
text: I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.\pIt looks like they'll get a lot better\nthan me. I'm excited about that.

label: Route115_Text_NobRegister
text: You impress me! Give me a rematch\nafter I redo my training!

label: Route115_Text_NobRematchIntro
text: After you beat me, we trained hard to\nimprove our skills.\lCome on, give us a rematch!

label: Route115_Text_NobRematchDefeat
text: Ugwaaah!\nWe lost again!

label: Route115_Text_NobPostRematch
text: My POKéMON will grow stronger!\nI'll redouble my training!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyIntro
text: This beach is my secret training spot!\nDon't come butting in!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyDefeat
text: I haven't trained enough!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostBattle
text: The sand acts as a cushion to reduce\nimpact and prevent injury.\lThis is the perfect place to train.

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRegister
text: Okay, fine, you're free to come here.\nIn return, I'd like to battle you again.

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchIntro
text: Okay, let's get this battle on!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchDefeat
text: I can battle but my POKéMON…

label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostRematch
text: Even when I lose, I still get some\nenjoyment out of it.\lIt must be that I love POKéMON.

label: Route115_Text_HectorIntro
text: I have a rare POKéMON!\nWould you like me to show you?

label: Route115_Text_HectorDefeat
text: You…\nYou want my POKéMON, don't you?

label: Route115_Text_HectorPostBattle
text: I have this rare POKéMON.\nIt's enough to keep me satisfied.

label: Route115_Text_KyraIntro
text: I'll battle while I'm running!\nTry to keep up with me!

label: Route115_Text_KyraDefeat
text: Gasp, gasp…

label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
text: I made the mistake of trying to battle\nwhile running!\pI should take a run to calm down…

label: Route115_Text_JaidenIntro
text: Take that!\nUltra POKéMON ninja attack!

label: Route115_Text_JaidenDefeat
text: Waaah!\nOur strategy failed!

label: Route115_Text_JaidenPostBattle
text: But my POKéMON were ultra,\nweren't they?

label: Route115_Text_HeleneIntro
text: My POKéMON have black belt-level\nstrength!

label: Route115_Text_HeleneDefeat
text: This is too humiliating!

label: Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle
text: I rarely meet anyone who's better\nthan me…\pI get it now!\nYou're a GYM LEADER, aren't you?

label: Route115_Text_AlixIntro
text: Our eyes met!\nThere's no getting away now!

label: Route115_Text_AlixDefeat
text: Gah!\nNot bad!

label: Route115_Text_AlixPostBattle
text: Oh, well.\nI think I will TELEPORT home.

label: Route115_Text_MarleneIntro
text: You've disturbed my meditation…\nYou'll be punished for it.

label: Route115_Text_MarleneDefeat
text: You've broken my concentration!

label: Route115_Text_MarlenePostBattle
text: I was meditating with my POKéMON.\nBut this place isn't very peaceful…

label: Route116_Text_ClarkIntro
text: If the tunnel doesn't go through, then\nI'll just go over the top.

label: Route116_Text_ClarkDefeat
text: Gasp… Gasp…\nLosing made me tired…

label: Route116_Text_ClarkPostBattle
text: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel.\nTo a HIKER, mountains are roads!

label: Route116_Text_JoeyIntro
text: My POKéMON rule!\nCheck them out!

label: Route116_Text_JoeyDefeat
text: Ouch! A scrape!\nI have to put on a bandage!

label: Route116_Text_JoeyPostBattle
text: Bandages are signs of toughness!\nI've got another one!

label: Route116_Text_JoseIntro
text: My BUG POKéMON are tough!\nLet's battle!

label: Route116_Text_JoseDefeat
text: I lost!\nI thought I had you!

label: Route116_Text_JosePostBattle
text: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nSo they get strong quickly, too.

label: Route116_Text_JaniceIntro
text: Let me teach you how strong my\nadorable POKéMON is!

label: Route116_Text_JaniceDefeat
text: You're a notch above me…

label: Route116_Text_JanicePostBattle
text: POKéMON that possess cuteness and\npower, that's ideal, I think.

label: Route116_Text_JerryIntro
text: We learn all sorts of things at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\pI want to test things out for real!

label: Route116_Text_JerryDefeat
text: I slacked off in school…\nThat's why I lost.

label: Route116_Text_JerryPostBattle
text: I'll have to redo some courses at\nthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\lIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister1
text: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL\nthat a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.\pI don't really get what that means,\nso can I just try it?

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister2
text: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL\nthat a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.\pI don't really get what that means,\nso can I just try it?

label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchIntro
text: I've been studying seriously at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\lI won't lose like I did last time.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchDefeat
text: Hunh?\nI studied diligently.

label: Route116_Text_JerryPostRematch
text: I'll have to redo some courses at\nthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\lIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.

label: Route116_Text_KarenIntro
text: I study at school, and I study on\nthe way home, too!

label: Route116_Text_KarenDefeat
text: I'm in shock--I lost?

label: Route116_Text_KarenPostBattle
text: Awww, I'll never become an elegant\nTRAINER like ROXANNE this way!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister1
text: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?\nI have one, too! Please register me!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister2
text: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?\nI have one, too! Please register me!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchIntro
text: I studied a whole lot since I saw you.\nYou must see my achievements!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchDefeat
text: I'm in shock.\nI lost again?

label: Route116_Text_KarenPostRematch
text: You've beaten ROXANNE?\nI can't beat you, then. Not yet.

label: Route116_Text_SarahIntro
text: Just so you know, I've never once been\nbested by anyone at anything.

label: Route116_Text_SarahDefeat
text: Oh, my goodness.\nThis is a new experience for me.

label: Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle
text: My life of luxury affords me all that\nI could possibly desire.\pHowever, when it comes to POKéMON,\nmy wealth has no meaning.

label: Route116_Text_DawsonIntro
text: When you lay your eyes on my POKéMON's\ngorgeous fur, their beauty will render\lyou helpless!

label: Route116_Text_DawsonDefeat
text: Oh, baby, say it isn't so!

label: Route116_Text_DawsonPostBattle
text: Oh, no, no, no!\nYou've mussed up my POKéMON's fur!\lYou've ruined my hairdo, too!\lI'll have to call my stylist now!

label: Route116_Text_DevanIntro
text: We'll rock you hard!

label: Route116_Text_DevanDefeat
text: Aiyiyi!\nNo contest at all!

label: Route116_Text_DevanPostBattle
text: I should try different POKéMON\ntypes, that's what I ought to do.

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonIntro
text: It's a dead end up here.\nI'm bored, so can we battle?

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonDefeat
text: That was fun even though I lost.

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonPostBattle
text: Want to stay here and keep\nme company?

label: Route117_Text_IsaacIntro
text: Listen, could I get you to battle\nthe POKéMON I'm raising?

label: Route117_Text_IsaacDefeat
text: You've raised yours superbly…

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle
text: POKéMON isn't all about power.\pPolishing a unique aspect of one's\ncharacter is another way of enjoying\lPOKéMON.

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRegister
text: I'm going to redouble my training.\nWould you come look in on us?

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
text: The POKéMON I've been raising are\nlooking good, just like before.

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchDefeat
text: You know how to raise them properly.\nYou might have DAY CARE skills…

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostRematch
text: Your POKéMON are growing good!\nYou should enter them in CONTESTS.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaIntro
text: Please, allow me to evaluate if you\nhave raised your POKéMON properly.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaDefeat
text: Yes, they are growing properly.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostBattle
text: Try raising POKéMON with more\nattention to their character traits.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRegister
text: I'm glad I met a superb TRAINER in you.\nI hope to see you again.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchIntro
text: Allow me to reevaluate if you have\nraised your POKéMON properly.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchDefeat
text: They are growing admirably.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch
text: POKéMON seem to like different kinds\nof {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.

label: Route117_Text_DylanIntro
text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but,\nwhatever, let's have a battle!

label: Route117_Text_DylanDefeat
text: I ran out of energy!

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle
text: I may have blown it…\pI might have dropped to last during\nthat battle…

label: Route117_Text_DylanRegister
text: POKéMON have to be strong, too?\nI'd like you to train me!

label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchIntro
text: I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm comfortably ahead.\lLet's make this a quick battle!

label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchDefeat
text: I ran out of energy again!

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostRematch
text: I was tops in swimming and cycling,\nbut I'm not quite that confident with\lPOKéMON yet.

label: Route117_Text_MariaIntro
text: I do my triathlon training with POKéMON,\nso I'm pretty confident about my speed.

label: Route117_Text_MariaDefeat
text: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle
text: Training is meaningful only if you\nkeep it up regularly.\pOkay! I'll resume my training!\nTomorrow!

label: Route117_Text_MariaRegister
text: You appear to be training properly…\nIf you'd like, I'll battle you later!

label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchIntro
text: Are you keeping up with your training?\nI sure am!\lLet me show you the evidence!

label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchDefeat
text: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostRematch
text: I'll resume training tomorrow.\nLet's battle again sometime!

label: Route117_Text_DerekIntro
text: Once a BUG CATCHER!\nAnd now a BUG MANIAC!\pBut my love for POKéMON remains\nunchanged!

label: Route117_Text_DerekDefeat
text: My ineptitude also remains\nunchanged…

label: Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle
text: All I did was follow my heart, and now\nthey call me a BUG MANIAC…\pStill, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON,\nso it's only natural that they call me\la BUG MANIAC.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaIntro
text: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner. I have to do good!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaDefeat
text: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner! Let me win!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle
text: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\pI'd say you're second only to us!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaAndMegRegister
text: ANNA: We can't take this lying down!\nYou will come back, won't you?

label: Route117_Text_AnnaNotEnoughMons
text: ANNA: If you want to battle us,\nbring two POKéMON with you.

label: Route117_Text_MegIntro
text: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super\nsenior student partner and beat you!

label: Route117_Text_MegDefeat
text: MEG: Oh, no!\nI'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down…

label: Route117_Text_MegPostBattle
text: MEG: I dragged ANNA down…\nIf I didn't, she would have won!

label: Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
text: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\pWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchIntro
text: ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of\nmy junior partner, right?

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchDefeat
text: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch
text: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\pI'd say you're second only to us!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchNotEnoughMons
text: ANNA: If you want to battle us,\nbring two POKéMON with you.

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchIntro
text: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my\nsenior partner and win this time!

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchDefeat
text: MEG: Too strong!

label: Route117_Text_MegPostRematch
text: MEG: I battled together with my\nsenior partner, but we lost…\pThat's so discouraging…

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons
text: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\pWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.

label: Route117_Text_MelinaIntro
text: Isn't it nice? To battle while looking\nat pretty flowers?

label: Route117_Text_MelinaDefeat
text: Oh, that's quite impressive!

label: Route117_Text_MelinaPostBattle
text: It feels wonderful to go for a jog\nwhile looking at flowers.

label: Route117_Text_BrandiIntro
text: Let me demonstrate the power\nhidden within a PSYCHIC POKéMON!

label: Route117_Text_BrandiDefeat
text: Astonishing!

label: Route117_Text_BrandiPostBattle
text: PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex.\nYou should try catching some.

label: Route117_Text_AishaIntro
text: Concentrate on getting the win.\nThat's how I battle!

label: Route117_Text_AishaDefeat
text: I don't waste any time being angry\nover a loss--I would rather train.

label: Route117_Text_AishaPostBattle
text: I think that if you worry about losing,\nyou're more likely to lose.

label: Route118_Text_RoseIntro
text: The aroma of flowers has a magical\npower. It cleanses us body and soul.

label: Route118_Text_RoseDefeat
text: Oh, dear me.\nI seem to have lost.

label: Route118_Text_RosePostBattle
text: Flowers, POKéMON…\nI love whatever smells nice.\pStinky things…\nI'll pass.

label: Route118_Text_RoseRegister
text: Sniff… That odor--it's a POKéNAV!\nWe must register each other!

label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchIntro
text: Were you drawn here by the sweet\naroma?

label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchDefeat
text: The power of aroma…\nIt didn't seem to do much.

label: Route118_Text_RosePostRematch
text: If you use a sweet aroma properly,\nPOKéMON will be attracted by it.

label: Route118_Text_PerryIntro
text: BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in\nthe sky… They're the best!

label: Route118_Text_PerryDefeat
text: Urgh…\nI crashed…

label: Route118_Text_PerryPostBattle
text: You've got great POKéMON.\nI'll have to train mine better.

label: Route118_Text_ChesterIntro
text: Take flight!\nMy BIRD POKéMON!

label: Route118_Text_ChesterDefeat
text: They did take flight…

label: Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle
text: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able\nto fly more freely…

label: Route118_Text_BarnyIntro
text: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER.\nI'm raising the POKéMON I caught.

label: Route118_Text_BarnyDefeat
text: I thought I was doing okay in my\ntraining…

label: Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle
text: I couldn't win by training POKéMON\nwhile I fished…\pWas I doing things in half measures?

label: Route118_Text_WadeIntro
text: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.\pBut for TRAINERS, the key ingredients\nare POKéMON and heart, of course!

label: Route118_Text_WadeDefeat
text: I was beaten in heart?

label: Route118_Text_WadePostBattle
text: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle\nbetween a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.

label: Route118_Text_DaltonIntro
text: Let my melody rock your soul!

label: Route118_Text_DaltonDefeat
text: La-lalala…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle
text: An electric guitar doesn't always\nhave to be noisy…\pIt can be strummed to squeeze out\nthis heart-stirring melody…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRegister
text: When I compose better melodies,\nyou have to come listen, okay?

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchIntro
text: A melody from my POKéMON and me…\nLet us deliver it to your soul.

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchDefeat
text: La-lalala…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch
text: When I play, my emotions should reach\nyou through my electric guitar…

label: Route118_Text_DeandreIntro
text: Go, go, go!\nPOKéMON 1, 2, and 3!

label: Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat
text: Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay?\nPOKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!

label: Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle
text: Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON\nbattle team?\pYou can copy me--I don't mind!

label: Route119_Text_BrentIntro
text: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nWe MIMIC what you do!

label: Route119_Text_BrentDefeat
text: Whoopsie!\nI lost!

label: Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle
text: What's so good about mimicry?\pFufufu…\nYou'll never understand…

label: Route119_Text_DonaldIntro
text: So, we finally meet!\nMy BUG POKéMON will keep you company!

label: Route119_Text_DonaldDefeat
text: I wish we'd never met…

label: Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle
text: I want to MIMIC you some more.\nCan you hurry up and move?

label: Route119_Text_TaylorIntro
text: If you step forward, we step forward.\pIf you turn right, we turn, too…

label: Route119_Text_TaylorDefeat
text: But if you win, I lose…

label: Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle
text: I can't MIMIC you winning the match.\nThat's just impossible…\lIt's burning me up…

label: Route119_Text_DougIntro
text: Yep, you've finally caught me!\nOr were you trying to avoid me?

label: Route119_Text_DougDefeat
text: Whoop, that was a great match!

label: Route119_Text_DougPostBattle
text: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nI hope you enjoyed our performance.

label: Route119_Text_GregIntro
text: You don't know who I am, do you?\pBut, I also don't know you.\nSo, we'll battle!

label: Route119_Text_GregDefeat
text: You're pretty strong!

label: Route119_Text_GregPostBattle
text: Until you go away somewhere, we'll\nkeep on mimicking your every move.

label: Route119_Text_KentIntro
text: The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people\nwho like to MIMIC.\pA battle starts the instant we meet!

label: Route119_Text_KentDefeat
text: I give up!

label: Route119_Text_KentPostBattle
text: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
text: Who has the knowledge and\nthe technique for survival?\pPOKéMON RANGERS, that's who!

label: Route119_Text_JacksonDefeat
text: I didn't have enough POKéMON\nknow-how…

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle
text: To break away from civilization and\nawaken the wild spirit within!\pThat's our vision.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRegister
text: I hope you'll give me a rematch without\nmocking my lack of knowledge.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
text: I'm going to regain my wild spirit by\nbeing together with POKéMON.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchDefeat
text: You've remained strong!

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch
text: Believe in your POKéMON.\nBelieve in yourself.\pThe road will reveal itself to you.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineIntro
text: Oh? Look at you.\pFor someone on an adventure,\nyou're traveling awfully light.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineDefeat
text: Accidents happen when you're not\nprepared!

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle
text: You're traveling light but you have\neverything you need.\pYou're on top of things mentally and\nphysically, too.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRegister
text: Do you have a POKéNAV?\nIt's a must-have tool for any TRAINER.\pOh, you do have one!\nLet's register each other, then!

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchIntro
text: How's your journey with POKéMON\ngoing?

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchDefeat
text: I'm still missing something…

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch
text: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER,\nrely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON\lrely on you.

label: Route119_Text_HughIntro
text: The vast sky holds untold promise!\pNothing can compare to the sheer\nexhilaration of flight!

label: Route119_Text_HughDefeat
text: Down and out!

label: Route119_Text_HughPostBattle
text: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of\nflying come true!

label: Route119_Text_PhilIntro
text: I'll show you the true potential of me\nand my BIRD POKéMON!

label: Route119_Text_PhilDefeat
text: We lacked potential…

label: Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle
text: Ever since I was a little kid, I always\nadmired BIRD POKéMON…

label: Route119_Text_YasuIntro
text: To lurk in shadows, and live in\ndarkness… That is my destiny.\pI emerge to challenge you!

label: Route119_Text_YasuDefeat
text: I admit defeat!

label: Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle
text: Those defeated in battle withdraw\nquietly back into the shadows.\lThat, too, is destiny…

label: Route119_Text_TakashiIntro
text: If you're not on your guard,\nyou're in for some pain!

label: Route119_Text_TakashiDefeat
text: You're surprisingly good!

label: Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle
text: My surprise attack ended in\nfailure…

label: Route119_Text_HideoIntro
text: To hide a tree, use a forest!

label: Route119_Text_HideoDefeat
text: I bow to your superiority.

label: Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle
text: To hide a tree, use a forest!\nTo hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!\pThere is no deep, hidden meaning\nto that.

label: Route119_Text_ChrisIntro
text: You spoke to me…\nSo you want to challenge me!\pSure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught\nwhile SURFING!

label: Route119_Text_ChrisDefeat
text: I don't have a clue about what it\ntakes to win.

label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
text: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON…\pThen fish off its back…\pIt's an indescribably luxuriant moment!

label: Route119_Text_FabianIntro
text: Hit me with a power chord!\nVictory is mine!\lIt's our time to shine, whoa, yeah!

label: Route119_Text_FabianDefeat
text: You showed me who's the boss!\nWe'll have to take the loss, oh, no!

label: Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle
text: Hit me with another power chord!\nLeave me alone!\lYour win you have to atone!

label: Route119_Text_DaytonIntro
text: Hohoho!\nI like kid TRAINERS!\lLet's have a good one!

label: Route119_Text_DaytonDefeat
text: You're pretty amazing!\nHohoho!

label: Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle
text: Hohoho!\nI'll try emulating the pep of kid\lTRAINERS like you!

label: Route119_Text_RachelIntro
text: Wherever and whenever I may be,\nI always have my parasol in hand.

label: Route119_Text_RachelDefeat
text: Oh, but…\nThat's not fair.

label: Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle
text: You're asking if my parasol is heavy?\nYour BAG is filled with more junk than\lI ever carry around.

label: Route120_Text_ColinIntro
text: Do you have any moves that can strike\na flying POKéMON?

label: Route120_Text_ColinDefeat
text: You soared above me!

label: Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle
text: The move FLY is convenient,\ndon't you think?\pWhile the POKéMON is flying,\nalmost no moves can strike it.

label: Route120_Text_RobertIntro
text: My POKéMON is strong!\nHow about yours?

label: Route120_Text_RobertDefeat
text: Your POKéMON were stronger…

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle
text: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.

label: Route120_Text_RobertRegister
text: You can be counted on to get better.\nI'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchIntro
text: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchDefeat
text: Your POKéMON are seriously strong.

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch
text: My POKéMON are growing stronger.\nI have to grow stronger, too.

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro
text: I'll check your POKéMON and see if\nthey're fit for the outdoors.

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoDefeat
text: With POKéMON that strong, you're in\nno danger of needing rescue!

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle
text: To travel wherever your heart desires\nwith POKéMON…\lThat's the joy of being a TRAINER.

label: Route120_Text_JennaIntro
text: How's your physical fitness?\nIf you're not fit, you could have a\lrough time in critical situations.

label: Route120_Text_JennaDefeat
text: I'm totally fit, but…

label: Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle
text: Fitness training is in my routine.\nI always run with my POKéMON.

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyIntro
text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lWant to battle?

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyDefeat
text: Lost it…

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostBattle
text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lI'll try harder…

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRegister
text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lDo you have a POKéNAV…?

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchIntro
text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lWant to battle again?

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchDefeat
text: … … … … … …\nI lost again…

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch
text: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lI'll try harder…\lFor my precious BUG POKéMON…

label: Route120_Text_JenniferIntro
text: POKéMON have many special abilities.\nIf you want to become a first-class\lTRAINER, learn about them.

label: Route120_Text_JenniferDefeat
text: You're obviously thinking.

label: Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle
text: The special abilities of POKéMON\nwill make battle styles change.

label: Route120_Text_ChipIntro
text: Who might you be?\pAre you perhaps searching for ancient\nruins that are rumored to possibly\lexist according to legend?

label: Route120_Text_ChipDefeat
text: What a disgraceful setback…

label: Route120_Text_ChipPostBattle
text: That giant rock… I would like to\nbelieve it may indeed contain ancient\lruins. But I see no entrance.

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro
text: Why am I carrying this parasol?\pI'll tell you if you can win against me.

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaDefeat
text: A parasol can't ward off POKéMON\nattacks…

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle
text: I don't think strong sunlight is good\nfor my POKéMON.\lSo I shield them with my parasol.

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro
text: Me, POKéMON, and my parasol…\pIf any one of them is missing,\nthe picture of beauty will be ruined.

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaDefeat
text: You've completely ruined my beauty…

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
text: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.\pWhy, something like this would only\nget in your way.

label: Route120_Text_KeigoIntro
text: I will adopt the movements of POKéMON\nand create new ninja techniques.

label: Route120_Text_KeigoDefeat
text: The creation of new ninja techniques\nis but a distant dream…

label: Route120_Text_KeigoPostBattle
text: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under\na ninja sensei.

label: Route120_Text_RileyIntro
text: We ninja conceal ourselves under our\ncamouflage cloaks.\lI bet you didn't know where I was!

label: Route120_Text_RileyDefeat
text: I lost!\nI should camouflage my shame!

label: Route120_Text_RileyPostBattle
text: Our camouflage cloaks are all\nhandmade.

label: Route120_Text_CallieIntro
text: If you don't pay attention,\nyou could get hurt!

label: Route120_Text_CallieDefeat
text: Ouch!\nI was the one to get hurt.

label: Route120_Text_CalliePostBattle
text: I wonder… Should I evolve my POKéMON?\nThey're cute the way they are, though.

label: Route120_Text_LeonelIntro
text: Your party POKéMON…\nDo you have different types?

label: Route120_Text_LeonelDefeat
text: I've seen your policy in action!

label: Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle
text: I think it's awesome you're so strong\nbattling with your favorite POKéMON.

label: Route121_Text_VanessaIntro
text: Will you play with my delightfully\npretty POKéMON?

label: Route121_Text_VanessaDefeat
text: This isn't what I meant!

label: Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle
text: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.\pMy POKéMON should have no problem\nsweeping the MASTER CLASS.

label: Route121_Text_WalterIntro
text: With my POKéMON, I have traveled\nto the world's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.

label: Route121_Text_WalterDefeat
text: Ah, well played.

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostBattle
text: I would like to circle the globe once\nagain with my POKéMON.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRegister
text: Your POKéMON prowess is remarkable.\nAllow me to register you as a memento.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro
text: With my POKéMON, I have traveled\nto the world's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchDefeat
text: Ah, well played.

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch
text: Your POKéMON and you…\pYour prowess together will be\nconsidered strong, even overseas.

label: Route121_Text_TammyIntro
text: There are powers beyond our\nunderstanding in the world…

label: Route121_Text_TammyDefeat
text: I have lost…

label: Route121_Text_TammyPostBattle
text: MT. PYRE…\nThere is a mysterious power\lat work there…

label: Route121_Text_KateIntro
text: KATE: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!

label: Route121_Text_KateDefeat
text: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior\nstudent partner…

label: Route121_Text_KatePostBattle
text: KATE: When someone's relying on me,\nI get this urge to look cool in front\lof them…

label: Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons
text: KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON,\nwe can't battle with you.\pThat would be bullying.

label: Route121_Text_JoyIntro
text: JOY: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!

label: Route121_Text_JoyDefeat
text: JOY: Please forgive me, KATE!

label: Route121_Text_JoyPostBattle
text: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE,\nmy senior student partner, again.

label: Route121_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
text: JOY: You need at least two POKéMON\nif you're going to challenge us!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaIntro
text: Stop! Have a good look at my precious\nPOKéMON!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaDefeat
text: Oh, how dare you!\nDon't take it so seriously!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostBattle
text: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRegister
text: I took it easy on you this time!\nIt won't be that way the next time!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchIntro
text: My precious POKéMON grew!\nHave a good look!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchDefeat
text: Oh, how dare you!\nYou still won't take it easy!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostRematch
text: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.

label: Route121_Text_CristinIntro
text: I have this routine.\nDefeat five TRAINERS a day.\lGuess what? You're number five!

label: Route121_Text_CristinDefeat
text: No!\nYou're horrid!

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostBattle
text: I didn't expect to lose this easily…\nI'll win next time!

label: Route121_Text_CristinRegister
text: That was total humiliation!\nI won't forget you…\lHand over your POKéNAV!

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchIntro
text: I have this new routine.\nDefeat ten TRAINERS a day.\lGuess what? You're number ten!

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchDefeat
text: Wait! That's nasty!\nI demand a rematch!

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostRematch
text: An opponent I just can't beat…\nSnivel…\lI can't believe this is happening…

label: Route121_Text_CaleIntro
text: Can't you see that I have all this\nstuff with me?\pDespite that, you still insist that\nwe battle?

label: Route121_Text_CaleDefeat
text: Of course I lost!\nI'm holding stuff in both hands!

label: Route121_Text_CalePostBattle
text: I bought too much stuff at\nthe LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE.\pIt's up the road from here.\nI wish I had a BAG like yours.

label: Route121_Text_MylesIntro
text: There's nothing I love more than\nchecking out other people's POKéMON!

label: Route121_Text_MylesDefeat
text: Super awesome!

label: Route121_Text_MylesPostBattle
text: They're great, your POKéMON!\nHow do you raise them?

label: Route121_Text_PatIntro
text: I want everybody to see the POKéMON\nI've raised!

label: Route121_Text_PatDefeat
text: Wow!\nSpectacular!

label: Route121_Text_PatPostBattle
text: I raise every POKéMON with the same\nlove and care--I don't pick favorites.

label: Route121_Text_MarcelIntro
text: My POKéMON have never tasted defeat!\nOn their next win, I'm entering them\lin CONTESTS.

label: Route121_Text_MarcelDefeat
text: Oh, now what happened here?

label: Route121_Text_MarcelPostBattle
text: I may have to train my gang some more\nbefore entering any CONTEST.

label: Route123_Text_WendyIntro
text: Want to determine how strong you are?\nI'll be the test!

label: Route123_Text_WendyDefeat
text: You passed with flying colors!

label: Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle
text: To best even me…\nYour strength is marvelous!

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro
text: You seem to have a big collection\nof GYM BADGES.\pLet me see if you're actually worthy of\nthose BADGES!

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonDefeat
text: Oh, you're worthy, all right!

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
text: You did your BADGES proud in that\nmatch!

label: Route123_Text_VioletIntro
text: They say that good times are filled\nwith good aromas.

label: Route123_Text_VioletDefeat
text: Oh…\nI smell the bitter scent of misery…

label: Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle
text: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled\nwith uplifting fragrances.

label: Route123_Text_CameronIntro
text: Being a psychic is about willpower.\pI've willed myself not to lose to\nanyone. That makes me strong!

label: Route123_Text_CameronDefeat
text: I feel sad…

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle
text: Being a psychic is about willpower.\nI thought I wouldn't lose to you…

label: Route123_Text_CameronRegister
text: I sense it!\nYou and I shall battle again!\lI can't tell if I'll win, though…\pLet's see your POKéNAV.

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchIntro
text: I've convinced myself that I won't\nlose anymore. That makes me strong!

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchDefeat
text: I feel sad…

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch
text: I should train at MT. PYRE…\nI'll never beat you this way…

label: Route123_Text_JackiIntro
text: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON\ndevelop psychic powers.\pYou need to refine those powers to\nmake them really useful.

label: Route123_Text_JackiDefeat
text: Overwhelmed!

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle
text: We all have psychic powers.\nWe've just forgotten how to use them.

label: Route123_Text_JackiRegister
text: I would like to face you again.\nIs that okay with you?

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchIntro
text: Have you awoken the psychic powers\nwithin you?

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchDefeat
text: Astounding!

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch
text: Your power with POKéMON…\nThat could be a psychic power, too.

label: Route123_Text_MiuIntro
text: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your\nPOKéMON won't cry when they lose.

label: Route123_Text_MiuDefeat
text: MIU: Uh-oh, we lost.

label: Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle
text: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are\nstrong because you are friends.

label: Route123_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
text: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.

label: Route123_Text_YukiIntro
text: YUKI: Okay!\nWe're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!

label: Route123_Text_YukiDefeat
text: YUKI: Uh-oh, we lost.

label: Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle
text: YUKI: Why are you so strong?\nWe've never lost before.

label: Route123_Text_YukiNotEnoughMons
text: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.

label: Route123_Text_KindraIntro
text: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\lWill your POKéMON sleep?

label: Route123_Text_KindraDefeat
text: Overflowing with vitality…

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
text: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\pIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits…

label: Route123_Text_FernandoIntro
text: I'll turn your lights out while\nI rip through this tune!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoDefeat
text: Hey, hold it!\nI was still playing the intro!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle
text: You're rock steady.\nI'd like to write a tune about you.

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRegister
text: The next time, lend your ears to\nthe full tune, will you?

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchIntro
text: Today's the day I'm going to do it!\nI'll turn out your lights before\lI finish singing my song!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchDefeat
text: Hey, hold it!\nI haven't even hit the chorus!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch
text: I thought you'd be so enthralled\nby my tune, you'd lose.

label: Route123_Text_DavisIntro
text: This is my awesome BUG POKéMON!\nMy big brother got it for me.

label: Route123_Text_DavisDefeat
text: Waaaah!\nYou meanie!

label: Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle
text: Don't tell my brother I lost.\nYou have to keep it a secret!

label: Route123_Text_JazmynIntro
text: My confidence will get a boost by\nbeating someone obviously strong!

label: Route123_Text_JazmynDefeat
text: There goes my confidence…

label: Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle
text: They say that you can't judge a person\nby their appearance.\pBut often, their looks don't lie…

label: Route123_Text_FrederickIntro
text: Hello, child!\nCan you spare some time?

label: Route123_Text_FrederickDefeat
text: Ah, a mighty capable child!\nLet me contribute to your allowance.

label: Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle
text: Contribute to your allowance?\nWasn't the prize money enough?

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro
text: I have to tell you, BIRD POKéMON\nare my obsession!\pBirds are cool!\nThey're the best!

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoDefeat
text: Even in defeat, BIRD POKéMON are cool!

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle
text: I gather BIRD POKéMON feathers that\nscatter during battles.\pI'm going to make a hat with\nBIRD POKéMON feathers.

label: Route123_Text_EdIntro
text: When there are no TRAINERS around,\nI let my POKéMON battle each other.\lI watch them.

label: Route123_Text_EdDefeat
text: I kind of like your POKéMON.

label: Route123_Text_EdPostBattle
text: Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas!\nI think they'll make me better.

label: Route123_Text_JonasIntro
text: I lay in ambush, and a TRAINER has\nlanded in my trap!

label: Route123_Text_JonasDefeat
text: If you don't lose, how am I supposed\nto have fun playing ninja?

label: Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle
text: I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking\nTRAINER next time.

label: Route123_Text_KayleyIntro
text: I just bought this parasol.\nMy cuteness should be up by a third!

label: Route123_Text_KayleyDefeat
text: You're better than me by about\nfive times!

label: Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle
text: Using accessories effectively is\nthe secret behind fashion appeal.

label: Route124_Text_SpencerIntro
text: Hey, are you lost at sea?\pIf you can beat my POKéMON,\nI can serve as your pilot.

label: Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat
text: I lost my bearings in battle!

label: Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle
text: Many people lose their bearings at sea.\pIf you're that sort, you should refer\nto the POKéNAV's MAP.

label: Route124_Text_RolandIntro
text: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead\nof swimming yourself…\pI am envious!

label: Route124_Text_RolandDefeat
text: Oh!\nI can't…

label: Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle
text: I'm getting chilled…\nI've been in the water too long…\pI wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…

label: Route124_Text_JennyIntro
text: If you just float in the sea like\nthis, POKéMON come around to play.

label: Route124_Text_JennyDefeat
text: Oh, darn.\nI've gone and lost.

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle
text: While swimming, I noticed that some\nPOKéMON attack, and some just watch.\pI guess POKéMON have personalities\nof their own.

label: Route124_Text_JennyRegister
text: It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get\nyou to register me in your POKéNAV.

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchIntro
text: If you just float in the sea like this,\nTRAINERS challenge you!

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchDefeat
text: That's strange…\nI lost again…

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch
text: This has nothing to do with anything,\nbut maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.

label: Route124_Text_GraceIntro
text: I'm growing bored of swimming…\nHow about a battle?

label: Route124_Text_GraceDefeat
text: I had no idea that you were\nthis strong!

label: Route124_Text_GracePostBattle
text: All the effort you put in must have\nmade you this strong.

label: Route124_Text_ChadIntro
text: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater\nto go deep under cover.\lPlumbing the depths is where I excel!

label: Route124_Text_ChadDefeat
text: Glub, glub, glub…\nI'm sinking…

label: Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle
text: I have it on good authority that\nthere's a DIVE spot around here.\pIt gives me the urge to go deep\nagain…

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
text: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pLet's battle so I won't have to dwell\non that!

label: Route124_Text_LilaDefeat
text: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost!\nYou're in for it later!

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle
text: LILA: Sigh…\pIf only it wasn't my little brother\nnext to me, but a nice boyfriend…

label: Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons
text: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.

label: Route124_Text_RoyIntro
text: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!\pDon't cry when you lose!

label: Route124_Text_RoyDefeat
text: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out…

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle
text: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pThat's why she doesn't have a\nboyfriend.

label: Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister
text: ROY: Will you battle with us again?\nBut take it easy next time, okay?

label: Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons
text: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
text: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pOh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle\nso I won't have to dwell on things!

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat
text: LILA: ROY!\nIt's your fault we lost again!\pWe're having a training session later!

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch
text: LILA: Sigh…\pIf I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat\nanyone with lovely combinations…

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchNotEnoughMons
text: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro
text: ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck.\nI'm going to go totally all out!

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchDefeat
text: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out again.

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch
text: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pShe's going to make me train really\nhard with POKéMON later…

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchNotEnoughMons
text: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.

label: Route124_Text_DeclanIntro
text: Here I am swimming by my lonesome\non this wide, beautiful sea.\pThere's no other word for it.\nThis is pathetic!

label: Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat
text: I'm feeling blue.\nBlue as the sky…

label: Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle
text: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS\nand invite them on a long swim.

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro
text: I'm not going to lose to some\nsurfer TRAINER.

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat
text: I've only got sweat in my eyes!\nI am not crying!

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle
text: You can find pretty colored shards\nof things around here.

label: Route125_Text_NolenIntro
text: I heard you approaching, so I hung\naround for you!

label: Route125_Text_NolenDefeat
text: I surrender!

label: Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle
text: Sound travels faster in water than\nit does through air.

label: Route125_Text_StanIntro
text: Hey, there!\nCheck out my sweet POKéMON!

label: Route125_Text_StanDefeat
text: I floundered…

label: Route125_Text_StanPostBattle
text: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm,\nso I started swimming, too.

label: Route125_Text_TanyaIntro
text: I'm tired of swimming.\nAre you up for a battle with me?

label: Route125_Text_TanyaDefeat
text: You're too much!

label: Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle
text: Whew…\nWhich way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?

label: Route125_Text_SharonIntro
text: How would you like to take on the\nWATER-type POKéMON I raised?

label: Route125_Text_SharonDefeat
text: Lost it…

label: Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle
text: Your power… You're the real deal.\nI'm amazed!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestIntro
text: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR!\nI've braved the world's seas!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestDefeat
text: Gwrroooar!\nI couldn't win!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle
text: The tide ebbs and flows inside the\nSHOAL CAVE.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Did you know?

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRegister
text: Register me in your POKéNAV,\nand I'll tell you something good.

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
text: It's high time I get my payback\nfrom you! Come on, we're battling!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchDefeat
text: I couldn't win!\nI flat out couldn't win!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
text: The SHOAL CAVE…\pThere are places you can and can't\nget to depending on the rise and fall\lof the tide.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Don't forget!

label: Route125_Text_KimIntro
text: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE. Someone told me.\lAre you going to see him, too?

label: Route125_Text_KimDefeat
text: KIM: I thought we would win.

label: Route125_Text_KimPostBattle
text: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?\pLet's go see him, IRIS!

label: Route125_Text_KimNotEnoughMons
text: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON,\nor it's just no good!

label: Route125_Text_IrisIntro
text: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're\nlooking for out here?

label: Route125_Text_IrisDefeat
text: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.

label: Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle
text: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into\nthe SHOAL CAVE?\lWe'll get all wet.

label: Route125_Text_IrisNotEnoughMons
text: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do\nanything like a 2-on-1 battle.

label: Route125_Text_PresleyIntro
text: Why would a BIRDKEEPER like me\ncome out to the sea?

label: Route125_Text_PresleyDefeat
text: Okay.\nI'll tell you why I'm here.

label: Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle
text: I put a message in a bottle and put\nit out to sea.\pI'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will\nfind it!

label: Route125_Text_AuronIntro
text: Hey! Was it you throwing garbage\ninto the sea?

label: Route125_Text_AuronDefeat
text: Oh, you weren't throwing trash into\nthe sea.

label: Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle
text: I found an unsightly bottle bobbing\nin the waves earlier.\pIt angers me that someone would\npollute the sea!

label: Route126_Text_BarryIntro
text: Swimming is a full-body workout!\nYou will get fit!

label: Route126_Text_BarryDefeat
text: I admit it!\nYou win!

label: Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle
text: Thanks to my daily swimming routine…\nLook! Feast your eyes on this physique!

label: Route126_Text_DeanIntro
text: This towering white mountain of rock\nis SOOTOPOLIS CITY.

label: Route126_Text_DeanDefeat
text: I was done in?

label: Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle
text: I can't find the entrance to\nSOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?

label: Route126_Text_NikkiIntro
text: Ufufufufu!\nI'm a mermaid!

label: Route126_Text_NikkiDefeat
text: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble!\nBlub, blub, blub…

label: Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle
text: You thrashed me… I want to\ndisappear in a wave of despair…

label: Route126_Text_BrendaIntro
text: Hello, kiddo!\nWant a battle with me?

label: Route126_Text_BrendaDefeat
text: Oh, noooooh!

label: Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle
text: I love frolicking with POKéMON in\nthe sea like this!

label: Route126_Text_PabloIntro
text: Check out this sculpted body!\nI'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!

label: Route126_Text_PabloDefeat
text: Whoops! Too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle
text: Losing to you stimulated my senses!\nI'll train myself and POKéMON harder!

label: Route126_Text_PabloRegister
text: Yep, you're not bad at all!\nI'd like to get to know you more!

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchIntro
text: Check out this beautiful body!\nI'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchDefeat
text: Whoops! Really too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch
text: I'm going to train even harder!\nYou're a great motivator!\lYou have to come back again!

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro
text: I couldn't even swim last year,\nbut now I'm a decent SWIMMER.\pI think I'm capable of anything now.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoDefeat
text: Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do\na thing for me.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle
text: If you practice at something,\nyou will get better at it.\pYou're young--don't be afraid to\ntry all sorts of things!

label: Route126_Text_IsobelIntro
text: If seawater gets up your nose,\ndoesn't it feel terrible?

label: Route126_Text_IsobelDefeat
text: Ack! Why, you…\nGlub!

label: Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle
text: Ooh, I choked on some water!\nIt's bitter! It's salty!!

label: Route126_Text_SiennaIntro
text: I'm throwing my whole heart\ninto this!

label: Route126_Text_SiennaDefeat
text: You had more heart!

label: Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle
text: I need to cool down now…\nI think I'll go for a dive.

label: Route127_Text_CamdenIntro
text: I can see it in your face.\nYou want to challenge me.

label: Route127_Text_CamdenDefeat
text: Awawawawawa…

label: Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle
text: A well-played match leaves me feeling\nrefreshed and serene.

label: Route127_Text_DonnyIntro
text: Do you have a rival whom you just\nhate to lose against?

label: Route127_Text_DonnyDefeat
text: Arrrgh!\nI hate losing!

label: Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle
text: If you have a rival, don't you get the\nfeeling that you have to keep getting\lbetter?

label: Route127_Text_JonahIntro
text: Through fishing, I have attained a\nstate of becalmed serenity…\pPlease, allow me to demonstrate…

label: Route127_Text_JonahDefeat
text: Though I have lost, my heart remains\ncalm…

label: Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle
text: It matters not that I catch nothing.\nThe line remains in the water…

label: Route127_Text_HenryIntro
text: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged\na SURFING POKéMON?

label: Route127_Text_HenryDefeat
text: I can't keep up!

label: Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle
text: It'd be a handful if I hooked\nyour tough POKéMON!

label: Route127_Text_RogerIntro
text: Well, hey! This is a match between\na POKéMON fan and a fishing buff!

label: Route127_Text_RogerDefeat
text: No! My line's all tangled!\nThe party's over!

label: Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle
text: My fishing line's doing a dance!\nThe tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!

label: Route127_Text_AidanIntro
text: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision.\nThey spot prey from great heights.

label: Route127_Text_AidanDefeat
text: Whew… I give up.

label: Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle
text: There're lots of diving spots in\nthe sea around here.\pYou can spot them easily from the sky\nbecause of their darker color.

label: Route127_Text_KojiIntro
text: Run in your bare feet.\nThat will toughen up your soles!

label: Route127_Text_KojiDefeat
text: Yowch!\nI got a pebble under a toenail!

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle
text: Going barefoot feels great.\nBut your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.

label: Route127_Text_KojiRegister
text: This is what I do to people who beat me!\nI hope we can do this again.

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchIntro
text: I still run in my bare feet daily.\nMy soles are tough!

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchDefeat
text: Yowch!\nPebbles dug into my arches!

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch
text: Want to go barefoot for a while?\nSo I can try your RUNNING SHOES?

label: Route127_Text_AthenaIntro
text: We should have a slow and methodical\nmatch.

label: Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat
text: You didn't give me the chance to\ndo any strategizing.

label: Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle
text: When I'm surrounded by the blue sea\nand sky, it feels as if time slows down.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahIntro
text: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways\naway…

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahDefeat
text: My first victory seems to be far\naway, too…

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
text: My whole life has been about losing,\nbut I will never give up!

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister
text: I know I'm not good now, but I think\nI can win eventually.\pPlease register me in your POKéNAV.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
text: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on\nswimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchDefeat
text: I've yet to taste my first victory…

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch
text: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY\nwhere I can eventually win…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynIntro
text: You have to swim, cycle, and then run\na marathon in a triathlon.\pIt's a grueling race that consists\nof three events.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynDefeat
text: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle
text: I have to ride a BIKE next, but…\nI'm about to throw in the towel…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRegister
text: Well, I may as well make the best\nof this. I'd like a rematch sometime.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
text: A triathlon is long. But I guess the\nroad to become the POKéMON CHAMPION\lis also a long and grueling one.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchDefeat
text: A POKéMON battle really is harsh\nand unforgiving…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch
text: You should give serious thought to\nchallenges on VICTORY ROAD.

label: Route128_Text_AlexaIntro
text: We've been working so hard to mount\na POKéMON LEAGUE challenge…\pWe can't afford to lose now!

label: Route128_Text_AlexaDefeat
text: Oh!\nHow could this happen?!

label: Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle
text: After all I've done to get here,\nI won't give up after one setback.

label: Route128_Text_RubenIntro
text: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!

label: Route128_Text_RubenDefeat
text: This can't be!

label: Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle
text: There probably is no stronger TRAINER\nthan you!

label: Route128_Text_WayneIntro
text: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I\ncaught myself a POKéMON that knows\lthe move WATERFALL to crest the falls.

label: Route128_Text_WayneDefeat
text: I'm crestfallen!

label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
text: Awww, phooey!\pMy POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but\nI don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro
text: You're looking awfully tough.\nI wonder if I can win?

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat
text: Ouch!\nI guess it was impossible to win.

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle
text: There are tough TRAINERS galore\naround EVER GRANDE.\pDo you think I may be out\nof my league?

label: Route128_Text_CarleeIntro
text: The sunlight seems to be more harsh\nin this area.

label: Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat
text: I couldn't see very well because of\nthe sun's glare.

label: Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle
text: I should go back soon.\nI need to reapply my sunscreen.

label: Route129_Text_ChaseIntro
text: This is my first triathlon.\nI'm all tense and nervous!

label: Route129_Text_ChaseDefeat
text: Wroooaaar!\nI failed to win!

label: Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle
text: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to\ngive it my all.

label: Route129_Text_AllisonIntro
text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut, sure, why don't we battle?

label: Route129_Text_AllisonDefeat
text: I was sure I'd win!

label: Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle
text: Do you know what's the greatest thing\nabout triathlons?\pTesting the limits of your own\nstrength and endurance against\lMother Nature!

label: Route129_Text_ReedIntro
text: Say hey, hey!\nLet's get on with it!

label: Route129_Text_ReedDefeat
text: Beat, I'm beaten.\nThat's it, done!

label: Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle
text: There's nothing for a loser.\nTime for me to beat it home.

label: Route129_Text_TishaIntro
text: What's the hurry?\nLet's take it slow and easy.

label: Route129_Text_TishaDefeat
text: Oh, my.\nI wanted to relax a little more…

label: Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle
text: Don't you hate making mistakes when\nyou're in a rush?\pThat's why I try to take things\nslowly.

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro
text: Surfing isn't as easy as it seems,\nisn't that right?

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceDefeat
text: Winning sure isn't easy.

label: Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle
text: You have your sights on the POKéMON\nLEAGUE? Keep at it!

label: Route130_Text_RodneyIntro
text: What a surprise! I didn't expect to\nsee a TRAINER out in the sea.\pI think we should battle!

label: Route130_Text_RodneyDefeat
text: This kid's awfully tough…

label: Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle
text: Your eyes have that look of someone\nwho's experienced harsh challenges\land won. It suits you well!

label: Route130_Text_KatieIntro
text: In the deep blue sea,\nmy shattered blue heart finds\lcomfort among waves.

label: Route130_Text_KatieDefeat
text: Like the vast blue sea,\nthe world of POKéMON spans\ldepths beyond belief.

label: Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle
text: The world's children dream\nof one day becoming\lthe POKéMON CHAMPION.

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro
text: Floating on the open sea like this…\nIt's peaceful.

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat
text: I needed to be a little less peaceful!

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle
text: Swimming and battling like this…\nI'm one happy guy…

label: Route131_Text_RichardIntro
text: The sea is teeming with POKéMON.\nIt's not easy swimming, I tell you.

label: Route131_Text_RichardDefeat
text: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are\nseriously tough…

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
text:
Gasp… Gasp…
I'm wiped out…\pThe going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.\pWill I have any energy left to make
the return trip?

label: Route131_Text_HermanIntro
text: The sea… The sea… The sea…\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!\lI'm sick and tired of the sea!

label: Route131_Text_HermanDefeat
text: Bleah!

label: Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle
text: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.\pI'm a born swimmer!\nThat's what I am.

label: Route131_Text_SusieIntro
text: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!

label: Route131_Text_SusieDefeat
text: You're tough in spite of the way\nyou look!

label: Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle
text: Did you see a guy over there who whines\nthat he's bored of the sea?\pThat's all talk.\nHe's hopelessly in love with the sea!

label: Route131_Text_KaraIntro
text: Why do men love bathing suits so much?\pThey all ogle me!

label: Route131_Text_KaraDefeat
text: I'm out of my depth!

label: Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle
text: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that\nmakes men look. It must be my beauty!

label: Route131_Text_ReliIntro
text: RELI: We'll work together as siblings\nto take you on!

label: Route131_Text_ReliDefeat
text: RELI: We couldn't win even though we\nworked together…

label: Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle
text: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\ntogether with the sea and POKéMON from\lthe time they are born.

label: Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons
text: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?\nWe can't enjoy a battle, then.

label: Route131_Text_IanIntro
text: IAN: I'm doing my best together with\nmy sis!

label: Route131_Text_IanDefeat
text: IAN: I did my best with my sis,\nbut we still couldn't win…

label: Route131_Text_IanPostBattle
text: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is\na floating town?\pSo, wherever there is the sea,\nthat's a part of PACIFIDLOG!

label: Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
text: IAN: If you have two POKéMON,\nwe'll take you on!

label: Route131_Text_TaliaIntro
text: If you can beat me, I'll give you some\ngreat information!
