label: Route131_Text_TaliaDefeat
text: Oh?\nDid I lose?

label: Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle
text: There is an odd place nearby.\nThere's a huge tower there.\lWhy don't you go take a look?

label: Route131_Text_KevinIntro
text: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\na peaceful bunch.\pThey never get angry.\nThat goes for me, too.

label: Route131_Text_KevinDefeat
text: Oops!

label: Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle
text: Tch! …Oh, wait.\nI'm not angry. Honestly!\pBut, boy, you're strong!\nHahaha!

label: Route132_Text_GilbertIntro
text: I used to catch colds all the time as\na kid, but I became totally fit after\lI started swimming.

label: Route132_Text_GilbertDefeat
text: I crave more power…

label: Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle
text: TRAINERS travel the fields and\nmountains, so they must be fit, too.

label: Route132_Text_DanaIntro
text: I try not to swim where the currents\nare too strong.

label: Route132_Text_DanaDefeat
text: Oh, please, no!

label: Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle
text: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my\nsense of place…

label: Route132_Text_RonaldIntro
text: Win or lose, you'll never know until\nyou try!

label: Route132_Text_RonaldDefeat
text: Waah!\nI sank in defeat!

label: Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle
text: I never battle when I know I'll win.\nI like to battle at the razor's edge of\lvictory and defeat!

label: Route132_Text_KiyoIntro
text: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day.\nHow could you possibly beat me?

label: Route132_Text_KiyoDefeat
text: I lose.\nI will concede defeat.

label: Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle
text: Urggh…\nYou're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?\pYou must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours\na day, don't you?

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro
text: I'm always with my husband,\nbut I can win even without him.

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat
text: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
text: That young man over there looks just\nlike my husband when he was young.\pHe's making me blush!

label: Route132_Text_JonathanIntro
text: Someone's been watching me intently.\nWas it you?

label: Route132_Text_JonathanDefeat
text: Wow!\nThat's pretty strong, all right!

label: Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle
text: I can't shake this feeling that\nsomeone's watching me.\pI can't concentrate!

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro
text: Now where could my wife have gone?\nI'm always with her.\lI wonder if I can win on my own.

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonDefeat
text: Ah, I see that I couldn't manage\nto win on my own after all.

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
text: My wife must be looking for me.\nI'd best go find her right away.

label: Route132_Text_DarcyIntro
text: I liked training here by myself.\nIt's awful that all these people came!

label: Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat
text: Okay! I won't complain about other\npeople being here.

label: Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle
text: I suppose I can partner up with that\nold man and challenge that other team.

label: Route133_Text_FranklinIntro
text: Did the currents carry you here, too?\nThis must have been fated.\lLet's battle!

label: Route133_Text_FranklinDefeat
text: Strong!\nToo much so!

label: Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle
text: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER\nlike you would drift here…\lI must be cursed…

label: Route133_Text_DebraIntro
text: I've led a life of woe and misery…\nI've been cast away, and this is where\lI've drifted…

label: Route133_Text_DebraDefeat
text: Another loss…

label: Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle
text: A life adrift…\nI don't want it anymore!

label: Route133_Text_LindaIntro
text: Welcome!\nI've been expecting you!

label: Route133_Text_LindaDefeat
text: No! Please!

label: Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle
text: A strong child TRAINER…\nThat's so annoying!

label: Route133_Text_WarrenIntro
text: I want to win like everyone else, but I\nwon't raise POKéMON like everyone else.

label: Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat
text: Darn it!\nMy way is still too slack!

label: Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle
text: It's way more fun to do things the way\nI want than to be like everybody else.\lI mean, that's obvious!

label: Route133_Text_BeckIntro
text: I came all the way out here with my\nBIRD POKéMON.

label: Route133_Text_BeckDefeat
text: You…\nYou're stunningly cool!

label: Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle
text: I'd like to go back to FORTREE,\nbut I've grown to like this place, too.

label: Route133_Text_MollieIntro
text: I must have battled thousands\nof times. I've lost count.

label: Route133_Text_MollieDefeat
text: I may have lost thousands of times,\nbut a loss still stings.

label: Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle
text: Keep at this, youngster. So you can\nbecome like my husband and me.

label: Route133_Text_ConorIntro
text: Young people are too happy to go with\nthe flow. They're without direction.

label: Route133_Text_ConorDefeat
text: You have a firm sense of purpose.

label: Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle
text: Don't let others lead you astray.\nDon't lose direction as you grow older.

label: Route134_Text_JackIntro
text: Even those POKéMON that can swim are\ncarried along by the rapid currents.

label: Route134_Text_JackDefeat
text: Aiyeeeeh!

label: Route134_Text_JackPostBattle
text: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running\ncurrents around these parts.

label: Route134_Text_LaurelIntro
text: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun\nmatch. Will you join us?

label: Route134_Text_LaurelDefeat
text: Oopsie!

label: Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle
text: There's a collector who's after\nthe SCALES of LUVDISC.

label: Route134_Text_AlexIntro
text: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang!\nIt's time for a match!

label: Route134_Text_AlexDefeat
text: Tuckered out again…

label: Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle
text: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after\na long flight…

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro
text: You're a POKéMON TRAINER.\nNo need for words. We battle now.

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
text: It was I who challenged you, and yet\nI lost. I am deeply shamed…

label: Route134_Text_AaronIntro
text: The savage tide in this area serves to\nmake us stronger than ever.

label: Route134_Text_AaronDefeat
text: I willingly concede defeat.

label: Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle
text: We will return for more training at\nMETEOR FALLS.\pIf you'd like, you should go, too.\nIt will definitely toughen you up!

label: Route134_Text_KelvinIntro
text: O-our boat!\nThe tide carried it away!

label: Route134_Text_KelvinDefeat
text: Awawawawah!\nPlease, stop! Please!

label: Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle
text: If we can't SURF, how are we supposed\nto get home?\pActually, I know a fainted POKéMON\ncan still SURF, but it feels wrong.

label: Route134_Text_MarleyIntro
text: Can your POKéMON dodge our\nlightning-quick attacks?

label: Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat
text: I never knew such a technique existed!\nYou've defeated us thoroughly.

label: Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle
text: I haven't lost my passion for speed.\nI will try harder.

label: Route134_Text_ReynaIntro
text: My POKéMON can't be taken down\neasily!

label: Route134_Text_ReynaDefeat
text: You're kidding!\nExplain how I lost!

label: Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle
text: Haha!\nYou won, all right!\pI'll work my way back up by taking on\nTRAINERS I happen to meet!

label: Route134_Text_HudsonIntro
text: Listen, have you seen another SAILOR\naround here?

label: Route134_Text_HudsonDefeat
text: Now, that's something!

label: Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle
text: Our boat drifted out to sea.\pMy buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm\nworried about him.

text: The battery isn't charged enough.\pNo. of steps required to fully\ncharge the battery: {STR_VAR_1}{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}

label: VSSeeker_Text_NoTrainersWithinRange
text: There are no Trainers within range\nwho can battle…\pThe VS Seeker was turned off.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}

text: The other Trainers don't appear\nto be ready for battle.\pLet's wait till later.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DifficultToMakeBattleTurnOutAsPlanned

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeYourBattle

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SilentType

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LookingForwardToNextBattle
text: I'll be looking forward to your\nnext battle!

text:

love on your {STR_VAR_1}.\pOkay, it's named {STR_VAR_2}.\pCan I ask you a favor?\pI'm a TV reporter, and I'm running

text: Great! Thank you!\pOkay, here goes.\nI just need quick answers, okay?

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DescribeFeelingsFirstMetMon
text: When you first met {STR_VAR_1},\nwhat did you feel?\pHow would you describe your feelings\nat the time?

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikenMonToSomethingYouLike
text: Your {STR_VAR_1} is cared for lovingly.\pIf you were to liken it to something\nthat you like, what would it be?

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_WhatAttractedYouAboutMon
text: This question also relates to your\nbeloved {STR_VAR_1}.\pWhat was it about {STR_VAR_1} that\nattracted you?

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_WhatDoPokemonMeanToYou

end up on TV. Tune in and check!\pOkay, that's all.

text: You will?\nThank you!\pOkay, I need you to describe your\nfeelings about our battle, but it\lhas to be short and sweet. Go!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou
text:
GABBY: Mmm, yeah!
That's the perfect clincher!\pI get the feeling that this will make
a great TV show.\pThere's a chance that they'll air this
on TV, so make sure to look for us!\pOkay!
We'll be seeing you!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DontGiveUpKeepingEyeOut
text: GABBY: Oh…\pOkay, but don't give up!\nWe'll be keeping an eye out for you!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_KeepingAnEyeOutForYou
text: GABBY: We'll be keeping an eye out\nfor you!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyNotEnoughMons
text: GABBY: Is there a strong TRAINER\nanywhere with a lot of POKéMON?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GiveUsAnInterviewThisTime
text:
GABBY: Wow, you are something!\pYou've gotten a lot stronger--a lot--
since we last battled.\pWe were right about you when we
spotted you as a hot TRAINER.\pSo, anyway, what do you think?
Are you willing to give us an interview\lthis time?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeat
text: GABBY: That was an intense battle!\nDid you get all that on camera?

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPreFirstBattle
text: TY: Hey, lookie here! A tough-looking\nTRAINER here, of all places!\lCamera's rolling!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyIntro
text: TY: Hey, lookie here!\nI remember you!\pI'll get this battle all on this\nhere camera!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPostBattle
text: TY: You're a natural!\nGot me some prime footage right here!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyNotEnoughMons
text: TY: Do you only have the one POKéMON\nand that's it?\pIf you had more POKéMON, it'd make for\nbetter footage, but…

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeatFirstTime
text: TY: Yep, we sure spotted a hot TRAINER.\nThis is a huge scoop for us!

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeat
text: TY: Yep, I got it all.\nThat whole battle's on camera.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText00
text:
IN SEARCH OF TRAINERS…\pGABBY: Hi! Today I'm visiting an area
near {STR_VAR_1}.\pWe're trying to spot some up-and-
coming new talent in the field.\pToday, we turned our lens on the
TRAINER {PLAYER}.\pThere's something about this TRAINER
that piqued our interest.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText01
text: We've battled {PLAYER} before, but we\ncan attest that the TRAINER has most\ldefinitely improved from before.\pI knew we were onto someone special\nwhen we spotted this TRAINER!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
text:
The best way to determine how strong
a TRAINER is…\pWell, the fastest way is to battle.
And so we began our investigation!\p… …\pThat's how we ended up in battle
with {PLAYER}.\pIn a dominating performance, we were
flattened, rolled up, and tossed aside!\p{PLAYER} is ruthlessly strong…\pHere's our impressions after having
battled our featured TRAINER.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
text:
The combination of {STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3} was divine!\pThe sight of them--{STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3}--selflessly supporting\leach other in the thick of battle…\pIt was a marvelous sight to behold!\p{STR_VAR_2} was the move the TRAINER
used last in our battle.\pThe move {STR_VAR_2} is {STR_VAR_1}
and {STR_VAR_3}'s sign of friendship!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
text:
…I lost confidence in myself as
a result of our encounter.\pWe were beaten before we could launch
a single attack.\lOhhh… Snivel…\pIn spite of that, {PLAYER}'s battles
are worth seeing.\pI recommend confident TRAINERS to
challenge {PLAYER}.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
text:
There's only one thing to be said.
Don't you dare throw a POKé BALL during\la TRAINER battle!\p{PLAYER} is certainly strong, but has
no clue about the basic rules.\pTo our TV audience, I have a request.\pIf you see {PLAYER}, please caution
the TRAINER!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText06
text: {PLAYER} is adept at reading the\nopponent's actions.\pThe timing of item usage was remarkably\neffective!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
text:
Honestly speaking, I thought that
I might even be pretty good.\pWhile we did end up losing, we did have
a hotly contested battle.\pBut if you're struggling against me,
you have a ways to go, {PLAYER}!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
text:
After our battle, we asked {PLAYER} for
a succinct summary.\pThe TRAINER replied, “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON {STR_VAR_2} and
{STR_VAR_3}…\lAnd “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pMmm! That's deep! There's deep
significance behind that quote!\pIt's no surprise--a good TRAINER has
good things to say.\pThat's all for today!
See you again on our next broadcast!

text:

text:

Thanks for joining us on live TV!\pMay I congratulate you on your win?\pWhat was the key factor in today's

today, my {STR_VAR_2} and I!\pBut I'm sure we wouldn't have made it

with whom you'd like to share your joy?\lLet's hear it live!\pBEAUTY: Hey, out there!\p{STR_VAR_3}! Are you watching?
We did it!\lThank you!

text:

The poor girl!\pMC: Uh… Uh-oh…\pUh… That's all the time we have today!

text:
